sa: jadājaḍānām apy evaṃ % nāsty asāv iti niścayaḥ naitat svarūpaṃ spṛśati % vastuno jñātṛgāmy adaḥ parāpekṣitayā naika- % rūpatve sattvalaṅghanāt siddhyaty eva viśeṣo 'tra % tāvatā ca prayojanam tadapekṣāṃ vinā bhāvā- % bhāvayor aviśiṣṭatā kuryān nānyas tathāpy artho % nirviśeṣo nijātmani sann arthaḥ syāt svarūpeṇa % nāsatas tu viśiṣyate samam evānayos tena % pratiṣṭhā saṃvidāśrayā abhāvena jaḍenātha % tulyaiva prāgvad ātmani

katham anyasya bhāvasya % pratiṣṭhāspadatām iyāt pratiṣṭhātmakatāṃ gacched % aham ity ātmanā punaḥ vyavasthitiḥ pratiṣṭhā ca % siddhir nirvṛttir ucyate jaḍāḥ prakāśa evāsti % svātmanaḥ svaparātmabhiḥ muktvānvayasya prakāśasya % vimarśarahitātmanaḥ yā svasvarūpe viśrāntir % vimarśaḥ so 'ham ity ayam prāṇādinā niruddho 'ṇuḥ % paramātmā tv akhaṇḍitaḥ eka evānusandhānād % ato 'nyo nopapadyate bhāti paryantavartinyāṃ % bhāsanād adhikaṃ jaḍam

tat prāṇādi prameyaṃ syān % na pramātānyato bhramāt jīve niruddhā tatrāpi % paramātmani sā sthitā sādhitā pratyabhijñāyām % akhyāter jīvatā param prakāśasyātmaviśrāntir % ahaṃbhāvo hi kīrtitaḥ svātantryam atha kartṛtvaṃ % mukhyam īśvaratāpi ca tadakhyātimayaṃ hy etaj % jagannirmātṛteśitā svasaṃvedanaparyāya- % mātṛtattvam anādi tat vyāpitvam anusaṃdhānaṃ % taj jaḍasya na yujyate tenoktam pratyabhijñāyāṃ % tadadvayamayaṃ jagat

en: When the yogin abides with mind-wind dissolved in the inward aim — he, seeing yet not seeing outside with unmoving-pupil gaze — this indeed becomes the śāmbhavī mudrā, by your grace, O guru: devoid of void and non-void becomes that reality, the śāmbhava state.
l3:
When the yogin rests, mind and breath dissolved in the inward aim — seeing, yet unseeing, outward with motionless gaze —
this indeed becomes śāmbhavī mudrā, by your grace, O guru: reality free of void and non-void becomes the śāmbhava state.
sa: antarlakṣyavilīnacittapavano yogī yadā vartate dṛṣṭyā niścalatārayā bahirasau paśyannapaśyannapi | mudreyaṃ khalu śāmbhavī bhavati sā yuṣmatprasādādguro śūnyāśūnyavivarjitaṃ bhavati yat tattvaṃ padaṃ śāmbhavam

en: Half-open-eyed, steady-minded, gaze placed on the nose-tip — moon and sun too have attained dissolution in the interior of the triple-throb state — light-formed, devoid of all exteriority, and one supreme person: reality attains that state, the thing supreme. What more is there to say here?
l3:
Eyes half-open, mind steady, gaze set on the nose-tip — moon and sun themselves dissolved within the triple throb —
a form of light, free of all outside, the one supreme Person: reality attains that state, the highest Real. What more is there to say here?
sa: ardhoddhāṭitalocanaḥ sthiramanā nāsāgradattekṣaṇaḥ candrārkāvapi līnatāmupagatau trispandabhāvāntare | jyotīrūpamaśeṣabāhyarahitaṃ caikaṃ pumāṃsaṃ paraṃ tattvaṃ tatpadameti vastu paramam vācyaṃ kimatrādhikam

en: Whatever sound arises from the mouth — that mantra is transcendent. Whatever posture of the pleasure-pain-born body — that indeed is mudrā. Whatever flowing of breath by its own rhythm — that indeed is wonderful yoga. The supreme śākta abode — while I experience, what indeed would not shine?
l3:
Whatever sound rises from the mouth — that mantra is beyond the world; whatever stance this pleasure-pain-born body takes — that itself is mudrā.
Whatever flowing of breath in its own rhythm — that itself is wondrous yoga; and the supreme śākta abode — as I experience it, what would not shine?
sa: śabdaḥ kaścana yo mukhādudayate mantraḥ sa lokottaraḥ saṃsthānaṃ sukhaduḥkhajanmavapuṣo yatkāpi mudraiva sā | prāṇasya svarasena yatpravahaṇaṃ yogaḥ sa evādbhutaḥ śāktaṃ dhāma paraṃ mamānubhavataḥ kinnāma na bhrājate

en: That mantra shines forth in which letter-arrangement is not distinguished. That mudrā arises in which entire bodily action is dissolved. That yoga spreads forth from which breath's flowing is exhausted. In the festivals of attaining Your abode, of the wise — what, what is indeed not wonderful?
l3:
That mantra shines where no pattern of letters can be traced; that mudrā rises where every bodily act has melted away.
That yoga spreads where the breath’s flowing is spent; in the festivals of attaining Your abode, of the wise — what, what is not wonderful?
sa: mantraḥ sa pratibhāti varṇaracanā yasminna saṃlakṣyate mudrā sā samudeti yatra galitā kṛtsnā kriyā kāyikī | yogaḥ sa prathate yataḥ pravahaṇaṃ prāṇasya saṃkṣīyate tvaddhāmādhigamotsaveṣu sudhiyāṃ kiṃ kiṃ na nāmādbhutaṃ

en: Transition here is no method at all — not contemplation, not speech-connection, not discussion, not visualization, not steadying, not japa-practice-effort. So what is well-decided? Speak the supreme truth, and hear it: not renouncer, not possessor — enjoy happiness, wholly, as staying.
l3:
No crossing here by method — no contemplation, no reasoned talk, no inquiry, no visualization, no fixing, no straining at mantra-practice.
So what stands well decided? Speak the highest truth — and hear it: neither renouncer nor possessor — enjoy happiness, all of it, abiding as you are.
sa: saṃkrāmo 'tra na bhāvanā na ca kathāyuktir na carcā na ca dhyānaṃ vā na ca dhāraṇā na ca japābhyāsaprayāso na ca | tat kiṃ nāma suniścitaṃ vada paraṃ satyaṃ ca tac chrūyatām: na tyāgī na parigrahī — bhaja sukhaṃ sarvam yathāvasthitaḥ

saṃsāro 'sti na tattvatas tanubhṛtāṃ bandhasya vārtaiva kā bandho yasya na jātu tasya vitathā muktasya muktikriyā | mithyāmohakṛd eṣa rajjubhujagacchāyāpiśācabhramo mā kiṃcit tyaja mā gṛhāṇa vihara svastho yathāvasthitaḥ

pūjapūjakapūjyabhedasaraṇiḥ keyaṃ kathānuttare saṃkrāmaḥ kila kasya kena vidadhe ko vā praveśakramaḥ | māyeyam na cidadvayāt paratayā bhinnāpy aho vartate sarvaṃ svānubhavasvabhāvavimalaṃ cintāṃ vṛthā mā kṛthāḥ

ānando 'tra na vittamadhyamadavan naivāṅganāsaṅgavat dīpārkendukṛtaprabhāprakaravan naiva prakāśodayaḥ | harṣaḥ saṃbhṛtabhedamuktisukhabhūr bhārāvatāropamaḥ sarvādvaitapadasya vismṛtanidheḥ prāptiḥ prakāśodayaḥ

en: Passion, aversion, pleasure, displeasure, rise and fall, I-ness, misery and the rest — things shining forth, universe-bodied, are not different-natured. Whosever manifestation you suddenly see — having regarded it as one-self-natured consciousness-form — why do you not delight, full of contemplation?
l3:
Passion, aversion, pleasure, pain, rise and fall, I-sense, misery and the rest — these states, shining forth, bodied of the universe, are of no separate nature.
Whatever form you suddenly see — see it as consciousness of one self-nature: why not delight, full of contemplating it?
sa: rāgadveṣasukhāsukhodayalayāhaṅkāradainyādayo ye bhāvāḥ pravibhānti viśvavapuṣo bhinnasvabhāvā na te | vyaktiṃ paśyasi yasya yasya sahasā tattattadekātmatāsaṃvidrūpam avekṣya kiṃ na ramase tadbhāvanānirbharaḥ

en: Former non-being, being, action — things always, suddenly, in this existence: middle-formed, transformation-confused — whence their truth? In the non-true, unsteady, manifold, clever dream-delusion — transcending doubt, fear, stain, and reasoning's contriving: awakened, become.
l3:
Past non-being, being, doing — things, always, suddenly, in this becoming, half-formed and mixed in change: what truth could they have?
In the untrue, restless, teeming, clever dream-delusion — past doubting, fearing, staining, and reason’s scheming: awake — become.
sa: pūrvābhāvabhavakriyā hi sahasā bhāvāḥ sadā 'smin bhave madhyākāravikārasaṃkaravatāṃ teṣāṃ kutaḥ satyatā | niḥsatye capale prapañcanicaye svapnabhrame peśale śaṅkātaṅkakalaṅkayuktikalanātītaḥ prabuddho bhava

en: Of things there is no arising; naturally, by your contemplation they shine; even the non-true partakes of truth for a moment, through experience's delusion. This universe-glory is will-born from you, birth from elsewhere it has none; hence by splendor you shine in worlds — one, yet many-selfed.
l3:
Things do not arise; by nature they shine through your beholding — even the untrue partakes of truth for a moment, through experience’s delusion.
This glory of worlds is will-born of You, with birth from nowhere else — so in splendor You shine through the worlds, one and yet many-selfed.
sa: bhāvānāṃ na samudbhavo 'sti sahajas tvadbhāvitā bhānty amī niḥsatyā api satyatām anubhavabhrāntyā bhajanti kṣaṇam | tvatsaṅkalpaja eṣa viśvamahimā nāsty asya janmānyataḥ tasmāt tvaṃ vibhavena bhāsi bhuvaneṣv ekopy anekātmakaḥ

en: What true, what untrue, little-much, eternal, not eternal, what Māyā-stained, what self-pure — in the consciousness-mirror shines. That all, from own-grasping-consciousness-rise, form-light-natured, having known — own-experience-risen glory: Lordhood — worship.
l3:
What is true, what untrue, little or much, lasting or lasting-not, Māyā-stained or self-pure — all shines in the mirror of consciousness.
All that — risen from self-grasping consciousness, natured as form and light — know it: glory mounted on your own experience — worship lordship of all.
sa: yat satyaṃ yad asatyam alpabahulaṃ nityaṃ na nityaṃ ca yat yan māyāmalinaṃ yad ātmavimalaṃ ciddarpaṇe rājate | tat sarvaṃ svavimarśasaṃvidudayād rūpaprakāśātmakaṃ jñātvā svānubhavādhirūḍhamahimā viśveśvaratvaṃ bhaja

cidbhairavam eva paraṃ paramāmṛtarūpam ekam atidīptam | ullasitakaraṇacakragrastasamastaṃ śivaṃ vande || stutyaḥ stotā stutir iti yad api vibhinnaṃ na kiṃcid astīha | mṛṣati yathā yad rūpaṃ cidrūpatayā tathā bhavaty etat || vigalitasarvavibhedaṃ sarvavibhedātma cidghanānandam | yat tava tattvaṃ bhagavaṃs tasyānukṛtiṃ tvadākṛtiṃ vande || rekhāpuruṣaḥ puruṣaṃ varṇalipir varṇasaṃcayaṃ yadvat | tadvat vicitrarūpaṃ tvām ākāro vyanakti paramātman || tatrāvikalpam eva tvāṃ cidrūpaṃ samāviśya | vimṛśāma

paśyata paśyata pāśā viṣamās ta ime bahiṣkṛtāḥ śaśvat | ity antradhāraṇamiṣat kathayaṃs tvaṃ naḥ samābhāsi || māyāpaṭaḥ sarāgo vyomni pare 'smin sa eṣa nikṣiptaḥ | iti gajacarma saraktaṃ mūrdhni vahan kathayasīśa || antaḥśaktikṛpāṇīm vyanakṣi saṃsṛtivibhedinīm asinā | nijaśaktimahimasvīkṛtasamastaviśvā hi vīravarāḥ || bhavabhayahantā so 'ham sānāthye 'vasthito 'smi mā bhaiṣṭa | ity āsphoṭitakheṭakadarśanato diśasi naḥ svāmin || nijaśaktipāśavalitaś cidvapuṣā kalyate mayā kālaḥ | iti pāśadhāraṇav

kiṃ ca parādikaśaktitritayārāsundarām mahāśaktim | devānukaroṣi bahis triśūladhāraṇamiṣeṇa nityaṃ tvam || icchādikanijaśaktiprakāśitādhaḥsthagocaratritayām | svām eva parāṃ śaktiṃ vajramayīṃ vahasi ṣaḍarāṃ tvam || jagad akhilaṃ macchaktyā damitaṃ sarvavyāvasthitīr dhatte | iti daṇḍadhāraṇavaśād vyanakṣi cidbhairavāsmākam || mudgaraparaśū bibhrad baindavanādānukārarūpau tvam | bhedavibhedanaśakalanaparatvam īśāna nirdiśasi || darśanabhedāt svāminn anyānyām āhṛtiṃ dadhānas tvam | bhairavaparabodha

deva digambaratā te vadati nirāvaraṇam ātmano rūpam | paramabrahmamayārkān māyāvaraṇam kathaṃ vṛṇuyāt || saṃhartā sarveṣām arkādīnām ahaṃ tamobhūmiḥ | nirmalaśāradagaganaprabheṇa vapuṣeti darśayasi || paramabrahmamayas tvaṃ deva yadāśrayasi bhairavākāram | tat prathayasi tattvajñaḥ saty api bhede vimukta iti || vividhaśmaśānamālāvetālāvṛtaḥ prakāśayase | saṃvittiviṣayakalanāmadhyaś citibhairavo 'smīti || tvayy evāmṛtalekhā paraśaktimayī parapramātātaḥ | nātha tvam eva jagatām jīvanam iti bhāsi n

en: Pervading the particular states of moving and unmoving — consciousness-made, one, endless, beginningless: Bhairava-Lord, refuge of the helpless — by mind become Yours, in heart I venerate.
l3:
Pervading every state of moving and unmoving, consciousness itself is one — without end or beginning.
Bhairava, Lord, refuge of the helpless — with a mind become Yours, in my heart, I bow.
sa: vyāptacarācarabhāvaviśeṣaṃ cinmayam ekam anantam anādim bhairavanātham anāthaśaraṇyaṃ tvanmayacittatayā hṛdi vande

en: All this, become of You, now appears to me by the power of Your grace. You, Maheśa, are always my self; by You all is mine.
l3:
All this, become Yours without remainder, now appears to me by the power of Your grace.
You, Maheśa, are ever my own self — made of You, all is mine through You.
sa: tvanmayam etad aśeṣam idānīṃ bhāti mama tvadanugrahaśaktyā tvaṃ ca maheśa sadaiva mamātmā svātmamayaṃ mama tena samastam

en: With You as Lord, all-pervading in own self — therefore no talk of transmigration-fear. Even though hard-to-bear suffering, delusion, terror-causing karmas are present.
l3:
You, Lord, pervade my own self — so there is no talk of transmigration-fear.
Even while hard-to-bear suffering, delusion, and terror-causing karma-hosts stand.
sa: svātmani viśvagaye tvayi nāthe tena na saṃsṛtibhītikathāsti satsv api durdharaduḥkhavimohatrāsavidhāyiṣu karmagaṇeṣu

en: O Ender, turn not toward me this most wrathful-terrible gaze. Firm in Śaṅkara-service and contemplation, I am filled with terrifying Bhairava-power.
l3:
O Ender — turn from me this most wrathful and terrible gaze.
Steadfast in Śaṅkara’s service and contemplation, I am filled with dread Bhairava-power.
sa: antaka māṃ prati mā dṛśam enāṃ krodhakarālatamāṃ vinidhehi śaṅkarasevanacintanadhīro bhīṣaṇabhairavaśaktimayo 'smi

en: Thus — great darkness dispelled by rays of world-awareness: death, Yama, the ender, karma-ghosts — Lord, salutation; never do I fear.
l3:
Thus — the great darkness, taken on with becoming, is dispelled by awareness’s rays:
Death, Yama, the Ender, karma-ghosts — Lord, salutation: never shall I fear.
sa: ittham upoḍhabhavanmayasaṃviddīdhitidāritabhūritamisraḥ mṛtyuyamāntakakarmapiśācaiḥ nātha ! namo'stu na jātu bibhemi

en: The true essence of world-objects is seen by rays of arisen true awakening. In being-full in You — I, the self, enter bliss.
l3:
True awakening has dawned — its rays reveal each thing’s true essence:
In You — brimming full of supreme nectar — I myself enter bliss.
sa: proditasatyavibodhamarīciprekṣitaviśvapadārthasatattvaḥ bhāvaparāmṛtanirbharapūrṇe tvayi aham ātmani nirvṛtim emi

en: When the affliction-state, producing slight anguish, comes into the mind's range — Lord, then alone is my nondifference with You; the supreme-nectar-rain arises.
l3:
Whenever affliction, dealing slight anguish, comes within the mind’s reach —
then alone, Lord, my nondifference from You: the hymn rains supreme nectar.
sa: mānasagocaram eti yadaiva kleśadaśā tanutāpavidhātrī nātha ! tadaiva mama tvadabhedas stotraparāmṛtavṛṣṭiḥ udeti

en: Truly, O Śaṅkara: vow, giving, bathing, austerity dispel becoming's heat. Contemplation of Your scripture as supreme nectar streams a bliss-stream in mind.
l3:
Truly, Śaṅkara — vow, giving, bathing, austerity: they dispel becoming’s heat.
But contemplating Your scripture as supreme nectar pours a bliss-stream in the mind.
sa: śaṅkara satyam idam vratadānasnānatapaḥ bhavatāpavidāri tāvakaśāstra parāmṛtacintā cetasi nirvṛtidhārām syandati

en: This consciousness of mine dances, sings, deeply rejoices — O Bhairava-Lord. Having obtained You, the dear: the beautiful vision alone, hard to get by others, samaya-knower.
l3:
This consciousness of mine dances, sings, rejoices deeply — O Bhairava, Lord:
having won You, my dear — a single beautiful vision, hard for others to obtain, kept for knowers of the covenant.
sa: nṛtyati gāyati hṛṣyati gāḍham saṃvit iyam mama bhairavanātha tvāṃ priyam āpya sudarśanamekam durlabhamanyajanaiḥ samayajñam

en: In the month of Pauṣa, on the dark tenth, Abhinavagupta made this hymn. The pervasive, compassionate Lord pacifies the world's desert-heat — instantly.
l3:
In the Vasura year, in Pauṣa, on the dark tenth — Abhinavagupta composed this hymn —
by which the pervasive, compassionate Lord in a flash stills the people’s desert-heat of becoming.
sa: vasurasapauṣe kṛṣṇadaśamyām abhinavaguptaḥ stavam imam akarot yena vibhuḥ bhavati janasya arusantāpaṃ śamayati jhaṭiti dayāluḥ
# Text  anastamitabhārūpas tejasāṃ tamasām api | ya eko 'ntar yadantaś ca tejāṃsi ca tamāṃsi ca
sa eva sarvabhūtānāṃ svabhāvaḥ parameśvaraḥ | bhāvajātaṃ hi tasyaiva śaktir īśvaratāmayī

en:
## bod-p03 (3)
Power too from power-possessor-form difference does not desire; identity of these two is eternal, as fire and burning. // AgBpd_3
sa: śaktiś ca śaktimadrūpād vyatirekam na vāñchati | tādātmyam anayor nityaṃ vahnidāhikayor iva
sa eva bhairavo devo jagadbharaṇalakṣaṇaḥ | svātmādṛṣe samagraṃ hi yacchaktyā pratibimbitam
tasyaivaiṣā parā devī svarūpāmarśanotsukā | pūrṇatvaṃ sarvabhaveṣu yasyā nālpaṃ na cādhikam

en:
## bod-p06 (6)
This god by this goddess always play-joy-eager; varied creation-dissolution he does simultaneously, all-pervading. // AgBpd_6
sa: eṣa devo 'nayā devyā nityaṃ krīḍārasotsukaḥ | vicitrān sṛṣṭisaṃhārān vidhatte yugapad vibhuḥ
atidurghaṭakāritvam asyānuttaram eva yat | etad eva svatantratvam aisvaryaṃ bodharūpatā

en:
## bod-p08 (8)
Limited-light-ness of inert indeed is mark; from inert different is awareness since not measured. // AgBpd_8
sa: paricchinnaprakāśatvaṃ jaḍasya kila lakṣaṇam | jaḍād vilakṣaṇo bodho yato na parimīyate
evam asya svatantrasya nijaśaktyupabhedinaḥ | svātmagāḥ sṛṣṭisaṃhārāḥ svarūpatvena saṃsthitāḥ

en:
## bod-p10–p11 — variety and non-knowledge
In them variety extreme up-down across what; worlds, their parts, pleasure-pain-mind what. What of it non-knowledge — that its autonomy thus stated; it indeed saṃsāra of fools who is terrifying. Extreme variety in worlds, parts, and minds; non-knowledge of this autonomy is saṃsāra — the terrifying state of fools.
sa: teṣu vaicitryam atyantam ūrdhvādhas tiryag eva yat | bhuvanāni tadaṃśāś ca sukhaduḥkhamatiś ca yā

en:
## bod-p11 (11)
What of it non-knowledge — that its autonomy thus stated; it indeed saṃsāra of fools who is terrifying. // AgBpd_11
sa: yad etasyāparijñānaṃ tatsvātantryaṃ hi varṇitam | sa eva khalu saṃsāro mūḍānāṃ yo vibhīṣakaḥ

en:
## bod-p12–p14 — attainment, liberation, and non-difference
From that grace-sap or from teacher-scripture or from scripture of supreme Lord from which from which approached. What of reality full-knowledge — that is liberation from supreme Lord. That fullness of awakened, living-liberation that is remembered. These two bondage and liberation from supreme-Lord-nature. Not they differ; no difference indeed in truth in supreme Lord. Three paths to the reality (grace, teacher-scripture, Lord's script
sa: tatprasādarasād eva gurvāgamata eva vā | śāstrād vā parameśasya yasmāt kasmād upāgatam

en:
## bod-p13 (13)
What of reality full-knowledge — that is liberation from supreme Lord. That fullness of awakened, living-liberation that is remembered. // AgBpd_13
sa: yat tattvasya parijñānaṃ sa mokṣaḥ parameśataḥ | tat pūrṇatvaṃ prabuddhānāṃ jīvanmuktiś ca sā smṛtā
etau bandhavimokṣau ca parameśasvarūpataḥ | na bhidyete na bhedo hi tattvataḥ parameśvare
ittham icchākalājñānaśaktiśūlāmbujāśritaḥ | bhairavaḥ sarvabhāvānāṃ svabhāvaḥ pariśīlyate

citiḥ svatantrā viśvasya hetur ity abhidhīyate / svātantryarūpā jñātā ca siddhīr vā saṃprayacchate sā svabhittau svecchayaiva viśvasyonmīlanāya ca / nānānurūpavaicitryād grāhyagrāhakabhedataḥ viśvasya tasya vaicitryaṃ grāhyabhedena saṃsthitam / nānāvaicitryayogena cottamādhamasaṅkhyayā citisaṅkocanāc cittaṃ cetano 'pi maheśvaraḥ / vaṭadhanikāvat tatra viśvarūpaṃ ca tad viduḥ caitanyam ātmano rūpaṃ śuddham atyantanirmalam / tad eva niyamāsaktaṃ cittaṃ cid abhidhīyate arthonmukhatayā saṃvic citte

sadvimarśabalenaivaṃ nityaṃ yaḥ pariśīlate / sa muktaḥ sarvabandhebhyo nityānandamayo bhavet cidvahnir grasate so 'yaṃ suprabuddho 'sty asau yadā / tadāsau vimalo jñeyaś cidvahniḥ sarvabhakṣakaḥ etadbalena saṃyukto yogī nirvāṇalakṣaṇaḥ / padaṃ prāpnoti vimalaṃ so 'cirān nātra saṃśayaḥ cidvahnir balalābhe 'pi viśvam ābhāti cinmayam / svānandāmṛtakallolam etad ucchalitaṃ bahiḥ tad eva śyānatāṃ yātaṃ bhāvarūpair vibhāvyate / svātmā maheśvaro devaḥ krīḍate parameśvaraḥ iti yaḥ satataṃ vetti sa mukto

nirmalā suprabhā śuddhā nityānandamayī parā / nirdehacchedajālāpi jñānadṛṣṭir vijṛmbhate madhyadhāmavikāse tu upāyo balavatsthitiḥ / vikalpakṣayasaṅkocavikāsādyā anekaśaḥ akiñciccintanād eva vikalpānāṃ kṣayo bhavet / cidbodhād vilasacchaktī raktāsau bhāvamaṇḍale tatrānuraktā divyaughaṃ paśyate vimalātmakam / śaktisaṅkocam etad dhi procyate brahmavādibhiḥ ādyantakoṭiviśrāmabindunādalayās tathā / aśaṅkitabhayakrodhabībhatsādiparigrahāḥ ity etat kathitaṃ devi madhyadhāmavikāsakam / tatra śakto dina

tatrāsau vilasan yogī mantreśvarapade sthitaḥ / tatra śakto vibhur yadvat krīḍate śaktibṛṃhitaḥ evaṃ svatantratā tasya vyāpakasya jagadvibhoḥ / nānābhedajuṣaś citrapadasthitasyākhaṇḍitā etad advayam ity uktaṃ jñānāmṛtam anuttamam / yaḥ pibec chāmyate tasya saṃsāraviṣamūrchanam bodhollāsavidhāneyaṃ śivaprāpyai mahātmanām / rājñaḥ kṣemābhidhānasya śāstram atyantanirmalam

en:
In the heart, Kāma wakes to kill.

This — the separated beloved — arises.

By that cruel one who serves a foreign land, you will kill me — without him.

Release your foreign love today — or your wife: what more is there to say?

The cātaka, gasping, begs for rain — and nothing else.

The suffering traveler — she is your beloved.

By clouds the peacock-flock is sounded; what delight, beloved, without me today?

Thinned by cloud-arrival, she today; tormented by hard Kāma.

Drowned in sorrow-ocean'
sa: manmathe ca hṛdi hantum udyate proṣitapramadayedam udyate nirdayena paradeśasevinā māriṣyatha hi tena māṃ vinā anyadeśaratir adya mucyatāṃ sāthavā tava vadhūḥ kim ucyatām cātakaś ca tṛṣito 'mbu yācate duḥkhitā pathika sā priyā ca te ambudaiḥ śikhigaṇo vinādyate kā ratiḥ priya mayā vinādya te toyadāgamakṛśā ca sādya te durdhareṇa madanena sādyate śokasāgarajale ca pātitāṃ tvadguṇasmaraṇam eva pāti tām dravati ca kaluṣaṃ jalaṃ nadīnāṃ kim iti ca māṃ samavekṣase na dīnām gambhīramegharasitavyathitā

en:
For Kāma's sake, today the groves of abodes shine.

You are chief of groves by sprouts, eye-festival of youths.

Kuṭaja, why are you laughed at by flowers? I bow — hard to laugh at you.

Your flower-looked-at body — I would release it quickly, nīpa, body.

Having observed honey's season, the bee kisses the yūthikā creeper.

By waters scattered, dust on earth; sun and moon are not seen.

New-cloud-drunk, peacocks cry at cloud-arrival.

With Indra's weapon, the cloud today resounds, bringing the e
sa: madanasya kṛte niketanānāṃ pratibhānty adya vanāni ketanānām tvaṃ mañjarībhiḥ pravaro vanānāṃ netrotsavaś cāsi sayauvanānām kuṭaja kiṃ kusumair avahasyate praṇipatāmi ca duṣprahasya te tava puṣpanirīkṣitāpadehaṃ visṛjeyaṃ sahasaiva nīpa deham madhunaḥ samavekṣya kālatāṃ bhramaraś cumbati yūthikālatām salilair vihataṃ rajaḥ kṣitau ravicandrāv api nopalakṣitau navāmbumattāḥ śikhino nadanti meghāgame kundasamānadanti sendrayudhaś ca jalado 'dya rasann ibhānāṃ saṃrambham āvahati bhūdharasannibhānām

en:
Clouds thundering make travelers long; sorrow grows in those, endless.

They honor the love-festival with beloveds; cloud-arrival, dear friend, they bring.

May I be conquered by which poet, by yamakas, other; to him I pour water in ghaṭakarpara.

## isva-p07 — close
**SUMMARY.** Palāyate daivahatasya sanmaṇiḥ — flees, of god-struck, good gem. Bhāti vahnir niśīthe — shines, fire, at night.

**FUNCTION.** Closes with imagery.

## kram-p01–p05 — the hymn's purpose and the self's nature
This hymn is the course of great ease: in the midst of the host of sorrows, the rite of completion, the essence of great bliss flowing, this inauspicious day. Constantly, on the worshipper's conduct, reflecting, it reflects back; the mind, fear-gone, in the hymn. Examining own self, examining again the hymned conduct, the worshipper in hymn-practice without effort; the examined self, in all-knowable-moment, that thus in hymn I, here, alw
sa: ayaṃ duḥkhavrātavrataparigame pāraṇavidhir mahāsaukhyāsāraprasaraṇarase durdinam idam | yad anyanyakkṛtyā viṣamaviśikhaploṣaṇaguror vibhoḥ stotre śaśvat pratiphalati ceto gatabhayam
anāmṛṣṭaḥ svātmā na hi bhavati bhāvapramitibhāj anāmṛṣṭaḥ svātmety api hi na vinā 'marśanavidheḥ | śivaś cāsau svātmā sphurad akhilabhāvaikasarasas tato 'ham tvatstotre pravaṇahṛdayo nityasukhitaḥ
vicitrair jātyādibhramaṇaparipāṭīparikarair avāptam sārvajñaṃ hṛdaya yad ayatnena bhavatā | tad antas tvadbodhaprasarasaraṇībhūtamahasi sphuṭam vāci prāpya prakaṭaya vibhoḥ stotram adhunā

## kram-p04 (4)

jvaladrūpaṃ bhāsvatpacanam atha dāhaṃ prakaṭanam vimucyānyad vahneḥ kim api ghaṭate naiva hi vapuḥ | stuve saṃvidraśmīn yadi nijanijāṃs tena sa nuto bhaven nānyaḥ kaścid bhavati parameśasya vibhavaḥ
vicitrārambhatve galitaniyame yaḥ kila rasaḥ paricchedābhāvāt paramaparipūrṇatvam asamam | svayaṃ bhāsāṃ yogaḥ sakalabhavabhāvaikamayatāviruddhair dharmaughaiḥ paracitir anarghocitaguṇā

## kram-p09 (9)
By such forms, varada, varied your body shines; in own-portion this world, difference-gone, Lord's. That same this hymn-to, heart and speech-outer-instrument-bonds would be mine, constant, unabandoned-rush. // AgKs_9
sa: tavaivaikasyāntaḥ sphuritamahaso bodhajaladher vicitrormivrātaprasaraṇaraso yaḥ svarasataḥ | ta evāmī sṛṣṭisthitilayamayasphūrjitarucāṃ śaśāṅkārkāgnīnāṃ yugapad udayāpāyavibhavāḥ

Hence varied-varied-course-station-other-distinction-etc.-standing-thing-enjoying-power, Lord's power, always goes, no difference how. That in this ground (akula), Bhairava, your pada — that one-pointed become my heart-ground, Bhairava Lord. In measure, dissolved, Śiva-pada-shining-power-vaibhava-force, body-breath-and-rest limited-made-agentness-standing; when time-condition, dissolution-state approaches you — then goddess, which, shining,
sa: amuṣmāt saṃpūrnāt vata rasamahollāsasarasān nijāṃ śaktiṃ bhedaṃ gamayasi nijecchāprasarataḥ | anarghaṃ svātantryaṃ tava tadidam atyadbhutamayīṃ bhavacchaktiṃ stunvan vigalitabhayo 'haṃ śivamayaḥ

ṣaṭṣaṣṭinām eke varṣe navamyām asite 'hani | mayā 'bhinavaguptena mārgaśīrṣe stutaḥ śivaḥ

en: Whatever I have truly done, O Lord — no duty of mine goes beyond this: my pride, laid at Your lotus feet with devotion. This is my all; I know there is nothing other. So, casting all else aside — quickly, O protector of the helpless, O ocean of compassion — be pleased with me!
l3:
Whatever I have truly done, O Lord, is this one duty and nothing beyond: my pride, offered at Your lotus feet in devotion.
This is my all; nothing else do I know. Having cast all else aside — quickly, O protector of the helpless, ocean of compassion — be pleased.
sa: yatsatyaṃ tu mayā kṛtaṃ mama vibho kṛtyaṃ tu nātaḥ paraṃ yanmanmānamaiśapādakamale bhaktyā mayaivārpitam | sarvasvamata evametaditarannāsyeva jānāmyatastyaktvā kṣipramanāthanātha karuṇāsindho prasanno bhava

en: O Maheśa, at Your door let this charming speech of mine flash forth, exceeding all: 'Victory, victory to Maheśa!' — faultless, unceasing. Let this very speech, auspicious, be bliss-giving to me forever. O Lord, O giver of refuge, make me — whose protector is Maheśa — possessed of a protector!
l3:
O Maheśa — at Your door let my charming speech flash forth, faultless: ‘Victory, victory to Maheśa,’ unceasing.
Let this auspicious speech bring me bliss forever. O giver of refuge, make me — whose protector is Maheśa — protected, O Lord.
sa: maheśa tvaddvāri sphuratu rucirā vāgatitarāṃ mamaiṣā nirdoṣaṃ jaya jaya maheśeti satatam | śivā saiṣā vāṇī bhavatu śivadā mahyamaniśaṃ maheśanāthaṃ māṃ śaraṇada sanāthaṃ kuru vibho

en: You speak not, O best-limbed one; You look not upon me, wretched as I am. My entreaty, made in many ways, You hear not; You come not into my mind. Fallen into the pit amid transmigration's ocean, I am mostly left unsupported — yet scripture truly declares You devoid of speech, sight, hearing, feet and the like!
l3:
You speak not, O Fair-limbed; You look not on wretched me, hear not my oft-made plea, nor come into my mind.
Fallen into the pit mid-ocean of becoming, I go mostly unsupported — yet scripture truly declares You without speech, sight, hearing, feet, and the rest.
sa: brūṣe nottamāṅga paśyasi na māmetādṛśaṃ duḥkhitaṃ vijñaptiṃ bahudhā kṛtāṃ na śṛṇuṣe nāyāsi manmānase | saṃsārārṇavagartamadhyapatitaṃ prāyeṇa nālambase vākcakṣuḥśravaṇāṅghriṇādirahitaṃ tvāmāha satyaṃ śrutiḥ

en: From the guru's word — by the force that wipes away the fabric of heaped-up reasonings — and from the assurance told, fittingly, out of regard for scripture: when the cloud of doubt has dissolved, let me touch the feet of the Lord, whose splendor shines in the sky of the heart — like the sun, the conqueror of darkness.
l3:
By the guru’s word — whose force wipes clean the heaped fabric of reasonings — and by assurance fittingly told regarding scripture:
when the doubt-cloud melts, let me touch the feet of the Lord, whose splendor blazes in the heart’s sky like the sun that conquers darkness.
sa: gurorvākyādyukti-pracaya-racana-unmārjana-vaśātsamāśvāsācchāstraṃ prati samucitādapi kathitam | vilīne śaṅkābhre hṛdayagaganodbhāsimahasaḥ prabhoḥ sūryasyeva spṛśatu caraṇān dhvāntajayinaḥ

en: Much time dwelling with You has passed — alas, in this very moment! What, what has not been done by You for me, for the sake of serving the excellent guru! Again and again I, whose body has attained the incomparable divine plane — yet indeed I forget You. Therefore, by You, let there be no further staying-away!
l3:
Much time with You has passed — alas, in this very moment! What has not been done by You for me, for the sake of serving the excellent guru!
Again and again, I — whose body has reached the peerless divine plane — yet I forget You. So by You let there be no more staying away.
sa: yātastvatsahavāsato bahutaraḥ kālo vatāsmin kṣaṇe kiṃ kiṃ vā na kṛtaṃ tvayā varagurūpāsānimittena me | vāraṃ vāramahaṃ punarnirupamāṃ divyaṃ bhuvaṃ prāsuvatkāyastvāṃ kila vismarāmi yadataḥ stheyaṃ na bhūyastvayā

en: Distinct from the illumination of sun, moon, lamp and the rest, it does not shine — on account of over-pervasion; and hence: of the nature of light, just this much — illumined-illuminator named is mere convention.
l3:
Unlike the light of sun, moon, lamp — it does not shine, pervading too completely. Hence:
of light-nature itself — ‘His illumined-and-illuminator’ is a mere transacting name.
sa: arkendudīpādyavabhāsabhinnaṃ nābhātyativyāptatayā tataśca | prakāśarūpaṃ tadiyatprakāśyaprakāśatākhyā vyavahāra eva

en: No thing at all is dually distinct from knowledge; made of this and that, in consciousness there is no difference. From self-luminosity, hundredfold, in the one abode — the individual would not indeed be divided.
l3:
Nothing at all stands dually apart from knowledge; made of this and that, in consciousness there is no split.
From self-luminosity, a hundredfold, in the one abode — the individual would never be divided.
sa: jñānadvibhinno na hi kaścidarthaḥ tattatkṛtaḥ saṃvidi nāsti bhedaḥ | svayamprakāśācchatam aikadhāmni prātisvikī nāpi vibheditā syāt

en: Thus — dense own-consciousness, one indeed: he is Śiva, the universe's supreme light. There too, indeed, shines, in variegated power: apprehended-apprehender-division-difference.
l3:
Thus — dense self-consciousness, one alone: He is Śiva, the universe’s supreme light.
And there too, in variegated power, shines the split of grasped and grasper.
sa: itthaṃ svasaṃvidghana eka eva śivaḥ sa viśvasya paraḥ prakāśaḥ | tatrāpi bhātyeva vicitraśaktau grāhyagṛhītṛpravibhāgabhedaḥ

en: That difference, and this — not different thence: of the free, most-perfectly-clear one-abode. Palace, elephant, horse, cloud, ocean, mountain and the rest — just as of jewel-mirror and the like.
l3:
That split — and this one — is not cut off from it: from the free, the flawlessly clear, the single abode.
Palace, elephant, horse, cloud, ocean, mountain, and the rest — just as with jewel, mirror, and the like.
sa: bhedaḥ sa cāyaṃ na tato vibhinnaḥ svacchandasusvacchatamaikadhāmnaḥ | prāsādahastyaśvapayodasindhugiryādi yadvanmaṇidarpaṇādeḥ

en: If, in a mirror's belly, the reflection-making with-prototype would be mind-proven — then in the interior of the mirror of free consciousness, among things there is no other cause besides.
l3:
If, in a mirror’s belly, a reflection — image-making, with its original — were proved by mind alone —
then, within the mirror of free consciousness, things have no other cause at all.
sa: ādarśakukṣau pratibimbakāri sabimbakaṃ syād yadi mānasiddham | svacchandasaṃvinmukhuraantarāle bhāveṣu hetvantaram asti nānyat

en: O consciousness-dense one — therefore you indeed are supreme; in you indeed the universes shine at once. And they flash forth by the power of your glory; you indeed are also their supreme-Lord maker.
l3:
O dense consciousness — therefore You alone are supreme; in You alone the worlds shine all at once.
And they flash by Your glory’s power — and You alone are their maker, the supreme Lord.
sa: saṃvidghanas tena parastvam eva tvayyeva viśvāni cakāsati drāk | sphuranti ca tvanmahasaḥ prabhāvāt tvam eva caiṣāṃ parameśakartā

en: Thus — self-consciousness, primordially established, unaccomplishable; the self, non-lord, lord; whose place and time are full of own power — eternal, pervasive: Bhairava-Lord, I praise.
l3:
Thus — self-consciousness, established from the first, never to be effected; the self, no lord and yet lord;
whose place and time are full of its own power — eternal, pervasive: Bhairava, Lord, I praise.
sa: itthaṃ svasaṃvedanam ādisiddham asādhyam ātmānam anīśam īśam | svaśaktisaṃpūrṇavadeśakālaṃ nityaṃ vibhuṃ bhairavanātham īḍe

en: This septad of good conduct — dissolved other thoughts — those desiring the ultimate rightly remember in the heart. Those, O Bhairava's one, again enter the supreme abode, and know the ultimate-thing-discussion of the three worlds.
l3:
This sevenfold good conduct — those whose other thoughts have melted, who long for the ultimate, rightly remember in the heart.
And they — O Bhairava’s own — enter the supreme abode again and again, and know the ultimate discourse of the three worlds.
sa: sadvṛttasaptakam idaṃ galitānyacintāḥ samyak smaranti hṛdaye paramārthakāmāḥ | te bhairavīya paradhāma muhur viśanti jānanti ca trijagatīparamārthacarcām

garbhādhivāsapūrvakamaraṇāntakaduḥkhacakravibhrāntaḥ | ādhāram bhagavantaṃ śiṣyaḥ papraccha paramārtham ādhārakārikābhiḥ taṃ gurur abhibhāṣati sma tatsāram | kathayaty abhinavaguptaḥ śivaśāsanadṛṣṭiyogena nijaśaktivaibhavabharād a.ṅdacatuṣṭayam idaṃ vibhāgena | śaktir māyā prakṛtiḥ pṛthvī ceti prabhāvitaṃ prabhuṇā tatrāntar viśvam idaṃ vicitratanukaraṇabhuvanasaṃtānam | bhoktā ca tatra dehī śiva eva gṛhītapaśubhāvaḥ nānāvidhavarṇānāṃ rūpaṃ dhatte yathāmalaḥ sphaṭikaḥ | suramānuṣapaśupādaparūpatv

sarvavikalpavihīnaṃ śuddhaṃ śāntaṃ layodayavihīnam | yat paratattvaṃ tasmin vibhāti ṣaṭṭriṃśadātma jagat darpaṇabimbe yadvan nagaragrāmādicitram avibhāgi | bhāti vibhāgenaiva ca parasparaṃ darpaṇād api ca vimalatamaparamabhairavabodhāt tadvad vibhāgaśūnyam api | anyonyaṃ ca tato 'pi ca vibhaktam ābhāti jagad etat śivaśaktisadāśivatām īśvaravidyāmayīṃ ca tattvadaśām | śaktīnāṃ pañcānāṃ vibhaktabhāvena bhāsayati paramaṃ yat svātantryaṃ durghaṭasaṃpādanaṃ maheśasya | devī māyāśaktiḥ svātmāvaraṇaṃ ś

śrotraṃ tvagakṣirasanā ghrāṇaṃ buddhīndriyāṇi śabdādau | vākpāṇipādapāyūpasthaṃ karmendriyāṇi punaḥ eṣāṃ grāhyo viṣayaḥ sūkṣmaḥ pravibhāgavarjito yaḥ syāt | tanmātrapañcakaṃ tat śabdaḥ sparśo maho raso gandhaḥ etatsaṃsargavaśāt sthūlo viṣayas tu bhūtapañcakatām | abhyeti nabhaḥ pavanas tejaḥ salilaṃ ca pṛthvī ca tuṣa iva ta.ṅdulakaṇikām āvṛṇute prakṛtipūrvakaḥ sargaḥ | pṛthvīparyanto 'yaṃ caitanyaṃ dehabhāvena param āvaraṇaṃ mala iha sūkṣmaṃ māyādikañcukaṃ sthūlam | bāhyaṃ vigraharūpaṃ kośatraya

tadvad dharmādharmasvarnirayotpattimaraṇasukhaduḥkham | varṇāśramādi cātmany asad api vibhramabalād bhavati etat tad andhakāraṃ yad bhāveṣu prakāśamānatayā | ātmānatirikteṣv api bhavaty anātmābhimāno 'yam timirād api timiram idaṃ ga.ṅdasyopari mahān ayaṃ sphoṭaḥ | yad anātmany api dehaprāṇadāv ātmamānitvam dehaprāṇavimarśanadhījñānanabhaḥprapañcayogena | ātmānam veṣṭayate citraṃ jālena jālakāra iva svajñānavibhavabhāsanayogenodveṣṭayen nijātmānam | iti bandhamokṣacitrāṃ krīḍāṃ pratanoti paramaśi

śānte śānta ivāyaṃ hṛṣṭe hṛṣṭo vimohavati mūḍhaḥ | tattvagaṇe sati bhagavān na punaḥ paramārthataḥ sa tathā yad anātmany api tadrūpāvabhāsanaṃ tat purā nirākṛtya | ātmany anātmarūpāṃ bhrāntiṃ vidalayati paramātmā itthaṃ vibhramayugalakasamūlavicchedane kṛtārthasya | kartavyāntarakalanā na jātu parayogino bhavati pṛthivī prakṛtir māyā tritayam idaṃ vedyarūpatāpatitam | advaitabhāvanabalād bhavati hi sanmātrapariśeṣam raśanāku.ṅdalakaṭakaṃ bhedatyāgena dṛśyate yathā hema | tadvad bhedatyāge sanmāt

iti śakticakrayantraṃ krīḍāyogena vāhayan devaḥ | aham eva śuddharūpaḥ śaktimahācakranāyakapadasthaḥ mayy eva bhāti viśvaṃ darpaṇa iva nirmale ghatādīni | mattaḥ prasarati sarvaṃ svapnavicitratvam iva suptāt aham eva viśvarūpaḥ karacaranādisvabhāva iva dehaḥ | sarvasmin aham eva sphurāmi bhāveṣu bhāsvarūpam iva draṣṭā śrotā ghrātā dehendriyavarjito 'py akartāpi | siddhāntāgamatarkāṃś citrān aham eva racayāmi itthaṃ dvaitavikalpe galite pravilaṅghya mohinīṃ māyām | salile salilaṃ kṣīre kṣīram iva

jñānaprāptau kṛtam api na phalāya tato 'sya janma katham | gatajanmabandhayogo bhāti śivārkaḥ svadīdhitibhiḥ tuṣakambukakiṃśārukamuktaṃ bījaṃ yathāṅkuraṃ kurute | naiva tathāṇavamāyākarmavimukto bhavāṅkuraṃ hy ātmā ātmajño na kutaścana bibheti sarvaṃ hi tasya nijarūpam | naiva ca śocati yasmāt paramārthe nāśitā nāsti atigūḍhahṛdayagañjaprarūḍhaparamārtharatnasaṃcayataḥ | aham eveti maheśvarabhāve kā durgatiḥ kasya mokṣasya naiva kiṃcid dhāmāsti na cāpi gamanam anyatra | ajñānagranthibhidā svaśak

dikkālakalanavikalaṃ dhruvam avyayam īśvaraṃ suparipūrṇam | bahutaraśaktivrātapralayodayaviracanaikakartāram sṛṣṭyādividhisuvedhasam ātmānaṃ śivamayaṃ vibudhyeta | katham iva saṃsārī syād vitatasya kutaḥ kva vā saraṇam iti yuktibhir api siddhaṃ yatkarma jñānino na saphalaṃ tat | na mamedam api tu tasyeti dārḍhyato na hi phalaṃ loke itthaṃ sakalavikalpān pratibuddho bhāvanāsamīraṇataḥ | ātmajyotiṣi dīpte juhvaj jyotirmayo bhavati aśnan yad vā tad vā saṃvīto yena kenacic chāntaḥ | yatra kvacana ni

ṣaṭtriṃśattattvabhṛtaṃ vigraharacanāgavākṣaparipūrṇam | nijam anyad atha śarīraṃ ghaṭādi vā tasya devagṛham tatra ca paramātmamahābhairavaśivadevatāṃ svaśaktiyutām | ātmāmarśanavimaladravyaiḥ paripūjayann āste bahirantaraparikalpanabhedamahābījanicayam arpayataḥ | tasyātidīptasaṃvijjvalane yatnād vinā bhavati homaḥ dhyānam anastamitaṃ punar eṣa hi bhagavān vicitrarūpāṇi | sṛjati tad eva dhyānaṃ saṃkalpālikhitasatyarūpatvam bhuvanāvalīṃ samastāṃ tattvakramakalpanām athākṣagaṇam | antarbodhe pariv

tīrthe śvapacagṛhe vā naṣṭasmṛtir api parityajan deham | jñānasamakālamuktaḥ kaivalyaṃ yāti hataśokaḥ puṇyāya tīrthasevā nirayāya śvapacasadananidhanagatiḥ | puṇyāpuṇyakalaṅkasparśābhāve tu kiṃ tena tuṣakambukasupṛthakkṛtata.ṅdulakaṇatuṣadalāntarakṣepaḥ | ta.ṅdulakaṇasya kurute na punas tadrūpatādātmyam tadvat kañcukapaṭalīpṛthakkṛtā saṃvid atra saṃskārāt | tiṣṭhanty api muktātmā tatsparśavivarjitā bhavati kuśalatamaśilpikalpitavimalībhāvaḥ samudgakopādheḥ | malino 'pi maṇir upādher vicchede sva

svargamayo nirayamayas tad ayaṃ dehāntarālagaḥ puruṣaḥ | tadbhaṅge svaucityād dehāntarayogam abhyeti evaṃ jñānāvasare svātmā sakṛd asya yādṛg avabhātaḥ | tādṛśa eva tadāsau na dehapāte 'nyathā bhavati karaṇagaṇasaṃpramoṣaḥ smṛtināśaḥ śvāsakalilatā cchedaḥ | marmasu rujāviśeṣāḥ śarīrasaṃskārajo bhogaḥ sa kathaṃ vigrahayoge sati na bhavet tena mohayoge 'pi | maraṇāvasare jñāni na cyavate svātmaparamārthāt paramārthamārgam enaṃ jhaṭiti yadā gurumukhāt samabhyeti | atitīvraśaktipātāt tadaiva nirvigh

viṣayeṣu sārvabhaumaḥ sarvajanaiḥ pūjyate yathā rājā | bhuvaneṣu sarvadaivair yogabhraṣṭas tathā pūjyaḥ mahatā kālena punar mānuṣyaṃ prāpya yogam abhyasya | prāpnoti divyam amṛtam yasmād āvartate na punaḥ tasmāt sanmārge 'smin nirato yaḥ kaścid eti sa śivatvam | iti matvā paramārthe yathā tathāpi prayatanīyam idam abhinavaguptoditasaṃkṣepaṃ dhyāyataḥ paraṃ brahma | acirād eva śivatvaṃ nijahṛdayāveśam abhyeti āryāśatena tad idaṃ saṃkṣiptaṃ śāstrasāram atigūḍham | abhinavaguptena mayā śivacaraṇasm

etad guhyaṃ mahāguhyaṃ kathayasva mama prabho | hṛdayasthā tu yā śaktiḥ kaulinī kulanāyikā tām me kathaya deveśa yena tṛptiṃ vrajāmy aham | śrībhairava uvāca | śṛṇu devi mahābhage uttarasyāpy anuttaram kathayāmi na saṃdehaḥ sadyaḥ kaulikasiddhidam | kauliko 'yaṃ vidhir devi mama hṛdvyomny avasthitaḥ athādyās tithayaḥ sarve svarā bindvavasānakāḥ | tadantaḥ kālayogena somasūryau prakīrtitau pṛthivyādīni tattvāni puruṣāntāni pañcasu | kramāt kādiṣu vargeṣu makārānteṣu suvrate vāyvagnisalilendrāṇāṃ

asyoccāre kṛte samyaṅ mantramudrāgaṇo mahān | sadyaḥ sanmukhatām eti svadehāveśalakṣaṇam muhūrtaṃ smarate yas tu cumbake nābhimudritaḥ | sa badhnāti tadā dehaṃ mantramudrāgaṇaṃ naraḥ atītānāgatānarthān pṛṣṭo 'sau kathayaty api | praharād yad abhipretaṃ devatārūpam uccaran sakṣāt paśyaty asaṃdigdham ākṛṣṭaṃ rudrasaktibhiḥ | praharadvayamātreṇa vyomastho jāyate smaran trayeṇa mātaraḥ sarvā yogesvaryo mahābalāḥ | vīrā vīresvarāḥ siddhā balavān śākinīgaṇaḥ āgatya samayaṃ dattvā bhairaveṇa pracoditāḥ

anena jñātamātreṇa jñāyate sarvaśaktibhiḥ | śākinīkulasāmānyo bhaved yogaṃ vināpi hi avidhijño vidhānajño jāyate yajanaṃ prati | kālāgnim āditaḥ kṛtvā māyāntam brahmadehagam śivo viśvadyanantāntaḥ paraṃ śaktitrayaṃ matam | tadantar varti yatkiṃcic chuddhamārge vyavasthitam aṇur viśuddham acirād aisvaraṃ jñānam aśnute | taccodakaḥ śivo jñeyaḥ sarvajñaḥ parameśvaraḥ sarvago nirmalaḥ svacchas tṛptaḥ svāyatanaḥ śuciḥ | yathā nyagrodhabījasthaḥ śaktirūpo mahādrumaḥ tathā hṛdayabījasthaṃ jagad etac ca

puṣpādikaṃ kramāt sarvaṃ liṅgaṃ vā stha.ṅdilaṃ ca vā | caturdaśābhijaptena puṣpeṇāsanakalpanā tatra sṛṣṭiṃ yajed vīraḥ punar evāsanaṃ tataḥ | sṛṣṭiṃ tu sampuṭīkṛtya paścād yajanam ārabhet sarvatattvasusampūrṇām sarvāvayavaśobhitām | yajed devīṃ mahābhāgā saptaviṃśatimantritām tataḥ sugandhipuṣpaiś ca yathāśaktyā samarcayet | pūjayet parayā bhaktyā svātmanaṃ ca nivedayet evaṃ yajanam ākhyātam agnikārye 'py ayaṃ vidhiḥ | kṛtapūjāvidhiḥ samyak smaran bījam prasiddhyati ādyantarahitam bījaṃ vikasat

śrī gaṇapataye namaḥ | ādyantāntargatānantaśaktiviśrāntinirbharām | anuccāryām ahaṃ vācam adhīye hṛdayaṃ vibhoḥ sa eva bhairavo devas sarve devāś ca yanmayāḥ | saivāsau bhairavī sattāsattāpi ca yanmayī tad eva bhairavaṃ jñānam ajñānam api yanmayam | sa hi bhairavasiddhāntaḥ pūrvapakṣo 'pi yanmayaḥ aikadhyam adhvanāṃ ṣa.ṅnāṃ yatra sā bhairavī sthitiḥ | paryante sarvatantrāṇām avācyā paramā gatiḥ sā cidānandamātrātmamagnecchājñānasatkriyā | hṛdayaṃ devadevasya bhairavasyāvibhāgabhūḥ citsvābhāvyād

kramo yo deśakālātmā bhedaprāṇas sa saṃvidām | vicchedād eṣa vijñātur vicitrābhāsatākṛtaḥ ubhayo tatra vai rītiḥ śuddhāśuddhātmabhedataḥ | śuddhir bahiṣkṛtārthānāṃ svāhantāyāṃ nimajjanam aśuddhir api magnānāṃ naivaṃ hṛdayaviśramaḥ | atrāntare 'py anantās syuḥ sthitayas tāratamyataḥ ucitocitameyānāṃ pramātṝṇāṃ prakāśane | sādhāraṇānyathābhāvau bhidyete mātṛmeyayoḥ avikalpasphuṭābhāsā sā sṛṣṭiḥ śāmbhavī matā | abhedenātmanirmāṇe svātmaiva karaṇīkṛtaḥ kriyājñānātmacicchaktir bhedāsūtraṇakāraṇāt | k

karmabuddhyakṣatāṃ prāptā tadāsau paśur ucyate | itīcchayā sa bhagavān bhairavaḥ parimīyate mitavṛttis satī sā ca śaktis tam anuvartate | tasya vidyeśasādākhyaśivatās saṃkucatsthiteḥ | dehaprāṇabuddhiśūnyapramātṛtvam upāgaman tasyāsādhāraṇī sṛṣṭis tattannānāvikalpanā | śaivasargotthasaṃskārasaṃskṛtasya tadāśrayā pramātaivāyam etāvatprakāro 'vagrahotsave | avyagro vartate svātmany avikalpe cidātmake vatsa paśya tvam evaitat advayatvena saṃvidaḥ | viditaṃ tanmayaṃ viśvam anyat tuccham asad yataḥ k

anantaitāvadākārasvīkāre 'py ekalakṣaṇām | tāṃ svasaṃvidam āviśya vikalpān na vikalpayet khecaryādicatussrotovāhapūrṇamahāhradām | vyomeśvarīm ātmacitiṃ vigāhya broḍayej jaḍam sargasthāpanasaṃhāranigrahānugrahakramāt | pañcakṛtyāni kurvāṇaḥ śivo 'ham iti viśvaset kṣepajñānaprasaṃkhyā[naga]tinādakrameṇa vā | guruvaktreṇa tāny ātmany ākalayya kṛtī bhavet vikalpayitvā viśvātmā bhairavo 'haṃ mamaiva tāḥ | viśvabhaṅgyo yathā vahner jvālābhaṅgyaḥ prabhā raveḥ eko 'haṃ mātṛvijñānamānameyaprakāravān | ś

antaḥkārabahiṣkārāv akālakramam ātmanaḥ | aparādhīnam ādhatse yat tvaṃ prābhavanirbharaḥ anuttaravisargātmaviśramodayayāmalam | saṃghaṭṭaś śivaśaktyos tadantare cānyaśaktayaḥ ānandeccheśanonmeṣā ūnatā ceśanecchayoḥ | asphuṭasphuṭabhedena vedyollāsas tayor vidaḥ ānandānuttarābhyāṃ ca sandhībhāvo 'tha vedanā | vedyānāṃ prāṇabhūteti pūrṇaṃ tad bhairavaṃ vapuḥ vedyollāso 'yam icchāyām īśane caikataḥ sthitaḥ | sthūlatvena pṛthivyādibhūtapañcakatām iyāt sūkṣmatvena ca gandhādipañcatanmātratāṃ tataḥ |

abhūvann iṣyasaṃyogād dvirūpād ubhayātmanaḥ | icchāsvarūpād unmeṣād anyathānuttarāyutāt catasraś śaktyo 'ntaḥsthāḥ puṃso 'syāntaś ca dhārikāḥ | cidvyomno jaḍabhūmeś ca māyāmayyas triśaṅkuvat icchāśaktes trirūpāyās tisro 'nyāś śaktyo 'bhavan | visargo 'yam athātyarthaṃ sphuṭo 'bhūt sṛjyavistarāt etat sṛṣṭvātmaśaktīnām itaretaramiśrāt | bhavet kṣobhāntaraṃ nāsmād visargād bāhyato bhavet iyatsarvaṃ sad icchādidvārānuttarabhairave | viśramya viśramya muhus tata eva visṛjyate antarnilīnānantārthasvāt

bheditāntaḥkṛtākha.ṅdabhāvāvekṣā parāparā | kartṛtā saiva paśyantī tasyaiveśadaśāśrayā || 43 madhyamā sakramā sthūlā antaḥkaraṇavartinī | vikalpanābhinnavācyā prāṇavṛttivibheditā svavāsanātādavasthyād daśayoḥ pūrvayor api | māyāmātur mitatvaṃ syāt paśyantyāś ca kramo hy aṇuḥ tayor āviśya daśayoḥ kramāc chāntavikalpayoḥ | dhanyas svasaṃvidvistāraṃ sāścaryam anupaśyati sā sthānakaraṇāghātapuṃvyāpārātmikā satī | vaikharī vṛttayo yasyāstā imāḥ śrutigocarāḥ ābhiḥ parasparaṃ jñānasaṃkrāntyātmā sa lauk
ādyantāntargatānantavācyavācakanirbharam | rahasyaṃ mantramudrāṇāṃ prapadye 'nuttaraṃ mahaḥ śambhor abhinnahṛdayā jayanti guravaḥ purā | nirvyutthānasamādhānaprāptaparyantasaṃpadaḥ
citiḥ svatantrā viśvasiddhihetuḥ | svecchayā svabhittau viśvam unmīlayati | tan nānā anurūpagrāhyagrāhakabhedāt | citisaṃkocātmā cetano 'pi saṃkucitaviśvamayaḥ | cittam
tanmayo māyāpramātā | saptapañcakasvabhāvaḥ | tadbhūmikāḥ sarvadarśanasthitayaḥ | cidvat tac chaktisaṃkocāt malāvṛtaḥ saṃsārī | tathāpi tadvat pañcakṛtyāni karoti
tāni | saṃsāritvam | cetanapadādhyārohāt citiḥ | meyendhanaṃ pluṣyati | balalābhe viśvam ātmasātkaroti
cidaikātmyapratipattidārḍhyaṃ jīvanmuktiḥ | madhyavikāsāc cidānandalābhaḥ | iha upāyāḥ | cidaikyāmarśān nityoditasamādhilābhaḥ | bhavatīti śivam

yena vijñātamātreṇa khecarīsamatāṃ brajet hṛdayasthā tu yā śaktiḥ kaulikī kulanāyikā śṛṇu devi mahābhāge uttarasyāpyanuttaram kathayāmi sureśāni sadyaḥ kaulikasiddhidam tadantaḥ kālayogena somasūryau prakīrtitau kramāt kādiṣu varṇeṣu makārānteṣu suvrate tadūrdhvaṃ śādi vikhyātaṃ purastādbrahmapañcakam ghanībhāvo'parāvākvapuṣi tiṣṭhan vaikharīrūpaṃ sphuṭī bhavati caturdaśayutaṃ bhadre tithīśāntasamanvitam

etannāyoginījāto nārudro labhate sphuṭam asyoccāre kṛte samyaṅmantramudrāgaṇo mahān muhūrta smarate yastu cummakenābhimudritaḥ atītānāgatānarthān pṛṣṭo'sau kathayatyapi sākṣātpaśyatyasaṃdigdhamākṛṣṭaṃ rudraśaktibhiḥ trayeṇa mātaraḥ sarvā yogeśvaryo mahābalāḥ āgatya samayaṃ labdhvā bhairaveṇa pracoditāḥ anena siddhāḥ setsyanti sādhayanti ca mantriṇaḥ adṛṣṭamaṇḍalo'pyevaṃ yaḥ kiñcidvetti tattvataḥ

anena jñātamatreṇa jñāyate sarvaśaktibhiḥ avidhijño vidhānajño jāyate yajanaṃ prati śivo viśvādyanantāntaḥ paraṃ śaktitrayaṃ matam aṇurviśuddhamacirādaiśvaraṃ jñānamaśnute sarvago nirmalaḥ svacchastṛptaḥ svāyatanaḥ śuciḥ tathā hṛdayabījasthaṃ jagadetaccarācaram dīkṣā bhavatyasaṃdigdhā tilājyāhutivarjitā nyāsaṃ kṛtvā śikhāṃ baddhvā saptaviṃśatimantritām tālatrayaṃ purā datvā saśabdaṃ vighnaśāntaye

puṣpādikaṃ kramāt sarvaṃ liṅge vā sthaṇḍile'thavā tataḥ sṛṣṭiṃ yajedvīraḥ punarevāsanaṃ tataḥ sarvatattvasusaṃpūrṇā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām tataḥ sugandhipuṣpaistu yathāśaktyā samarcayet evaṃ yajanamākhyātamagnikārye'pyayaṃ vidhiḥ ādyantarahitaṃ bījaṃ vikasattithimadhyagam yānyān kāmayate kāmāṃstāṃstāṃ śīghramavāpnuyāt evaṃ mantraphalāvāptirityetadrudrayāmalam

utthāpanaṃ bodhanaṃ ca cakraviśrāmameva ca viśrāmaḥ pariṇāmaśca tathāgamanameva ca sarveṣu trikaśāstreṣu sūcitaṃ śambhunā svayam tanmadhye kandanāmā ca cakrasthānamiti smṛtam samyag vāyugatiṃ jitvā yāvan madhyagatāṃ nayet śṛṅgāṭakanibhaṃ cakraṃ ṣaḍaraṃ cāparaṃ dhruvam etadrūpaṃ samākhyātaṃ tṛtīyaṃ cintanātmakam tyaktaruddho yadā vāyustadā lakṣaṃ vinirdiśet adhaūrdhve rekhāsaṃyuktā bhujaṃgakuṭilākṛtiḥ satyaṃ virājamānā sā sahasrārkasamaprabhā

etal lakṣaṇam uddiṣṭam utthāpanam ataḥ param prabuddhāṃ cintayecchaktiṃ daṇḍavat parameśvarīm utthāpanaṃ samākhyātaṃ bodhanaṃ paratastathā kaṇṭhasthamacyutaṃ sākṣādrudraṃ tālutale sthitam bodhayitvā vrajed āśu padaṃ cānāśritaṃ śivam svābhāvikaṃ dalaṃ dīptaṃ dravaṃ sthiranabhopamam bindunādaṃ tathā proktaṃ cakradvādaśakaṃ kila viśramet sā mahādevī cakraviśrāma uttamaḥ śiraśca bhramate tasya dṛṣṭisaṃkrāntilakṣaṇam ghūrṇate hṛdayaṃ cāsya samyagvidyāprabhāvataḥ

teṣu teṣu na bhetavyaṃ krīḍati parameśvarī malatrayavikārau bahujanmasu yatkṛtam bhūmikāgamanaṃ proktam antāvasthā tathocyate granthisphoṭaḥ sparśadivyapraharṣo binduspandā nābhikandāt sphuranti nābhicakraviniryātā yadā śaktiḥ prabudhyate yadā sā paramā śaktiḥ sulīnā parame pade śive viśrāmyate śaktistadā viśrāma ucyate tadātmā paramātmatve jñātavyo niścitātmabhiḥ sadā sa varṣate divyam amṛtaṃ jantujīvanam tadā tv āgamanaṃ proktamevaṃ samyak trayodaśa

bhāvabhedādisaṃbandhamayena [kha. bhedātmeti pāṭhaḥ |] vapuṣonmiṣan | jayatyeko'pi viśvātmā prakāśaḥ parameśvaraḥ iha bhāvānāṃ saṃbandho vicāryate, - kastāvatsaṃbandhaśabdārthaḥ saṃsargaḥ saṃparkaḥ saṃśleṣaḥ saṃbandha ityapyukte na vivṛtaḥ saṃbandhārthaḥ pratīyate | kiṃ nairantaryaṃ saṃśleṣa utānyatkiṃcit | nairantaryaṃ cet dūrasthayoḥ pitāputrayoḥ sa na syāt, ayaḥ - śalākayoḥ saṃnikṛṣṭayorvibhudravyayorapi ca syāt | atha dviṣṭhaḥ (p. 2) padārthaḥ kaścitsaṃbandhaḥ | tatrāpi dviṣṭhataiva saṃbandh

vyāpāro'nena ruddho'sau na vikalpāntaraṃ spṛśet | vikalpāntarasaṃsparśe mātṛbhedaprasaṅgataḥ tadekāmarśavartyekaśabdādhyāsavaśādbrajet | aneko'pyekatāmartho yathā ghaṭapaṭāviti (p. 13) ityasti tāvadanyaśca viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyayoḥ | saṃbandha upakārārthaḥ sa jñātumupayujyate bahutve'pi bhaveddvitvaṃ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyayoḥ | dvivimarśabhuvo yadvadrājño'śvarathapattayaḥ vimarśo rājña ityekaḥ svasāmānyonmukhaḥ paraḥ | svāmisāmānyasaṃbandhasahaḥ puruṣa ityayam rājñaḥ puruṣa ityeṣa paścātsaṃbandhagocaraḥ | kal

iti saṃbandhagatyuktā māyīyajñātṛniṣṭhitāḥ | dhiyo vibhinnārthadṛśo vyavahārapravartikāḥ na paraṃ tāstathā bhrāntāḥ sarvā api pratikṣaṇāt | svasaṃvitsaṃjñakānantacidvimarśapratiṣṭhitāḥ (p. 15) uktaḥ svasaṃvitsiddho'yaṃ nirbādha upayogavān | saṃbandhaḥ pratyabhijñāyāṃ pūrṇaḥ parikaraḥ punaḥ

en: Of one who neither meditates nor chants, manifestation may come without any preparatory rule. Just so — O light of Śiva — we bow to him who possesses devotion.
l3:
He neither sits in thought nor tells a bead — yet may it dawn for him, with no rule first.
Just so, just so — O Śiva's light — we bow to him who loves.
sa: na dhyāyato na japataḥ syād yasyāvidhipūrvakam evam eva śivabhāsas taṃ numo bhaktiśālinam

en: My self stays young, drinking the nectar of Your devotion — though greyed as if with the dust of worldly journeying and its passions.
l3:
My self stays young, drinking Your love's nectar —
greyed as if with road-dust, dust that is passion.
sa: ātmā mama bhavadbhaktisudhāpānayuvāpi san lokayātrārajorāgāt palitair iva dhūsaraḥ

en: For those who have gained that wealth — the possessors of devotion dwelling in Your city — even movement along worldly paths happens by that very expansion.
l3:
For those who've won that wealth — lovers homed in Your city —
may even their world-road walking be that same unfolding.
sa: labdhatatsaṃpadāṃ bhaktimatāṃ tvatpuravāsinām saṃcāro lokamārge 'pi syāt tayaiva vijṛmbhayā

en: Lord — where the whole world within worlds directly consists of You, what is not the devotee's field, and whose mantra does not succeed?
l3:
Lord — where world within world stands bare-faced You,
what is not the lover's ground? where does his prayer fail?
sa: sākṣādbhavanmaye nātha sarvasmin bhuvanāntare kiṃ na bhaktimatāṃ kṣetram mantraḥ kvaiṣām na siddhyati

en: Victory to those intoxicated with the finest wine of devotion's nectar-essence! Though non-dual, they are ever Your second, O Lord.
l3:
They win — the drunk, high on love's nectar-wine!
Second to none, yet never without You beside them, Lord.
sa: jayanti bhaktipīyūṣarasāsavavaronmadāḥ advitīyā api sadā tvaddvitīyā api prabho

en: Lord of the ocean of endless bliss — only they know Your truth who are densely drenched in blissful devotion's nectar.
l3:
Lord of the endless-bliss sea — Your truth is known by just such ones:
the flooded, thick-drenched in love's bliss-nectar.
sa: anantānandasindhos te nātha tattvaṃ vidanti te tādṛśa eva ye sāndrabhaktyānandarasāplutāḥ

en: You alone, Lord of the self, are the nature of all, and all loves dwelling in the self. Knowing Your devotion as self-established, may a person conquer.
l3:
You alone, self's Lord, are all men's nature, and all men love within the self — so this love stands on its own ground.
Who knows it, knowing by drowning — let him conquer.
sa: tvam evātmeśa sarvasya sarvaś cātmani rāgavān iti svabhāvasiddhāṃs tvadbhaktiṃ jānañ jayej janaḥ

en: Lord — when the knowable is destroyed, by whom are You not seen, standing alone? Even amid the agitation of knower and knowable, You are easily seen by devotees.
l3:
Lord — the known destroyed, who would not see You standing all alone?
Even in the known-knower churn, lovers find You easy.
sa: nātha vedyakṣaye kena na dṛśyo 'syekakaḥ sthitaḥ vedyavedakasaṃkṣobhe 'py asi bhaktaiḥ sudarśanaḥ

en: As the lake of endless bliss, the Goddess, the beloved, is inseparable from You — so may one devotion of mine be inseparable.
l3:
As the Goddess — endless-bliss lake, dearest — stands unparted from You,
so may one love of mine stand — unparted.
sa: anantānandasarasī devī priyatamā yathā aviyuktāsti te tadvad ekā tvadbhaktir astu me

en: O All-pervading — for devotees of devotion, everything is a cause of gaining You. This path of consciousness stands threefold — in joy, in suffering, in delusion.
l3:
O All — for lovers, everything causes the gaining of You.
This knowing-road stands threefold: by joy, by sorrow, by bewilderment.
sa: sarva eva bhavallābhahetur bhaktimatāṃ vibho saṃvinmārgo 'yam āhlādaduḥkhamohais tridhā sthitaḥ

en: What of knowledge — even its supreme state, from tasting Your devotion's nectar — is to me, O Lord, like vinegar-sourness after wine.
l3:
From tasting Your love's nectar, Master — even knowing's highest state
turns in my mouth to unwine-sourness.
sa: bhavadbhaktyamṛtāsvādād bodhasya syāt parāpi yā daśā sā māṃ prati svāmin nāsavasyeva śuktatā

en: Those to whom the great knowledge of Your devotion has come through practice — they alone know truth, both knowledge and its absence.
l3:
Those to whom Your love's great lore has come as practice —
they alone know the real: knowing, unknowing, both.
sa: bhavadbhaktimahāvidyā yeṣām abhyāsam āgatā vidyāvidyobhayasyāpi tā ete tattvavedinaḥ

en: From the root, this creeper of speech, unfolding in due sequence — watered by the nectar of Your devotion, may it bear rasa-rich fruit for me.
l3:
This speech-creeper, from the root, opening in order —
sprinkled with Your love's nectar, may its fruit swell with that sap — for me.
sa: āmulād vāglatā seyaṃ kramavisphāraśālinī tvadbhaktisudhayā siktā tadrasāḍhyaphalāstu me

en: "Having become Śiva, let him worship" — so the devotee is said to have become. For You alone are the body's essence, purified by devotees through non-duality.
l3:
Be Śiva, then sacrifice — and the lover, become, is so declared.
For You alone are the body's pith, assayed by lovers in oneness.
sa: śivo bhūtvā yajeteti bhakto bhūtveti kathyate tvam eva hi vapuḥ sāraṃ bhaktair advayaśodhitam

en: For devotees, what is not a means to accomplishment of non-duality with You? And for the low, what obstructions could there be to its failure?
l3:
For lovers, what is not proof toward oneness with You?
And for the lowest, what veil could dam its failing?
sa: bhaktānāṃ bhavadadvaitasiddhyai kā nopapattayaḥ tadasiddhyai nikṛṣṭānāṃ kāni nāvaraṇāni vā

en: That You are attained sometime, somewhere, by yoga, O Lord — that is the deceit. Otherwise, how would You shine in all states for the possessors of devotion?
l3:
Some time, some place, by yoga You may be got — Lord, that's the cheat.
Else how do You shine, here blazing, in every state, for lovers?
sa: kadācit kvāpi labhyo 'si yogenetīśa vañcanā anyathā sarvakakṣyāsu bhāsi bhaktimatāṃ katham

en: Untouched by withdrawal and the rest — this is the great distinction: that sharers of devotion stay composed even in emergence, beyond the yogins.
l3:
Untouched by breath-withdrawal and the rest — this is the great difference:
devotion's portion-takers stay gathered even waking — past the yogins.
sa: pratyāhārādyasaṃspṛṣṭo viśeṣo 'sti mahānayam yogibhyo bhaktibhājām yad vyutthāne 'pi samāhitāḥ

en: No yoga is enjoined, no austerity, no procedure of worship at all. On this guileless path of Śiva, devotion alone is praised.
l3:
No yoga bidden, no self-burning, no rite-rule — none of it prescribed.
On this straight Śiva-road, love alone is praised.
sa: na yogo na tapo nārcākramaḥ ko 'pi pranīyate amāye śivamārge 'smin bhaktir ekā praśasyate

en: My covering shattered by devotion's light shining from all sides — may even my thoughts, which face all real things, perish.
l3:
My cover fire-shattered from all sides by love's play of light —
I who face all things bare — may even my thoughts perish.
sa: sarvato vilasadbhaktitejodhvastāvṛter mama pratyakṣasarvabhāvasya cintānām api naśyatu

en: A wonder: that in devotees, with the single word "Śiva" standing always on the tongue's tip, there is the taste of every sense-object.
l3:
One word — Śiva — camped on the tongue-tip, always — and every sense-thing tasted.
In lovers only. Whatever that is — ah!
sa: śiva ity ekaśabdasya jihvāgre tiṣṭhataḥ sadā samastaviṣayāsvādo bhakteṣv evāsti ko 'py aho

en: In the calm-waved, cool, clear, sweet milk-ocean of devotion's nectar — in tasting its unworldly essence — who that stands firm there is counted low?
l3:
In the calm-waved, cool, clear, sweet love-nectar sea — tasting its otherworld sap, steady —
who is counted a nobody?
sa: śāntakallolaśītācchasvādubhaktisudhāmbudhau alaukikarasāsvāde susthaiḥ ko 'nāma gaṇyate

en: Why would people like me not chew Your devotion's great medicine — whose after-taste, O Lord, is called liberation?
l3:
Why would the likes of us not chew Your love's great herb —
such a one whose very next taste, Lord, is called freedom?
sa: sādṛśaiḥ kiṃ na carvyeta bhavadbhaktimahauṣadhiḥ tādṛśī bhagavan yasyā mokṣākhyo 'nantaro rasaḥ

en: Those alone are ultimately wealth, O Lord, in the judgement of the good — which nourish confident enjoyment of the taste of devotion to You.
l3:
Those alone count as wealth, Lord, by the good's measure —
whatever fattens trusted feasting on Your love's sap.
sa: tā eva paramarthyante sampadaḥ sadbhir īśa yāḥ tvad bhaktirasasambhogavisrambhaparipoṣikāḥ

en: They have grasped something of Your devotion-nectar's essence who, though fallen into this mud of passion and the rest, are not smeared by it.
l3:
They've caught some of love's nectar-pith who, fallen in this passion-mud and all the rest,
come up unsmeared.
sa: bhavadbhaktisudhāsāras taiḥ kim apy upalakṣitaḥ ye na rāgādi paṅke 'smiṃḷ lipyante patitā api

en: From supernormal powers to liberation — fruit is named as a mere limb of the ripened creeper of Your devotion, for some.
l3:
Powers down to freedom — fruit is just a limb-name on love's ripe creeper.
In some.
sa: aṇimādiṣu mokṣānteṣv aṅgeṣv eva phalābhidhā bhavadbhakter vipakvāyā latāyā iva keṣu cit

en: A wonder, Lord: this mind, by nature pain's seed — watered by the essence of devotion to You, becomes liberation's great fruit.
l3:
Strange, Lord: this mind, pain-seed by nature — sprinkled with Your love's sap,
ripens into freedom's great fruit.
sa: citraṃ nisargato nātha duḥkhabījam idaṃ manaḥ tvadbhaktirasasaṃsiktam niḥśreyasamahāphalam

en: To the many-formed, whose nature is consciousness — fire, moon, sun, Brahmā, Viṣṇu, moving and unmoving — bow.
l3:
Fire, moon, sun — Brahmā, Viṣṇu — still things, moving things: Your very stuff.
To the many-shaped — to You, shaped of knowing — bow.
sa: agnīṣomaravibrahmaviṣṇusthāvarajaṅgama svarūpa bahurūpāya namaḥ saṃvinmayāya te

en: To the great fire fed by the universe as fuel, smeared-pure with great ash, to the Becoming to whom the world is the sole oblation — bow.
l3:
To the great fire — universe for fuel, bright with great ash smeared pure —
to Thee, the Becoming, whose one offering is the world — bow.
sa: viśvendhanamahākṣārānulepaśucivarcase mahānalāya bhavate viśvaikahaviṣe namaḥ

en: To Śiva-fire — cool, dense with supreme nectar — and to You, the unequalled devourer in the world's destruction — bow.
l3:
To Śiva's fire — cool, thick with highest nectar —
and to some Unequalled, all-devouring when the world burns — homage be to Thee.
sa: paramāmṛtasāndrāya śītalāya śivāgnaye kasmai cid viśvasaṃploṣaviṣamāya namo 'stu te

en: To Mahādeva, to Rudra, to Śaṅkara, to Śiva, to You Maheśvara — and to someone mantra-bodied — bow.
l3:
To Mahādeva, Rudra, Śaṅkara, Śiva — to Thee, even as Great-Lord — bow.
And to some mantra-bodied one — bow.
sa: mahādevāya rudrāya śaṅkarāya śivāya te maheśvarāyāpi namaḥ kasmai cin mantramūrtaye

en: To Śiva-fire — cut, dried up, the three worlds' melted fat the oblation — unequalled, yet auspicious — bow.
l3:
Bow — to Śiva's fire: cut, sucked dry, the three worlds' melted fat His unction —
unequalled though He be, yet kind.
sa: namo nikṛttaniḥśoṣatrailokyavigaladvasā- vasekaviṣamāyāpi maṅgalāya śivāgnaye

en: To the god — to gracious someone — for whom the meeting of all marks is itself the mark — bow.
l3:
Whose mark is this alone — that no marks meet —
to Him, to God, to gracious some Śambhu — homage be.
sa: samastalakṣanāyoga eva yasyopalakṣaṇam tasmai namo 'stu devāya kasmai cid api śambhave

en: To the hidden Lord — Veda-and-Āgama-opposing, Veda-and-Āgama-making, their true essence, secret master — bow.
l3:
To Him against Veda and Āgama, maker of Veda and Āgama, their true essence —
to the hidden Master — bow.
sa: vedāgamaviruddhāya vedāgamavidhāyine vedāgamasatattvāya guhyāya svāmine namaḥ

en: Sole cause of the wheel of births and deaths — and its sole opponent; saṃsāra-formed, saṃsāra-free — to gracious Śambhu, bow.
l3:
Sole maker of the world-round — and its sole unmaker;
round-shaped, round-free — to gracious Śambhu, bow.
sa: saṃsāraikanimittāya saṃsāraikavirodhine namaḥ samsārarūpāya niḥsaṃsārāya śambhave

en: To root, to middle, to tip; embodied as root-middle-tip; with tip-middle-root exhausted — to the Full, gracious Śambhu — bow.
l3:
To root, middle, tip; shaped as root-middle-tip; tip-middle-root outworn —
to the Full, gracious Śambhu — bow.
sa: mūlāya madhyāyāgrāya mūlamadhyāgramūrtaye kṣīnāgramadhyamūlāya namaḥ pūrṇāya śambhave

en: Even once — whosever taking of the Name — ripened heaps of merit. To You, Śiva, hard to attain — bow.
l3:
Bow — that taking of the Name, even once, IS merit-heaps ripened.
To Him, Śiva, hard to win — to Thee.
sa: namaḥ sukṛtasaṃbharavipākaḥ sakṛd apy asau yasya nāmagrahas tasmai durlabhāya śivāya te

en: To You alone — consciousness-formed, skull-bearing — ever sporting with heaped multitudes of moving-and-static forms — bow.
l3:
Bow — amid heaped crowds of moving and unmoving shapes, ever playing for Thee, the One —
knowing-shaped, skull-wearing.
sa: namaścarācarākāraparetanicayaiḥ sadā krīḍate tubhyam ekasmai cinmayāya kapāline

en: To the magician, the pure, the hidden, the self-manifest; the subtle, the all-formed — to wondrous Śambhu — bow.
l3:
To the trickster, the pure; the hidden, the self-shown; the fine, the all-shaped — bow —
to Śambhu, wonder-variegated.
sa: māyāvine viśuddhāya guhyāya prakaṭātmane sūkṣmāya viśvarūpāya namaś citrāya śambhave

en: To all power — whose play destroys the world arrayed by Brahmā, Indra, Viṣṇu — wonder-working — bow.
l3:
To all-might — whose sport unmakes the world arrayed by Brahmā, Indra, Viṣṇu —
wonder to be worked — bow to Thee.
sa: brahmendraviṣṇunirvyūḍhajagatsaṃhārakelaye āścaryakaraṇīyāya namas te sarvaśaktaye

en: To You, the fathomless Hara-ocean — whose powers are gained by those wandering only its shores — bow.
l3:
Those powers and powers are won by shore-roamers only — roamers of His shores.
Bow to Thee — O fathomless Hara-sea.
sa: taṭeṣv eva paribhrāntaiḥ labdhās tās tā vibhūtayaḥ yasya tasmai namas tubhyam agādhaharasindhave

en: To the lovely hundred-petalled Śambhu-lotus, dwelling mid mud of the Māyā-made dense world, unsmeared, shining — bow.
l3:
Dwelling deep in the mud of the Māyā-thick world — unsmeared —
bow to the shining hundred-petalled Śambhu-lotus.
sa: māyāmayajagatsāndrapaṅkamadhyādhivāsine alepāya namaḥ śambhuśatapatrāya śobhine

en: Auspicious, pure, treasure, self-ornamented; dear, ultimate-real, highest — to You — bow.
l3:
To the kind, the pure; treasure; self-adorned; dear; last-real; highest —
to Thee — bow.
sa: maṅgalāya pavitrāya nidhaye bhūṣaṇātmane priyāya paramārthāya sarvotkṛṣṭāya te namaḥ

en: Ever bound, ever sharing liberation's portion; difference-free — to gracious someone Śambhu — bow.
l3:
Bow to the ever-bound, ever sharing freedom; lacking bond and freedom both —
to some Śambhu even — bow.
sa: namaḥ satatabaddhāya nityanirmuktibhāgine bandhamokṣavihīnāya kasmai ci d api śambhave

en: In these three worlds whose essence is mockery alone — to You alone, secondless, ever-bliss-seated — bow.
l3:
In all this three-world, whose whole stuff is jeering —
to Thee alone, secondless, ever throned in bliss — bow.
sa: upahāsaikasāre 'sminn etāvati jagattraye tubhyam evādvitīyāya namo nityasukhāsine

en: Essence of right-observance yet desirer of left-observance; of all observances, to observance-free Śarva — bow.
l3:
Heart of right-rite, lover of left-rite; all-rite, Śarva, rite-free —
to Thee — bow.
sa: dakṣiṇācārasārāya vāmācārābhilāṣiṇe sarvācārāya śarvāya nirācārāya te namaḥ

en: Whoever is worshipped, however, wherever — and whoever, whatever god he be — to that god, bow.
l3:
Be it how it may — whoever is worshipped, wherever honored — whoever, whichever god that be —
to him let homage be: to Thee.
sa: yathā tathāpi yaḥ pūjyo yatra tatrāpi yo 'rcitaḥ yo 'pi vā so 'pi vā yo 'sau devas tasmai namo 'stu te

en: Served by liberation-seekers, remover of all burning; of spread-out chosen loveliness — to You, boon-giver — bow.
l3:
Served by release-hungers, thief of every fever; spread loveliness at its choicest —
boon-giver — bow to Thee.
sa: mumukṣujanasevyāya sarvasantāpahāriṇe namo vitatalāvaṇyavarāya varadāya te

en: To You, Lord of the ever-festival, whose three worlds brim with unbroken bliss-rasa — bow.
l3:
Always — three worlds brimmed with unbroken bliss-sap —
bow to Thee, Master of the feast that never ends.
sa: sadā nirantarānandarasanirbharitākhila- trilokāya namas tubhyaṃ svāmine nityaparvaṇe

en: Whatever enjoys You through pleasure-first knowables — to that terrible host of Your powers — bow.
l3:
Whatever courts Thee — Thee indeed — through pleasure-first tastes, enjoying —
to that dread power-ring of Thine — homage to Thee.
sa: sukhapradhānasaṃvedyasambhogair bhajate ca yat tvām eva tasmai ghorāya śaktivṛndāya te namaḥ

en: Even sages cannot know Him — yet those whose gestures love connects embrace Him. To that someone Becoming — bow.
l3:
Past even sages' knowing — yet those love-yoked in gesture hold Him fast.
To that some Becoming — bow.
sa: munīnām apy avijñeyaṃ bhaktisambandhaceṣṭitāḥ āliṅganty api yaṃ tasmai kasmai cid bhavate namaḥ

en: To the supreme-nectar sheath, the supreme-nectar heap; reachable beyond far and near — to Becoming — bow.
l3:
To highest-nectar's sheath, highest-nectar's heap;
reached past all beyond and no-beyond — to Becoming — bow.
sa: paramāmṛtakośāya paramāmṛtarāśaye sarvapāramyapāramyaprāpyāya bhavate namaḥ

en: I praise Your mantra-formed, clear-cool, unprecedentedly joyful, supreme-nectar-juicy form.
l3:
Mantra through and through — I praise Thy form:
clear, cool, lovely with unheard joy, lush with highest-nectar sap.
sa: mahāmantramayaṃ naumi rūpaṃ te svacchaśītalam apūrvamodasubhagaṃ parāmṛtarasolvaṇam

en: On oneness-fame's great cloth, full of immortality-nectar — where, Lord, there is no wonder — I praise Your teaching.
l3:
On oneness-fame's wide canvas, grounded in freedom-nectar's fullness —
where, Lord, wonder simply isn't — that I praise: Thy teaching.
sa: svātantryāmṛtapūrṇatvad aikyakhyātimahāpaṭe citraṃ nāsty eva yatreśa tan naumi tava śāsanam

en: Thunderbolt to all doubt, world-end fire to all misfortune, world's-end to all joylessness — we bow the Māheśvara path.
l3:
Thunderbolt to every doubt, doomsday-fire to all ill-luck, aeon-end to joylessness —
we bow the Great-Lord road.
sa: sarvāśaṅkāsaniṃ sarvālakṣmīkālānalaṃ tathā sarvāmaṅgalyakalpāntaṃ mārgaṃ māheśvaraṃ numaḥ

en: Victory, god! Bow upon bow to You; this whole world rests on You; of worlds You are supreme Lord; I am come to You for refuge, the One supreme.
l3:
Hail, God! Bow on bow to Thee; all this world leans on Thee;
Thou — worlds' high Lord, One supreme — I am come to Thee for shelter.
sa: jaya deva namo namo 'stu te sakalaṃ viśvam idaṃ tavāśritam jagatāṃ parameśvaro bhavān paramekaḥ śaraṇāgato 'smi te

en: Of things, the two courses that go by being and non-being — leaping over them — to the third, the wondrous Śambhu — bow.
l3:
Things run double — being, unbeing, the two-yoked course.
Leap it. To the Third — bow to wondrous Śambhu.
sa: sadasattvena bhāvānāṃ yuktā yā dvitayī gatiḥ tām ullaṅghya tṛtīyasmai namaś citrāya śambhave

en: Among gods, seers, and men in this unfree triple world — free are Your dependents, O Free One.
l3:
Gods, seers, men — this triple world unfree.
But free are they who live off Thee alone, O Free — Thy hangers-on.
sa: āsurarṣijanād asminn asvatantre jagattraye svatantrās te svatantrasya ye tavaivānujīvinaḥ

en: Remembrance of Your body inlaid with the whole universe — the one medicine for world-pain; who have it sit happy.
l3:
Thy body, gem-set with the whole world —
remembering it: the one medicine for existence-pain. Who hold it, sit easy.
sa: aśeṣaviśvakhacitabhavadvapur anusmṛtiḥ yeṣām bhavarujām ekaṃ bheṣajaṃ te sukhāsinaḥ

en: Whose white umbrella is the self-lit moon, whose fly-whisk the heaven-river's stream — He alone is Supreme Lord.
l3:
Whose white parasol is the moon, lit with its own light;
whose whisk is heaven-river's rush — He alone is high Lord.
sa: sitātapatraṃ yasyenduḥ svaprabhāparipūritaḥ cāmaraṃ svardhunīsrotaḥ sa ekaḥ parameśvaraḥ

en: Grant me, Lord, a glance — luminous, cool, one, pure as a moon-digit, carrying nectar.
l3:
Bright, cool, single, pure — like a moon-sliver —
deal me a glance, Lord, any at all, nectar-flowing.
sa: prakāśāṃ śītalām ekāṃ śuddhāṃ śaśikalām iva dṛśaṃ vitara me nātha kām apy amṛtavāhinīm

en: Fallen from Your consciousness-bliss ocean — these knowings, these drops — why are they not nectar-sweet-beautiful to me, Lord?
l3:
Drops fallen from Thy knowing-bliss sea — these knowings —
why, Lord, in my mouth not nectar-sweet, not lovely?
sa: tvaccidānandajaladheś cyutāḥ saṃvittivipruṣaḥ imāḥ kathaṃ me bhagavan nāmṛtāsvādasundarāḥ

en: In Your love-rasa, Lord, hearts unmelted — the heartless alone — such deserve contempt.
l3:
Hearts undipped in Thy love-sap, Lord —
whose are so, Master, are heartless, nothing else: such are contempt's seat.
sa: tvayi rāgarase nātha na magnaṃ hṛdayaṃ prabho yeṣām ahṛdayā eva te 'vajñaspadam īdṛśāḥ

en: Whose heart has met the Lord's — he alone is the vessel of ruling goddesses' powers.
l3:
Whose heart has met with Thine, Lord —
he, he alone, holds the ruling Ladies' powers: their one high vessel.
sa: prabhuṇā bhavatā yasya jātaṃ hṛdayamelanam prābhavīṇāṃ vibhūtīnāṃ paramekaḥ sa bhājanam

en: Flooder alike of all joys and sorrows — Your meditation-nectar-flood, like lowlands filling.
l3:
Drowner of joys, then sorrows — all, alike —
Thy thought-nectar in flood, over low ground, as water seeks it.
sa: harṣāṇām atha śokānāṃ sarveṣāṃ plāvakaḥ samam bhavaddhyānāmṛtāpūro nimnāṇimnabhuvām iva

en: What would their look not be, happiness-provisions-full — who never part from You, more than self, Lord?
l3:
What would their eyes not hold, brimmed with joy-stores —
they who, by more than life, Lord, nowhere ever leave Thee?
sa: keva na syād dṛśā teṣāṃ sukhasambhāranirbharā yeṣām ātmādhikeneśa na kvāpi virahas tvayā

en: I roar, I dance — my wishes are fulfilled, for my Lord is won, utterly charming.
l3:
I thunder — ah! — I dance: my mind-chariots ride full, for my Master is won —
since Thou, Thou utterly delightest.
sa: garjāmi bata nṛtyāmi pūrṇā mama manorathāḥ svāmī mamaiṣa ghaṭito yat tvam atyantarocanaḥ

en: Where no other knowable for action, no other yoga for knowing — yet what if knowledge? Consciousness alone, world-filled-one, expands.
l3:
No other known for doing, no other yoke for knowing —
and yet, what of knowing? Thou — all-one-full Knowing — unfoldest.
sa: nānyad vedyaṃ kriyā yatra nānyo yogo vidā ca yat jñānaṃ syāt kiṃ tu viśvaikapūrṇā cittvaṃ vijṛmbhate

en: Suddenly fled from them — hard, endless sorrows — whose speech forever holds the Śiva-sound.
l3:
Hard, endless pains — suddenly out of their grip, fled —
from whom? Those in whose speech rings ever the Śiva-din.
sa: durjayānām anantānām duḥkhānāṃ sahasaiva te hastāt palāyitā yeṣāṃ vāci śaśvacchivadhvaniḥ

en: Is there another, higher person, distinct by remaining Yours? You alone, great Person, support of all persons without remainder.
l3:
Is there another high One, marked by remaining Thine?
Thou alone art the great Person — shelter of persons, none left out.
sa: uttamaḥ puruṣo 'nyo 'sti yuṣmaccheṣaviśeṣitaḥ tvaṃ mahāpuruṣas tv eko niḥśeṣapuruṣāśrayaḥ

en: Victorious, world-venerable, Your slaves, Lord — for whom this saṃsāra-ocean is a play-great-lake.
l3:
They win — Thy slaves, honored by the world, O world-pervader —
for whom this very passing-sea is a play-lake.
sa: jayanti te jagadvandyā dāsās te jagatāṃ vibho saṃsārārṇava evaiṣa yeṣāṃ krīḍāmahāsaraḥ

en: Let other miseries sit — for Your devotees, "You manifest Yourself" — by this alone they are shamed.
l3:
Let other miseries sit a while —
here, for Thy partakers, appear plain, Thou — by that alone they are shamed.
sa: āsatāṃ tāvad anyāni dainyānīha bhavajjuṣām tvam eva prakaṭībhūyā ity anenaiva lajjyate

en: "Nothing is beyond me" — yet therein I am a reciter, by that oneness; as truth, You point the rosary somewhere.
l3:
'Naught beyond me' — yet even there I tell my beads, one with that.
In truth: 'murmur on' — with bead-strand Thou pointest onward.
sa: matparaṃ nāsti tatrāpi jāpako 'smi tadaikyataḥ tattvena japa ity akṣamālayā diśasi kvacit

en: From being must come supreme being, and beyond that, Lord — and You are other than being and non-being both; hence You are being-non-being-formed.
l3:
From being, needs must, highest being — and being past even that, Lord. And Thou —
other than being, other than unbeing — so art Thou being-unbeing-stuff.
sa: sato 'vaśyaṃ paramasat sac ca tasmāt paraṃ prabho tvaṃ cāsataḥ sataś cānyas tenāsi sadasanmayaḥ

en: Purer-shining than thousand-sun-ray-rise — yet You, all-worlds-pervading, are not seen.
l3:
Purer-bright than a thousand suns raying up —
yet Thou, though through all worlds spread, art not seen.
sa: sahasrasūryakiraṇādhikaśuddhaprakāśavān api tvaṃ sarvabhuvanavyāpako 'pi na dṛśyase

en: Conscious-formed in the inert world, knower even in the known; great in the measured — hence You are the highest.
l3:
Knowing-shaped in the dead world, they say —
knower inside the known; mighty in the measured: since Thou art so — highest of all, Lord.
sa: jaḍe jagati cidrūpaḥ kila vedye 'pi vedakaḥ vibhur mite ca yenāsi tena sarvottamo bhavān

en: Enough with other cries — this alone, before the Lord: I cry sharp, Lord, I am bewildered, even knowing thus.
l3:
Enough of other wailings — just this, before the Lord: I keen aloud —
for, Lord, I swoon, knowing even so.
sa: alam ākranditair anyair iyad eva puraḥ prabhoḥ tīvraṃ viraumi yan nātha muhyāmy evaṃ vidann api

en: Mind — though fickle you are — even so you are praised, since you worship the refuge of refuges, the world's teacher, Ambikā's husband.
l3:
Fickle though thou be, mind —
praised even so, since thou courtst the refuge of refuges, worlds' teacher, Ambikā's husband.
sa: capalam asi yad api mānasa tatrāpi ślāghyase yato bhajase śaraṇānām api śaraṇaṃ tribhuvanagurum ambikākāntam

en: Having crossed the ladder-steps of the many gods and resorted to Śiva's feet — yet a lower ground I do not quit even now. Strange.
l3:
Stairs of sundry gods climbed past, Śiva's feet reached and held —
yet the low ground I keep even today. Strange — I quit it not.
sa: ullaṅghya vividhadaivatasopānakramam upeya śivacaraṇān āśrityāpy adharatarāṃ bhūmiṃ nādyāpi citram ujjhāmi

en: Reveal Your own path, hide all world-ways thoroughly — while I am, Lord, quickly Your ever-risen servant.
l3:
Show Thine own road, shutter all world-doings tight —
while I am, Lord, Thy servant now, ever risen.
sa: prakaṭaya nijam adhvānaṃ sthagayatarām akhilalokacaritāni yāvad bhavāmi bhagavaṃs tava sapadi sadodito dāsaḥ

en: Śiva Śiva Śambhu Śaṅkara — swift pity on the refuge-seekers' lover! Fortune is near for whoever remembers Your lotus-feet-pair.
l3:
Śiva! Śiva! Śambhu! Śaṅkara! O lover of comers-for-shelter —
pity, and swift! Who bends on remembering Thy paired lotus-feet — fortunes, not far.
sa: śiva śiva śambho śaṅkara śaraṇāgatavatsalāśu kuru karuṇām tava caraṇakamalayugalasmaraṇaparasya hi sampado 'dūre

en: Those seated on Your foot-lotus-throne, making the world to taste — they laugh at Viriñci, office-stained, not-self-ruled.
l3:
Dissolved in Thy foot-lotus seat, making the world to taste —
they laugh at Viriñci, office-smeared, unmastered by himself, Lord.
sa: tāvakāṅghrikamalāsanalīnā ye yathāruci jagad racayanti te viriñcim adhikāramalenāliptam asvavaśam īśa hasanti

en: Nothing appears apart from Your light-body; so You are always already gained, Lord — though far by nature.
l3:
Naught can show apart from Thy light-body —
so, Lord, art Thou ever already won, Master, though far by nature.
sa: tvatprakāśavapuṣo na vibhinnaṃ kiṃ cana prabhavati pratibhātum tat sadaiva bhagavan parilabdho 'sīśvara prakṛtito 'pi vidūraḥ

en: Some taste Your foot-lotus-juice as stale-difference-conduct; others instantly taste it as flawless, body-whole, duality-free.
l3:
Thy foot-lotus sap — some sup as overnight-stale difference-fare;
but some taste it fresh-poured: shining, whole-bodied, void of two.
sa: pādapaṅkajarasaṃ tava ke cid bhedaparyuṣitavṛttim upetāḥ ke canāpi rasayanti tu sadhyo bhātam akṣatavapur dvayaśūnyam

en: Lord, like lightning at dawn gleams my nectar-smeared — if it stayed steadier, You are worshipped duly — what else?
l3:
Lord, like daybreak lightning shines my nectar-smeared —
would she hold but steadier, then art Thou duly worshipped. What more?
sa: nātha vidyud iva bhāti vibhāte yā kadā cana mamāmṛtadigdhā sā yadi sthirataraiva bhavet tat pūjito 'si vidhivat kim utānyat

en: Is there anything, thing or non-thing, apart from this? With great discernment decided here: as You are, so be plain to me.
l3:
'Thing or unthing —
is aught beyond this?' thus with high discernment resolved: as Thou art, be Thou bare to me.
sa: sarvam asyaparam asti na kiṃ cid vastv avastu yadi veti mahatyā prajñāya vyavasito 'tra yathaiva tvaṃ tathaiva bhava suprakaṭo me

en: By Your will alone, Lord, I was made to step on Your own path — then why do I behave just like a man, knowing nothing fit for Your feet?
l3:
By Thine own will alone, Lord, on Thine own road I was set walking —
by the Lord Himself. Why then walk I mere folk-like, kenning naught worthy of Thy feet?
sa: svecchayaiva bhagavan nijamārge kāritaḥ padam ahaṃ prabhunaiva tat kathaṃ janavad eva carāmi tvatpadocitam avaimi na kiṃ cit

en: Some god of Yours blooms in their hearts, a lovely supreme state — by whose story-thunder-cātakas they are long gladdened.
l3:
