Some god of Thine blooms in their hearts — a lovely high mood.
Thy story-cloud's thunder — its cātakas, by it made lovely, long.
sa: ko 'pi deva hṛdi teṣu tāvako jṛmbhate subhagabhāva uttamaḥ tvatkathāmbudaninādacātakā yena te 'pi subhagīkṛtāś ciram

en: For Your devotees, by some play in You, this love has grown fat — so that separation-ground talk and memory fruit in union-festival.
l3:
Thy partakers — by some play in Thee this love has grown fat:
on parting-ground, talk, remembrance too, fruit a union-feast.
sa: tvajjuṣāṃ tvayi kayāpi līlayā rāga eṣa paripoṣam āgataḥ yad viyogabhuvi saṅkathā tathā saṃsmṛtiḥ phalati saṃgamotsavam

en: The word, grown by strange-rasa-sprinkling, though uttered "Śaṅkara" hundreds of times — enters even sideways hearts, ever-fresh in purpose.
l3:
Grown by strange-sap watering — 'Śaṅkara!' hundredfold though uttered —
the word slips even into slant hearts, its errand ever fresh.
sa: yo vicitrarasasekavardhitaḥ śaṅkareti śataśo 'py udīritaḥ śabda āviśati tiryagāśayeṣv apy ayaṃ navanavaprayojanaḥ

en: Victorious are they on whose face-orbits the Śiva-sound ever revolves — which, moon-spread from nectar-source, trickles supreme nectar, sweet.
l3:
They win on whose face-orbs circles ever the Śiva-din —
which, moonlike, streaming from nectar's seat, trickles sweet supreme nectar.
sa: te jayanti mukhamaṇḍale bhraman asti yeṣu niyataṃ śivadhvaniḥ yaḥ śāśīva prasṛto 'mṛtāśayāt svādu saṃsravati cāmṛtaṃ param

en: The fierce world as if finished; mind's impurity thinned to none — and yet not even the smallest knocking at Your city-door-bolt.
l3:
The fierce world as if done; mind-stain melted thin —
yet at Thy city, bolt-and-door, not one atom of knocking.
sa: parisamāptam ivogram idaṃ jagad vigalito 'viralo manaso malaḥ tad api nāsti bhavatpurārgalakavāṭavighaṭṭanam aṇva pi

en: Of minds eager for Your ever-blooming face-lotus-belly-gaze — do something, Lord, just a little, so You flash as facing me.
l3:
Hungry for one gaze into Thy ever-bloom face-lotus's heart —
do aught, Lord, the merest: flash Thou facing me.
sa: satataphullabhavanmukhapaṅkajodaravilokanalālasacetasaḥ kim api tat kuru nātha manāg iva sphurasi yena mamābhimukhasthitiḥ

en: What happiness here apart from non-difference-mind, what other glory? So why does this servant's mind, abandoning her, go the wrong way?
l3:
What joy here but thought of Thy undifference — what other glory?
Why then does this slave of Thine go wrong-road, forsaking her?
sa: tvadavibhedamater aparaṃ nu kiṃ sukham ihāsti vibhūtir athāparā tad iha tāvakadāsajanasya kiṃ kupatham eti manaḥ parihṛtya tām

en: May I never for a moment be unfit for Your serfdom — unless constantly, reverently tasting non-difference-wine.
l3:
Never for an instant here unfit for Thy serfdom may I be —
unless I sip, loving, unceasing, Thy undifference-wine.
sa: kṣaṇam apīha na tāvakadāsatāṃ prati bhaveyam ahaṃ kila bhājanam bhavadabhedarasāsavam ādarād avirataṃ rasayeyam ahaṃ na cet

en: These people truly do not see Your body, dirtied by duality-sight — and yet, all-knowing refuge-lover, do You not hear MY cry?
l3:
Folk see not, truly, Thy body — two-sight-dirtied. Yet Thou, all-knowing, shelter-tender —
why hearest Thou not this wail of mine?
sa: na kila paśyati satyam ayaṃ janas tava vapur dvayadṛṣṭimalīmasaḥ tad api sarvavidāśritavatsalaḥ kim idam āraṭitaṃ na śṛṇoṣi me

en: Do You remember, Lord, any desired sense-pleasure I ever asked? Give instead, always, Your body-vision-nectar as the only wish.
l3:
Rememberest Thou, Lord, e'er a sense-joy I wished —
or e'er asked? Give ever Thy body-beholding nectar — my one wish. Give it.
sa: smarasi nātha kadācid apīhitaṃ viṣayasaukhyam athāpi mayārthitam satatam eva bhavadvapurīkṣaṇāmṛtamabhīṣṭamalaṃ mama dehi tat

en: Since by Your will alone I stepped on Your Śiva-path, Lord — hundreds of good omens rose for me; what else should I seek from You?
l3:
Since foot I've set, Great-Lord, on Thy Śiva-road — by Thy will —
fair hundreds rose for me at once. What more hunt I from Thee, Master?
sa: kila yadaiva śivādhvani tāvake kṛtapado 'smi maheśa tavecchayā śubhaśatānyuditāni tadaiva me kim aparaṃ mṛgaye bhavataḥ prabho

en: Where the sun sets with the moon and all — that unconquered Śiva-night shines, self-light-spread-lustrous.
l3:
Where sun goes down with moon and all their train —
what a Śiva-night reigns, self-light outspread and lustrous.
sa: yatra so 'stam ayam eti vivasvāṃś candramaḥ prabhṛtibhiḥ saha sarvaiḥ kāpi sā vijayate śivarātriḥ svaprabhāprasarabhāsvararūpā

en: Even won rule in three worlds, O king of gods, I count tasteless — lacking Your foot-touch-nectar-rasa.
l3:
Three worlds' overlordship won — yet, God-king, I reckon it sapless, all —
wanting Thy foot-touch nectar-sap.
sa: apy upārjitam ahaṃ triṣu lokeṣv adhipatyam amareśvara manye nīrasaṃ tad akhilaṃ bhavadaṅghrisparśanāmṛtarasena vihīnam

en: Alas, Lord, strong is this self-bond, made of non-recognition of You, fashioned by You alone — first ignored by me, it never loosens a bit.
l3:
Alas, Lord — tough, this self-bond, Thy-unrecognition-made, tied by Thee alone:
scorning Thee first of all, it slackens not one jot.
sa: bata nātha dṛḍho 'yam ātmabandho bhavadakhyātimayas tvayaiva kḷptaḥ yad ayaṃ prathamānam eva me tvām avadhīrya ślathate na leśato 'pi

en: Though worshipped by the great, O king of gods, You ever stay the one-worshipper-form — seen outside and in, You shine in the seers' bodies forever.
l3:
God-king — though worshipped by the great, ever Thou standest worshiper-shaped alone;
seen without, within, here, Thou flashest in seer-bodies — ever.
sa: mahatām amareśa pūjyamāno 'py aniśaṃ tiṣṭhasi pūjakaikarūpaḥ bahirantarapīha dṛśyamānaḥ sphurasi draṣṭṛśarīra eva śaśvat

en: Joined in enjoyment by mere touch-contact of Your lotus-feet — bring me, Lord, by the neck into Your house.
l3:
Wedded in joy by mere brush of Thy lotus-feet —
take me by the scruff, Lord, into Thine own house.
sa: tvatpādapadmasamparkamātrasambhogasaṅginam galepādikayā nātha māṃ svaveśma praveśaya

en: Head hair dyed by Your foot-lotus-dust-redness — when shall I frantically begin to dance?
l3:
My hair dyed red with Thy foot-lotus dust —
when shall I, in boundless frenzy, break into dance?
sa: bhavatpādāmbujarajorājirañjitamūrdhajaḥ apārarabhasārabdhanartanaḥ syām ahaṃ kadā

en: You, sole Lord — this alone I always ask: dwelling inside You, may I be silent; not otherwise, O Wise One.
l3:
Thou my sole Lord — this much alone I beg, ever: dumb, dwelling inside Thee may I be —
never a sage instead.
sa: tvad ekanātho bhagavann iyad evārthaye sadā tvadantarvasatir mūko bhaveyaṃ mānyathā budhaḥ

en: Ah nectar-ocean master! Ah sweet three-eyed One! Ah tasty deformed-eyed One! — thus may I dance, shouting.
l3:
Ah, nectar-hoard, Master! Ah, sweet Three-eyed!
Ah, tasty Crooked-eyed! — so may I dance, yelling.
sa: aho sudhānidhe svāminn aho mṛṣṭa trilocana aho svādo virūpakṣety eva nṛtyeyam āraṭan

en: Eyes half-closed by Your foot-lotus-touch — may I expand, reeling drunk on Your devotion-liquor-madness.
l3:
Eyes half-shut with Thy foot-lotus touch —
may I gape wide, reeling with Thy love-wine's drunkenness.
sa: tvatpādapadmasaṃsparśaparimīlitalocanaḥ vijṛmbheyabhavadbhaktimadirāmadaghūrṇitaḥ

en: May I dwell anywhere, O All-pervading, mind-mountain on earth, where that practice is — uninterrupted, great-rasa, made of Your prattle.
l3:
Mind-mountain on earth, may I dwell anywhere, All —
where that practice runs unbroken, deep-sapped, made of Thy babble.
sa: cittabhūbhṛd bhuvi vibho vaseyaṃ kvāpi yatra sā nirantaratvatpralāpamayī vṛttir mahārasā

en: Where You stand with the Goddess, many-formed, from palace to gate-tower — in that city may I dwell.
l3:
Where Thou standest with the Lady, many-shaped, from palace to gate-tower —
in that town may I dwell.
sa: yatra devīsametas tvam āsaudhādā ca gopurāt bahurūpaḥ sthitas tasmin vāstavyaḥ syām ahaṃ pure

en: May Your sun-rays rejoice, Lord, until my heart-lotus blooms — for Your worship.
l3:
May Thy sun-rays sport, Lord, till this heart-lotus of mine opens —
for Thy worship.
sa: samullasantu bhagavan bhavadbhānumarīcayaḥ vikasatveṣa yāvan me hṛtpadmaḥ pūjanāya te

en: Favor me, Lord, so that my mind, fallen ever at Your feet, tasting this and that — may it melt, may it flow.
l3:
Clear, Lord —
that my mind, ever fallen at Thy feet, tasting this and that, melt as wax, run.
sa: prasīda bhagavan yena tvatpade patitaṃ sadā mano me tattadāsvādya kṣīved iva galed iva

en: Whether from joy bursting pot-lids, or sorrow — from outside or inside feeling, appear to me, Lord.
l3:
From joy though it burst from the pot, or from sorrow —
from outward feeling, inward feeling — show plain to me, Master.
sa: praharṣād vātha śokād vā yadi kuṅyād dhaṭād api bāhyād athāntarād bhāvāt prakaṭībhava me prabho

en: Outside too, inside too — may that ever-streaming, Your coolest foot-lotus-touch-nectar, be mine always.
l3:
Without too, within too —
may that ever-oozing be mine: Thy foot-lotus-touch nectar, cool past cool.
sa: bahir apy antar api tat syandamānaṃ sadāstu me bhavatpādāmbujasparśāmṛtam atyantaśītalam

en: Plunging inside Your touch-nectar-lake — may that pleasure beyond all pleasures be mine always.
l3:
Dived deep in Thy touch-nectar lake —
O what a joy past joys, leaping all enjoyment — be mine, ever.
sa: tvatpādasaṃsparśasudhāsaraso 'ntarnimajjanam ko 'py eṣa sarvasambhogalaṅghī bhogo 'stu me sadā

en: Take what I offer — passion and the rest, Lord; make it nectar and eat it with devotees.
l3:
Take the laid offering — passions and the rest, Lord, by me; take, nectarize, and feast —
with lover-folk, together.
sa: niveditam upādatsva rāgādi bhagavan mayā ādāya cāmṛtīkṛtya bhuṅkṣva bhaktajanaiḥ samam

en: Ever-full on whole-world-food, happily seated — Master, cast Your grace-glance-moment on servants.
l3:
Ever sated on whole-world food, easy-seated —
Master, take among slaves one grace-glance-instant.
sa: aśeṣabhuvanāhāranityatṛptaḥ sukhāsanam svāmin gṛhāṇa dāseṣu prasādālokanakṣaṇam

en: Eyes half-closed, chewing inner devotion-wonder — "bow to me, to Śiva" — may I worship even straw.
l3:
Half-eyed, chewing inner love-wonder —
'bow to me, to Śiva' — worshiping, may I be, even straws.
sa: antarbhakticamatkāracarvaṇāmīlitekṣaṇaḥ namo mahyaṃ śivāyeti pūjayam syāṃ tṛṇāny api

en: Though I have gained Your being — seeing the world as my self-blaze — may I be unparted by devotion-rasa-enjoyments.
l3:
Though Thy state be won — seeing the world my self-blaze —
by love-sap feastings may I stay unparted.
sa: api labdhabhavadbhāvaḥ svātmollāsamayaṃ jagat paśyan bhaktirasābhogair bhaveyam aviyojitaḥ

en: Since nothing else is to be desired, Lord — to You, the secondless, fullness is fitting.
l3:
Since naught else is to be longed for, Lord —
Thine — secondless — fullness is but fit.
sa: ākāmkṣaṇīyam aparaṃ yena nātha na vidyate tava tenādvitīyasya yuktaṃ yat paripūrṇatā

en: Where there is laughter, dancing, where passion-aversion are eaten, devotion-nectar drunk — may I reach that place.
l3:
Where 'tis laughed, 'tis danced —
where hates-and-loves are eaten, love-nectar drunk — may I win that foot-place.
sa: hasyate nṛtyate yatra rāgadveṣādi bhujyate pīyate bhaktipīyūṣarasas tat prāpnuyāṃ padam

en: May that unprecedented-joy-perfume of thought-flowers about You firm up in my mind — till bad-smell of bad-habit perishes.
l3:
That unheard-perfume — Thy-thought-blossoms' scent —
harden in my mind, till ill-habit's stink is eaten.
sa: tat tad apūrvāmodatvaccintākusumavāsanā dṛḍhatām etu mama manasi yāvann aśyatu durvāsanāgandhaḥ

en: Where is love among passions, and where is loving at Hari's lotus-feet — thus teach my contradiction-loving heart what is good, O Deathless.
l3:
Where, pray, love among passions —
and where loving 'mid Hara's foot-lotuses? So teach my clash-fond heart its good, Deathless.
sa: kva nu rāgādiṣu rāgaḥ kva ca haracaraṇāmbujeṣu rāgitvam itthaṃ virodharasikaṃ bodhaya hitam amara me hṛdayam

en: Though wandering even through yogic states, though turned away from objects — may I be only heart-melted by Your-thought-liquor-madness.
l3:
Roaming yoga-states even, turned from sense-things even —
Thy-thought-wine's frenzy liquifying my heart — only that may I be.
sa: vicaran yogadaśāsv api viṣayavyāvṛttivartamāno 'pi tvaccintāmadirāmadataralīkṛtahṛdaya eva syām

en: In speech, mind-thoughts, body-gestures made by senses — everywhere, always, may bhakti-rasa go before me as leader.
l3:
Speech, mind-thoughts, sense-wrought body-moves —
everywhere, ever, may love-sap run vanguard before me.
sa: vāci manomatiṣu tathā śarīraceṣṭāsu karaṇaracitāsu sarvatra sarvadā me puraḥsaro bhavatu bhaktirasaḥ

en: While Your name "Śiva Śiva Śiva" is chanted endlessly, Lord — may I taste some great unrepeatable rasa.
l3:
'Śiva Śiva Śiva' — Thy name muttered without end, Lord —
tasting may I be some great unre-said sap.
sa: śivaśivaśiveti nāmani tava niravadhi nātha japyamāne 'smin āsvādayan bhaveyaṃ kam api mahārasam apunaruktam

en: In the vastness flashing as endless consciousness-self, where all dull paths are drunk up — may I roam Your worship, countless consciousness-made ramparts uncounted.
l3:
Vast flashing endless knowing-self — dull roads all drunk dry —
ramparts uncounted, knowing-made — may I roam, by Thee honored.
sa: sphuradanantacidātmakaviṣṭape parinipītasamastajaḍādhvani agaṇitāparacinmayagaṇḍike pravicareyam ahaṃ bhavato 'rcitā

en: For standing in self-body, clearly shining, eternal — nothing else is of use; firm be this thought — but the dust of Your pure feet.
l3:
Standing in self-body, clear-shining, everlasting —
naught else avails. Firm be this thought. Yet — Thy foot-lotus dust, O Pure.
sa: svavapuṣi sphuṭabhāsini śāśvate sthitikṛte na kim apy upayujyate iti matiḥ sudṛḍhā bhavatāt paraṃ mama bhavaccaraṇābjarajaḥ śuceḥ

en: Something flashes sometime in mind, touching Your feet — where this whole world melts — show it always, in the nectar-lake, Lord.
l3:
Something, Lord, sometime flashes in mind —
touchers of Thy foot-sole, where this whole melts — in nectar's lake show me this world, ever.
sa: kim api nātha kadācana cetasi sphurati tad bhavadaṃghritalaspṛśām galati yatra samastamidaṃ sudhāsarasi viśvam idaṃ diśa me sadā

en: Even a moment parted from You, Lord — of me burning dense always — may I be the ground of Your gaze.
l3:
Though parted from Thee, Ruler, though it be a mere instant —
I ever thick-burning: may I be ground for Thy glance.
sa: kṣaṇamātram apīśāna viyuktasya tvayā mama nibiḍaṃ tapyamānasya sadā bhūyā dṛśaḥ padam

en: In saṃsāra whose essence is parting — by You, dear Lord, may I be ever unparted, though parted from the world.
l3:
In parting-pithed passing — by Thee, dear Master —
may I be ever unparted, though from the world parted.
sa: viyogasāre saṃsāre priyeṇa prabhuṇā tvayā aviyuktaḥ sadaiva syāṃ jagatāpi viyojitaḥ

en: Wherever I go by body, speech, mind — all that is You alone: may this ultimate truth stand ever full for me.
l3:
Body, speech, mind — where I go with them, all is Thou alone.
May this highest truth stand full for me, ever.
sa: kāyavāṅmanasair yatra yāmi sarvaṃ tvam eva tat ity eṣa paramārtho 'pi paripūrṇo 'stu me sadā

en: As You are construction-free, great-bliss-full — so may my praise-speech become, just fitting.
l3:
Thought-free as Thou, great-bliss-full as Thou —
so may my praise-making speech match, and only match.
sa: nirvikalpo mahānandapūrṇo yadvad bhavāṃs tathā bhavatstutikarī bhūyād anurūpaiva vāṅ mama

en: Possessed by You, seeing thing after thing as consisting of You — may I roam desireless, joy-filled.
l3:
Held by Thee — seeing thing and thing Thou-made —
may I roam longing-free, joy-brimmed.
sa: bhavadāveśataḥ paśyan bhāvaṃ bhāvaṃ bhavanmayam vicareyaṃ nirākāṅkṣaḥ praharṣaparipūritaḥ

en: May I see the whole world full of Your being, Lord — by that alone content; then do not toil.
l3:
Lord, may I see the all-world full of Thy being —
with that alone content. Then — no more wearing.
sa: bhagavanbhavataḥ pūrṇam paśyeyam akhilaṃ jagat tāvataivāsmi santuṣṭas tato na parikhidyase

en: May things shine for me always, melting into You alone like cloud-bits in sky, moving toward ever-purer courses.
l3:
Melting in Thee alone — like cloud-shreds in sky —
may things shine for me, ever, step by step stainless.
sa: vilīyamānās tvayy eva vyomni meghalavā iva bhāvā vibhāntu me śaśvat kramanairmalyagāminaḥ

en: May there blaze for me, from Your middle, some jewel of Being — its self-light-spread destroying the endless dark-series.
l3:
Self-light outspread, shattering the endless dark-train —
shine for me ever: some jewel of Thy being, from Thy middle.
sa: svaprabhāprasaradhvastāparyantadhvāntasantatiḥ santataṃ bhātu me ko 'pi bhavamadhyād bhavanmaṇiḥ

en: What stage do You not rule, what could there be that is not Your body? Tired — by effortlessness may I reach You everywhere.
l3:
What ground rulest Thou not? What could it be, not Thy body? Weary —
thereby, by no-effort, may I win Thee everywhere.
sa: kāṃ bhūmikāṃ nādhiśeṣe kiṃ tat syād yan na te vapuḥ śrāntas tenāprayāsena sarvatas tvām avāpnuyām

en: May limb-embrace-enjoyment with You happen to me by mere will — this much gained, Lord, what have I not won?
l3:
Thy limb-embrace's joy — by my will alone may it befall me.
This much won — what, Lord, have I not won?
sa: bhavadaṅgapariṣvaṅgasambhogaḥ svecchayaiva me ghaṭatām iyati prāpte kiṃ nātha na jitaṃ mayā

en: Appear! We, Thine, tormented by no other prayers — fainting, we seek only You.
l3:
Show plain! With no other prayers importune we Thee, Lord —
fainting, Thee alone we hunt.
sa: prakaṭībhava nānyābhiḥ prārthanābhiḥ kadarthanāḥ kurmas te nātha tāmyantas tvām eva mṛgayāmahe

en: Having come to even-taste in You, bliss-river — may my mind drop at once this difference-based great disaster.
l3:
Come to same-sap in Thee, bliss-river —
may my mind drop in one go, Lord, this great disaster of difference-dependence.
sa: tvayy ānandasarasvati samarasatām etya nātha mama cetaḥ pariharatu sakṛd iyantaṃ bhedādhīnaṃ mahānartham

en: "This is mine, not this" — on passion-aversion's firm-nailed root may the axe fall inside: the certainty of oneness-with-You-made.
l3:
'Mine this, not that' —
on passion-hate's fetter-hard root, Lord, may the axe fall within: certainty of Thee-made-oneness.
sa: etan mama na tv idam iti rāgadveṣādinigaḍadṛḍhamūle nātha bhavanmayataikyapratyayaparaśuḥ patatvantaḥ

en: May the thought-stain-line melt; may unbarredness blaze in heart; bliss-rasa-flooded be my consciousness-body, Lord.
l3:
Melt, thought-stain-string; sport, unboltedness, in heart.
Bliss-sap-flooded be my knowing-made form, Lord.
sa: galatu vikalpakalaṅkāvalī samullasatu hṛdi nirargalatā bhagavann ānandarasaplutāstu me cinmayī mūrtiḥ

en: Me, rolled in the passion-made world-egg — may devotion-thought-mother feed me with rasas, till, wing-grown, I am a bird.
l3:
Me, wallowing in passion's world-egg —
O Thy-love-thought Mother, plump me with sap on sap, that wing-grown I turn sky-goer.
sa: rāgādimayabhavāṇḍakaluṭhitaṃ tvadbhaktibhāvanāmbikā tais taiḥ āpyāyayatu rasair māṃ pravṛddhapakṣo yathā bhavāmi khagaḥ

en: May this mind of mine gain skill in tasting the essence of Your foot-thought-nectar-rasa — ending all object-poison-clinging-longing.
l3:
May this mind of mine win connoisseurship —
savoring Thy-foot-thought-nectar-sap's pith — till sense-poison-clinging hankers no more.
sa: tvaccaraṇabhāvanāmṛtarasasārāsvādanaipuṇaṃ labhatām cittam idaṃ niḥśeṣitaviṣayaviṣāsaṅgavāsanāvadhi me

en: By devotion-sun-ray-touch, may this mind-jewel release far away passion-kindled fire-drops.
l3:
By Thy-love-sun's ray-touch may this mind-jewel
of mine shed far-off passion-kindled fire-sparks.
sa: tvadbhaktitapanadīdhitisaṃsparśavaśān mamaiṣa dūrataram cetomaṇir vimūñcaturāgādikataptavahnikaṇān

en: In that state may I praise You constantly, aloud — where even Hari, Indra, and Brahmā wait outside.
l3:
In that station may I hymn Thee ever, full-throated —
where Viṣṇu, Indra, Brahmā wait outside.
sa: tasmin pade bhavantaṃ satatam upaślokayeyam atyuccaiḥ hariharyaśvaviriñcā api yatra bahiḥ pratīkṣante

en: By devotion-madness-born frenzy may I see with faculties unmaimed: the whole world as Śiva, and all acts as worship-stuff.
l3:
By whirl born of love's whirl may I see, senses whole:
the all-world Śiva-made, all doings worship-made.
sa: bhaktimadajanitavibhramavaśena paśyeyam avikalaṃ karaṇaiḥ śivamayam akhilaṃ lokaṃ kriyāś ca pūjāmayī sakalāḥ

en: My mind-boy, having taken Your-devotion-family-maiden, having borne aṇimā-etc. sons — may she, firm-rooted, harden the mine-thought.
l3:
My mind-lad has wed Thy-love-clan's lady; she has borne him power-sons.
Firm-rooted, may she harden the 'mine'-thought.
sa: māmakamanogṛhītatvadbhaktikulāṅganāṇimādisutān sūtvā subaddhamūlā mameti buddhiṃ dṛḍhīkurutām

en: The grace-drop stationed in the Lord, and devotion come as if to meet me — when will the pair, joined, take root in such a body?
l3:
A grace-drop, Lord-abiding; devotion, as if, nearing me —
the two, each in other — when will they root in such a body?
sa: yaḥ prasādalava īśvarasthito yā ca bhaktir iva mām upeyuṣī tau parasparasamanvitau kadā tādṛśe vapuṣi rūḍhim eṣyataḥ

en: Born of chewing His lordship, may some inner joy-juice rise; here always be supreme for me — knowledge-yoga's glories far off.
l3:
Born of chewing Thy mastery whole —
may some contentment-sap rise within; ever here be highest for me — knowledge, yoga, glories far off.
sa: tvatprabhutvaparicarvaṇajanmā ko 'py udetu paritoṣaraso 'ntaḥ sarvakālam iha me param astu jñānayogamahimādi vidūre

en: Like the worldly, let my thirst for objects swell — only seeing them as Your body, unconstructed.
l3:
Worldlike be my thirst 'mid sense-things —
swollen full, utter, Lord. Only as Thy body may I behold them — I, thought-unbuilt.
sa: lokavadbhavatu me viṣayeṣu sphīta eva bhagavanparitarṣaḥ kevalaṃ tava śarīratayaitān lokayeyam aham astavikalpaḥ

en: In body-grounds and in mind, Lord, and in breath's course where difference has come — and in those consciousness-paths — thereby, by Your own self, be plain to me.
l3:
In body-grounds, in mind, Thou — where breath's run has met difference —
and on those knowing-paths: thereby, by Thine own self, be plain to me.
sa: dehabhūmiṣu tathā manasi tvaṃ prāṇavartmani ca bhedam upete saṃvidaḥ pathiṣu teṣu ca tena svātmanā mama bhava sphuṭarūpaḥ

en: May these thrilled faculties fall into their own seats — never, Lord, even slightly, the daring of non-difference-rupture.
l3:
May these thrilled sense-plays of mine fall each to its own seat —
never, Lord, not an instant, not a jot, the outrage: wounding Thy undifference-sap.
sa: nijanijeṣu padeṣu patantv imāḥ karaṇavṛttaya ullasitā mama kṣaṇamapīśa manāg api maiva bhūt tvadavibhedarasakṣatisāhasam

en: Light, soft, white-pure, cool — possessed by You, contemplating a body — may I exceed those dealings of the all-thing-road.
l3:
Light, soft, white, clear, cool — by Thy possession-force picturing a body —
may I stride past those dealings of the all-things' road.
sa: laghumasṛṇasitācchaśītalaṃ bhavadāveśavaśena bhāvayan vapur akhilapadārthapaddhater vyavahārān ativartayeya tān

en: May my self-body bloom as You; may worlds join my limbs; may all this duality-sport, even recalled, become untellable.
l3:
Bloom, my body, Thou-natured; come, worlds, to my limbhood. Pass, all this two-sport —
though on memory's road it come — to untellability.
sa: vikasatu svavapur bhavadātmakaṃ samupayāntu jaganti mamāṅgatām vrajatu sarvam idaṃ dvayavalgitaṃ smṛtipathopagame 'py anupākhyatām

en: May there rise, looking at such Yours, a flood of supreme nectar — so my filling of non-duality's dread gorge happens.
l3:
Rise — O glance at such a face of Thine! highest-nectar deluge —
befall me, till filled the dread gorge of Thy unshown oneness.
sa: samudiyād api tādṛśatāvakānana viloka parāmṛtasamplavaḥ mama ghaṭeta yathā bhavadadvayāprathanaghoradarīparipūraṇam

en: If ever by the thinnest union-drops — may I turn from all world-pleasures; or shall I be fallen from both?
l3:
If ever, dusted thinnest with Thy meeting-nectar-drops, I turn not from all world-joys —
or fallen from both — what then?
sa: api kadācana tāvakasaṅgamāmṛtakaṇācchuraṇena tanīyasā sakalalokasukheṣu parāṅmukho na bhavitāsmy ubhayacyuta eva kim

en: Ever at Your lotus-feet, of me the best hamsa moving in the lake — from above, from the root-depths, and from inside, may devotion's lotus-stalk bend up, unborn Lord.
l3:
I, choice hamsa, ever wading Thy foot-lotus-lake —
above, from root-depth, from within: bend up, love's lotus-stalk — O Unborn.
sa: satatam eva bhavaccaraṇāmbujākaracarasya hi haṃsavarasya me upari mūlatalād api cāntarād upanamatv aja bhaktimṛṇālikā

en: May all things come under thought's scope and vision's footing for me; may vision-thought-light-nectar-essences blaze supreme.
l3:
Come, All, all things —
'neath thought's reach, 'neath sight's footing for me; sight-thought-shine-nectar-piths — shimmer supreme.
sa: upayāntu vibho samastavastūny api cintāviṣayaṃ dṛśaḥ padaṃ ca mama darśanacintanaprakāśāmṛtasārāṇi paraṃ parisphurantu

en: Lord, in crashing hardships, as names bend down, may I be — fear gone only while limb-joined, exceeding-joy-mad.
l3:
High-Lord, in strait on strait, when names themselves bow down —
may I be not merely fear-gone, but, Thy limbs lending, joy-mad past measure.
sa: parameśvara teṣu teṣu kṛcchreṣv api nāmopanamatsv ahaṃ bhaveyam na paraṃ gatabhīs tvadaṅgasaṅgādupajātādhikasammado 'pi yāvat

en: The universe woven in Your self is shown outside by You alone — what stands firm-certain: may it now shine plain.
l3:
Woven in Thy self, the world — by Thee alone shown outside.
What hard resolve holds — now may it shine plain.
sa: bhavadātmani viśvam umbhitaṃ yad bhavataivāpi bahiḥ prakāśyate tat iti yad dṛḍhaniścayopajuṣṭaṃ tad idāniṃ sphuṭam eva bhāsatām

en: When will my mind, eager to taste new-rasa-moist union, rush past all else to Your touch?
l3:
When will my mind — keen to taste the wet-and-wet wedding of fresh sap —
rush past all else to Thy touch?
sa: kadā navarasārdrārdrasambhogāsvādanotsukam pravarteta vihāyānyan mama tvatsparśane manaḥ

en: You-loving, worship-wealthy — when shall I, the eager one, see You face to face?
l3:
Dyed with Thee alone, rich only in Thy foot-worship —
when shall I face Thee face to face, I, keen?
sa: tvadekaraktas tvatpādapūjāmātramahādhanaḥ kadā sākṣātkariṣyāmi bhavantam ayam utsukaḥ

en: When, by thick love made needless-minded, shall I burst all great bolts with a crash and reach You?
l3:
By thick love's force past-caring grown —
when, crash! all great bolts burst, shall I near Thee?
sa: gāḍhānurāgavaśato nirapekṣībhūtamānaso 'smi kadā paṭapaṭiti vighaṭitākhilamahārgalas tvām upaiṣyāmi

en: When, Lord, shall I subdue all gods — heart-seated in my own consciousness-essence — by devotion's power?
l3:
Heart-throned in my knowing's pith, all gods —
when, Lord, shall I bring 'neath my spell, by Thy love's might?
sa: svasaṃvitsārahṛdayādhiṣṭhānāḥ sarvadevatāḥ kadā nātha vaśīkuryāṃ bhavadbhaktiprabhāvataḥ

en: When will my vast devotion-bliss-rasa festival be — where even distinction gets a name from beholding-joy?
l3:
When be mine, All, love-bliss-sap's teeming feast —
where beholding-joy's bliss names even 'apart'?
sa: kadā me syād vibho bhūri bhaktyānandarasotsavaḥ yadālokasukhānandī pṛthaṅ nāmāpi lapsyate

en: Having suddenly recognized the fearless, generous, full, causeless, self-hidden Lord — when shall I shame Your people?
l3:
The Lord — fearless, lavish, full, causeless, self-denied —
known in a flash: when shall I shame the Master's men?
sa: īśvaram abhayam udāraṃ pūrṇam akāraṇam apahnutātmānaṃ sahasābhijñāya kadā svāmijanaṃ lajjayiṣyāmi

en: When, Lord, shall I attain whatever beloved-ness of Yours — that by which it would not befit You to flee from me anywhere?
l3:
When, Lord, win I that, whatever, Thy belovedness —
whereby from me nowhere flight were fit for Thee?
sa: kadā kām api tāṃ nātha tava vallabhatām iyām yayā māṃ prati na kvāpi yuktaṃ te syāt palāyitum

en: When shall I be bathed by the approving sight of all beings whose selves are Your worship?
l3:
All breathing things — truth-told —
Thy-worship-made selves: by their applauding-glance-sap flooded may I be — when, All?
sa: tattvato 'śeṣajantūnāṃ bhavatpūjāmayātmanām dṛṣṭyānumoditarasāplāvitaḥ syāṃ kadā vibho

en: Devotion, the highest ground of knowledge, the highest state of yoga — when will my begging for it be full?
l3:
Knowing's highest ground, yoga's highest pitch —
Thy love. All, when be my begging for it full?
sa: jñānasya paramā bhūmir yogasya paramā daśā tvadbhaktir yā vibho karhi pūrṇa me syāt tadarthitā

en: Seizing suddenly, holding hard, joy-overwhelmed — when shall I proclaim Your foot-treasure to all?
l3:
Seizing sudden, gripping hard, joy-helpless I —
when shall Thy foot-treasure-choice to all be shown?
sa: sahasaivasādya kadā gāḍham avaṣṭabhya harṣavivaśo 'ham tvaccaraṇavaranidhānaṃ sarvasya prakaṭayiṣyāmi

en: All-around pure-You-light-spread — when shall I so shine that no Māyā-shadow-cave is in me?
l3:
Round about Thy-pure-shine-spread —
when be I so, Ruler, no Māyā-shade-pit in me may be?
sa: paritaḥ prasaracchuddhatvadālokamayaḥ kadā syāṃ yatheśa na kiñcin me māyācchāyābilaṃ bhavet

en: Having made all circles my own, need-free — when shall I be, Lord, leader of Your devotee-host?
l3:
All circles made my own, past needing —
when, Lord, be I Thy lover-host's head?
sa: ātmasātkṛtaniḥśeṣamaṇḍalo nirvyapekṣakaḥ kadā bhaveyaṃ bhagavaṃs tvadbhaktagaṇanāyakaḥ

en: Lord, You are the unprecedented ground of world-prides — when shall I be greatly proud, filled with Your devotion-rasa?
l3:
Lord, of world-prides Thou the unheard ground —
great-pride when be I, Thy love-sap-filled?
sa: nātha lokābhimānānām apūrvaṃ tvaṃ nibandhanam mahābhimānaḥ karhi syāṃ tvadbhaktirasapūritaḥ

en: Well-set in never-object-empty glory-embrace — may I lie as if at Your cool lotus-feet pair — when?
l3:
Well-set in never-empty glory-embrace —
may I lie as at Thy cool foot-lotus-pair — when?
sa: aśeṣaviṣayāśūnyaśrīsamāśleṣasusthitaḥ śayīyam iva śītāṅghrikuśeśayayuge kadā

en: Of worship-wealth grown rich on devotion-liquor — when shall I reach the far shore, when be apt?
l3:
Thy worship-joy-wealth, rich with love-wine —
when fare I to its far shore, when be done?
sa: bhaktyāsavasamṛddhāyās tvatpūjābhogasampadaḥ kadā pāraṃ gamiṣyāmi bhaviṣyāmi kadā kṛtī

en: Tears first, stumbling, wandering, choked crying — laughing-lit face: when shall I get Your touch-rasa?
l3:
Tears first, tripping, reeling, choked-wailing —
laughter-lit face: Thy touch-sap when win I?
sa: ānandabāṣpapūraskhalitaparibhrāntagadgadākrandaḥ hāsollāsitavadanas tvatsparśarasaṃ kadāpsyāmi

en: Shaking off this beast-people-like conduct — when shall I, O Śambhu, taste the self-form fit for Your devotion?
l3:
This beast-folk-like state shaken off —
when, Kind One, taste I my self-shape, worthy Thy lovers?
sa: paśujanasamānavṛttām avadhūya daśām imāṃ kadā śambho āsvādayeya tāvakabhaktocitam ātmano rūpam

en: Siddhis gained, all heat-fear melted — when shall I play, devoted to drinking Your devotion-rasa-medicine?
l3:
Powers won, all fever-fear melted —
on Thy love-elixir-drink-play bent: when be I?
sa: labdhāṇimādisiddhir vigalitasakalopatāpasantrāsaḥ tvadbhaktirasāyanapānakriḍhāniṣṭaḥ kadāsīya

en: Lord, when shall that cry of mine rise in speech — at which Your form flashes before me at once?
l3:
Lord, when shall that wail of mine ring so in speech —
Thy shape straightway flashing before me?
sa: nātha kadā sa tathāvidha ākrando me samuccared vāci yat samanantaram eva sphurati puras tāvakī mūrtiḥ

en: Mind set on hugging Your tight-tight lotus-feet — when shall I see You, thing or non-thing, without effort?
l3:
Mind on clasping hard-hard Thy foot-lotuses, passion-bent —
thing, unthing, this — strainless, when full-behold I Thee?
sa: gāḍhagāḍhabhavadaṅghrisarojāliṅganavyasanatatparacetāḥ vastv avastv idam ayatnata eva tvāṃ kadā samavalokayitāsmi

en: Surely intolerable to You, sole world-Lord: Your Maheśvaras and other world-folk on one level.
l3:
Surely past bearing for Thee, sole world-Lord —
this: Thy Great-One's men levelled with other world-folk.
sa: na soḍhavyam avaśyam te jagadekaprabhor idam māheśvarāś ca lokānām itareṣāṃ samāś ca yat

en: Who always follow Your feet with love — wherever gone, they enjoy certain pleasures.
l3:
Who trail Thy feet ever with love —
go where-go, certain joys they savor.
sa: ye sadaivānurāgeṇa bhavatpādānugāminaḥ yatra tatra gatā bhogāṃs te kāṃś cid upabhuñjate

en: Where He is husband and death-ender, whence sickness? Where His fortune is, what other fortune?
l3:
Where Thou art husband, death-ender —
whence ache? Where Thine own fortune stands — what care for other joys?
sa: bhartā kālāntako yatra bhavāṃs tatra kuto rujaḥ tatra cetarabhogāśā kā lakṣmīr yatra tāvakī

en: By whose moment-pleasure the All is gained — for him all time fills with Your bliss.
l3:
By whom through a wink's joy the All is won —
at once all his time with Thy bliss is filled.
sa: kṣanamātrasukhenāpi vibhur yenāsi labhyase tadaiva sarvaḥ kālo 'sya tvadānandena pūryate

en: Moon: Your bliss-rasa drop fallen to earth; sun: Your destroyer-heat's spread spark.
l3:
Moon — Thy bliss-sap drop, fallen earthward. Sun likewise —
Thy forth-fared spark of world-burning heat.
sa: ānandarasabindus te candramā galito bhuvi sūryas tathā te prasṛtaḥ saṃhārī tejasaḥ kaṇaḥ

en: Offering to this third eye of Yours, Lord — sole mark of some unworldly greatness.
l3:
Offering bear we to this third eye of Thine, Lord —
sole badge of some unworldly greatness.
sa: baliṃ yāmas tṛtīyāya netrāyāsmai tava prabho alaukikasya kasyāpi māhātmyasyaikalakṣmaṇe

en: Seen by Him alone, one joys in Your vision-etc.; or whose joy somehow — by it You are seen.
l3:
Seen by Him alone — Thy-vision-and-Co. overjoys.
Or whose joy, somehow, some — thereby art Thou seen.
sa: tenaiva dṛṣṭo 'si bhavaddarśanādyo 'tihṛṣyati kathañcid yasya vā harṣaḥ ko 'pi tena tvam īkṣitaḥ

en: Those You're pleased with, whose hearts You've won — dragging from Your city, they've made the outer inner.
l3:
Whom Thou favorest, All, who have won Thy heart —
dragging from Thy city, the outside they in-make.
sa: yeṣām prasanno 'si vibho yair labdhaṃ hṛdayaṃ tava ākṛṣya tvatpurāttais tu bāhyam ābhyantarīkṛtam

en: Apart from You the whole world looks same-eyed — but its Īśvara is You alone, the Uneven-eyed.
l3:
Without Thee, let the all-world be seen gone same-eyed —
but this world's Ruler, Thou alone: Uneven-eyed.
sa: tvad ṛte nikhilaṃ viśvaṃ samadṛgyātam īkṣyatām īśvaraḥ punar etasya tvam eko viṣamekṣaṇaḥ

en: Leave aside: without Your power there is no being at all — and those whose denials of You don't stand without You.
l3:
Leave be: without Thy might, being itself is not —
and whose Thee-blaming talk without Thee holds not.
sa: āstāṃ bhavatprabhāveṇa vinā sattaiva nāsti yat tvaddūṣaṇakathā yeṣām tvad ṛte nopapadyate

en: If mind stood in You alone, barriers in-outside gone — what else would be needed, Lord?
l3:
Stood my mind in Thee alone, lonely, outer-inner-hindrance-free —
what else, All, avails?
sa: bāhyāntarāntarāyālīkevale cetasi sthitiḥ tvayi cet syān mama vibho kim anyad upayujyate

en: Others wander, Lord, in the self itself, ill-placed; others wander in the self itself, well-placed.
l3:
Others roam, Lord, in the self itself — ill-placed past measure.
Others roam, Lord, in the self itself — well-placed past measure.
sa: anye bhramanti bhagavann ātmany evātiduḥsthitāḥ anye bhramanti bhagavann ātmany evātisusthitāḥ

en: Even untasted Your devotion-nectar, unseen You — by mere conduct with You, beings perfect.
l3:
Thy love-nectar undrunk, Thyself unseen even, Ruler —
by mere Thy-company alone souls ripen.
sa: apītvāpi bhavadbhaktisudhām anavalokya ca tvām īśa tvatsamācāramātrāt siddhyanti jantavaḥ

en: We are Your servants, Lord — so as You bear Yourself for three worlds, bear us too, fully.
l3:
Thy slaves are we, All —
as Thou bearest Thyself for three worlds, to-be-borne by Thee are we too — fully.
sa: bhṛtyā vayaṃ tava vibho tena trijagatāṃ yathā bibharṣy ātmānam evaṃ te bharttavyā vayam apy alam

en: Though seen in supreme-bliss-nectar, in the world-self — for touch-rasa with You I hunger exceedingly.
l3:
Seen even in Thee — high-bliss-nectar, world-self —
for touch-sap I hunger past-past, Thine.
sa: parānandāmṛtamaye dṛṣṭo 'pi jagadātmani tvayi sparśarase 'tyantatarasutkaṇṭhito 'smi te

en: All sorrows even of worldlings — joined to Your ghee-self, become bearable.
l3:
God — all pains, even the passing-through's —
yoked to Thy ghee-named self, grow bearable.
sa: deva duḥkhāny aśeṣāṇi yāni saṃsāriṇām api ghṛtyākhyabhavadīyātmayutāny āyānti sahyatām

en: With You — omniscient, omnipotent, consciousness-formed — somehow the world's show, though unreal, is fitting.
l3:
Thou all-knowing, all-mighty, knowing-made —
somehow, Lord, this world's unreality-show is fit.
sa: sarvajñe sarvaśaktau ca tvayy eva sati cinmaye sarvathāpy asato nātha yuktāsya jagataḥ prathā

en: Breathed by You, qualities throb — even clod-like — dancing wind-tossed like cotton fluff.
l3:
By Thee breathed, these strands throb —
clod-like even — dancing wind-lifted, as cotton-fluff.
sa: tvatprāṇitāḥ sphurantīme guṇā loṣṭopamā api nṛtyanti pavanoddhūtāḥ kārpāsāḥ picavo yathā

en: If self-pride in qualities were not — then by what would the world's show of sole-selfness with You be lost?
l3:
If, Lord, in strands no I-pride were —
whereby would the world lose its Thou-alone-self-show?
sa: yadi nātha guṇeṣv ātmābhimāno na bhavet tataḥ kena hīyeta jagatas tvadekātmatayā prathā

en: Venerable even the dissolved great ones, purified by Your anger-fire-touch.
l3:
Praised, even the great ones gone to dissolving —
Thy-anger-fire-touch-pure, High-Lord.
sa: vandyās te 'pi mahīyāṃsaḥ pralayopagatā api tvatkopapāvakasparśapūtā ye parameśvara

en: With Your broad-light body standing plain — Lord, why do I spread in darkness on all sides?
l3:
Thy great-light body standing plain —
on all sides, Ruler, why in dark range I?
sa: mahāprakāśavapuṣi vispaṣṭe bhavati sthite sarvato 'pīśa tat kasmāt tamasi prasarāmy aham

en: You alone undivided, my nectar-nature — yet of mortal natures I alone am the seat.
l3:
Undivided, Thou alone —
my nectar-nature. Yet of mortal ways I the one seat.
sa: avibhāgo bhavān eva svarūpam amṛtaṃ mama tathāpi martyadharmāṇām aham evaikam āspadam

en: Whose speech-ornament is the name "Maheśvara," whose head bears the bow-mark — he alone is powerful.
l3:
Whose speech-jewel is 'Great-Lord,' bow-brand on brow —
he alone is mighty.
sa: maheśvareti yasyāsti nāmakaṃ vāgvibhūṣaṇam praṇāmāṅkaś ca śirasi sa evaikaḥ prabhāvitaḥ

en: Since You are being and non-being — then effortlessly, by own tune, Lord, why is accomplishment not mine?
l3:
Being, unbeing — Thou alone. So effortless, by own sap alone, Lord —
why is ripening not mine?
sa: sadasac ca bhavān eva yena tenāprayāsataḥ svarasenaiva bhagavaṃs tathā siddhiḥ kathaṃ na me

en: Śiva's slave, Śiva-selfed — what joy would he not reach? I am sated by nectar-wines even of chief gods.
l3:
Śiva's slave, Śiva-one-self — what joy wins he not?
Chief gods themselves drink I sate with nectar-wines.
sa: śivadāsaḥ śivaikātmā kiṃ yan nāsādayet sukham tarpyo 'smi devamukhyānām api yenāmṛtāsavaiḥ

en: Between heart and navel, beings' bile-bodied — You devour, great fire, all moving-unmoving.
l3:
Heart-navel-between, breathers' bile-bodied —
Thou eaterest, great fire, all still, all moving.
sa: hṛnnābhyor antarālasthaḥ prāṇināṃ pittavigrahaḥ grasase tvaṃ mahāvahniḥ sarvaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam

en: This world, or friends, or kin — nothing is mine at all; but when You are all this, who else is mine?
l3:
This world, or friends, or kin —
naught of mine. But Thou art all this again — then who else be mine?
sa: jagad idam athavā suhṛdo bandhujano vā na bhavati mama kim api tvaṃ punar etat sarvaṃ yadā tadā ko 'paro me 'stu

en: "Master, Maheśvara, You directly — all the world is You alone" — may the thing itself succeed; and begging even in that is mere begging.
l3:
'Master, Great-Lord — Thou outright; all the world Thee alone' —
may the thing itself ripen: this the begging — and therein begging alone.
sa: svāmin maheśvaras tvaṃ sākṣāt sarvaṃ jagat tvam eveti vastv eva siddhim etv iti yācñā tatrāpi yācñaiva

en: Even world-overlordship here seems straw to Your devotee; what fruit has good karma, Lord, without Your remembrance?
l3:
Three-worlds-lordship even here seems straw to Thy partaker.
What fruit has fair-deed, Lord, parted from remembering Thee?
sa: tribhuvanādhipatitvam apīha yat tṛṇam iva pratibhāti bhavajjuṣaḥ kim iva tasya phalaṃ śubhakarmaṇo bhavati nātha bhavatsmaraṇād ṛte

en: Since nothing at all is apart from You, world-cause — Your play is wondrous, yet no praise takes hold.
l3:
Since naught of worlds nor world-birth is parted from Thee —
Thy unfolding: 'mid marvel-deeds even rises no praise-weaving of Thee.
sa: yena naiva bhavato 'sti vibhinnaṃ kiñcanāpi jagatāṃ prabhavaś ca tvadvijṛmbhitam ato 'dbhutakarmasv apy udeti na tava stutibandhaḥ

en: "I am Yours, worship-bound" — always, unceasing, even by own tune, and in dream — why am I not so?
l3:
'Thine-made am I, Thy-worship-bound' —
ever, unceasing picturing, All, by own sap — dream-goer even: why am I not so?
sa: tvanmayo 'smi bhavadarcananiṣṭhaḥ sarvadāham iti cāpy avirāmam bhāvayann api vibho svarasena svapnago 'pi na tathā kim iva syām

en: Who are touched even slightly by Your lotus-foot-born fragrance-dust — for them all enjoyed things, gods-sought, become rest.
l3:
Brushed by a jot even — Thy-foot-lotus-born scent-speck —
for them rest-like turns all joy-kind, gods-hunted even.
sa: ye manāg api bhavaccaraṇābjodbhūtasaurabhalavena vimṛṣṭaḥ teṣu visram iva bhavati samastaṃ bhogajātam amarair api mṛgyam

en: In heart nothing other than Thee; in word and deed wholly other, O Śambhu — yet whether grace or restraint from the truly Real: one work only.
l3:
Heart: naught but Thee. Word and deed: wholly else, Kind One.
From the truly Real — grace or curb: one alone be wrought.
sa: hṛdi te na tu vidyate 'nyad anyad vacane karmaṇi cānyad eva śaṃbho paramārthasato 'py anugraho vā yadi vā nigraha eka eva kāryaḥ

en: Fool am I, suffering-laden, aging-fearful, powerless — Yours am I: Śambhu, so arrange that, past sorrow's road, I mount the highest yoke fast.
l3:
Dull am I, pain-laden am I, age-fearing am I, power-bare am I —
Thine-sheltered am I. Kind One, so ordain: swift I near the highest yoke, sorrow-road-forsaken.
sa: mūḍho 'smi duḥkhakalito 'smi jarādidoṣabhīto 'smi śaktirahito 'smi tavāśrito 'smi śambho tathā kalaya śīghram upaimi yena sarvottamāṃ dhuram apojjhitaduḥkhamārgaḥ

en: Lying at Your ear-place, my cries, trifling — become like water-drops in bamboo-joints turning pearl.
l3:
Couched at Thy ear-place, my wails, most trifling, take high worth —
as reed-joint-fallen water-specks wear pearlhood.
sa: tvatkarṇadeśama dhiśayya mahārghabhāvam ākranditāni mama tucchatarāṇi yānti vaṃśāntarālapatitāni jalaikadeśakhaṇḍāni mauktikamaṇitvam ivodvahanti

en: What is not gained, alas, even by those — Lord — who even by deceit delight a moment in Your name?
l3:
What, pray, is unwon, alas — even by such as dote a wink, by cheat even, on Thy name?
Cool-ray-crested, so do that death-wounded I near power-and-Co. as glory.
sa: kim iva ca labhyate bata na tair api nātha janaiḥ kṣaṇam api kaitavād api ca ye tava nāmni ratāḥ śiśiramayūkhaśekhara tathā kuru yena mama kṣatamaraṇo 'ṇimādikam upaimi yathā vibhavam

en: Śambhu Śarva moon-crested Śiva, three-eyed rosary-bearer, fierce-skulled, trident-armed, ocean of pity, world-builder by fierce power, blue-throated — destroy ill-fortune fast, give supreme success.
l3:
Kind One! Śarva! Moon-crested! Śiva! Three-eyed rosary-wearing! Glorious! Fierce-skull-signed! Grim-trident-flashing! Pity-sea!
Worlds-weaving-natured! Fierce-power-formed! Fair-throated! — swift destroy ill-luck's loads; lay on high Thine own ripening.
sa: śambho śarva śaśaṅkaśekhara śiva tryakṣākṣamālādhara śrīmann ugrakapālalāñchana lasadbhīmatriśūlāyudha kāruṇyāmbunidhe trilokaracanāśīlograśaktyātmaka śrīkaṇṭhāśu vināśayāśubhabharān ādhat svasiddhiṃ parām

en: What would there be where the Lord does not make? What would the knower Śaṅkara destroys be? Thus, ever sheltered in Thee, O Lord of unwasted great power — in this saṃsāra, ceaseless in anguish, I suffer alone.
l3:
What, Lord, would not be, where the Lord wins not makerhood? What being had the knower, unmade by Kind-Maker?
Thus ever sheltered in Thee — unwaning great power's High-Lord — here in passing, pang-thickened, I ail — alone.
sa: tat kiṃ nātha bhaven na yatra bhagavān nirmātṛtām aśnute bhāvaḥ syāt kim u tasya cetanavato nāśāsti yaṃ śaṅkaraḥ itthaṃ te parameśvarākṣatamahāśakteḥ sadā saṃśritaḥ saṃsāre 'tra nirantarādhividhuraḥ kliśyāmy ahaṃ kevalam

en: Though pains, age, death here are boon-givers most haughty, and approved sounds unstable — yet I long, ever-pleasure-hungering, to stand long tasting Your feet for life-drink.
l3:
Though pains, age, death here — haughtiest boon-lords — bide a wink; approved, sense-and-Co. unstable ever —
yet I hanker, ever-joy-hungering, to stand long for life-drink: joy-taste-yoked Thy-foot-lotus-thought, first.
sa: yady apy atra varapradoddhatatamāḥ pīḍājarāmṛtyava ete vā kṣaṇam āsatāṃ bahumataḥ śabdādir evāsthiraḥ tatrāpi spṛhayāmi santatasukhākāṅkṣī ciraṃ sthāsnave bhogāsvādayutatvadaṅghrikamaladhyānāgrya jīvātave

en: O Lord skilled at destroying the bowed-down's pain, treasure of good, matted one — act now so that, living, I win unshakable attainments, Your-worship-bound.
l3:
O Lord — skilled smasher of the bent one's pangs, weal-hoard, Matted-haired —
of me, pain's sole seat, birth-death-frighted, now so act: living even, Thy-worship-bound, I win unshaken ripenings, sweet-sense-taste-yielding, high.
sa: he nātha praṇatārtināśanapaṭo śreyonidhe dhūrjaṭe duḥkhaikāyatanasya janmamaraṇatrastasya me sāmpratam tac ceṣṭasva yathā manojñaviṣayāsvādapradā uttamā jīvann eva samaśnuve 'ham acalāḥ siddhīs tvadarcāparaḥ

en: Bow to delusion-great-darkness-destroyer whose sole work is that, to over-bright light moon-marked.
l3:
Bow to delusion's great-gloom-smasher of no other work —
to all-light-outshining light, moon-badged.
sa: namo mohamahādhvāntadhvaṃsanānanyakarmaṇe sarvaprakāśātiśayaprakāśāyendulakṣmaṇe

en: No helper is wanted at all, no hinderer is seen in Your vision — yet all is flooded by You alone: how is it even so that You do not see?
l3:
No helper wanted for finding Thee, no bar to sight —
by Thee alone all is flooded. How, even now, still art Thou unseen?
sa: sahakāri na kiñcid iṣyate bhavato na pratibandhakaṃ dṛṣi bhavataiva hi sarvam āplutaṃ katham adyāpi tathāpi nekṣase

en: From things, senses, awareness-middle, ever self-born — may I see Him, world-veiled.
l3:
From thing-throng, sense-heap, thought's middle even —
the ever self-arising may I full-behold: world-doffed.
sa: api bhāvagaṇād apīndriyapracayād apy avabodhamadhyataḥ prabhavantam api svataḥ sadā paripaśyeyam apoḍhaviśvakam

en: How could things come to be, and how reach Your path of vision, inlaid by what great nature-limb? Rising and rising, from land-water-grass on, You scatter nectar-floods of creation over all things.
l3:
How be things born, how walk Thy seeing-road — inlaid with what great nature-limb?
Rising and rising, from land, water, grass on, Thou scatterest creation's trickle-nectar-floods over all.
sa: kathaṃ te jāyeran katham api ca te darśanapathaṃ vrajeyuḥ kenāpi prakṛtimahatāṅkena khacitaḥ tathotthāyotthāya sthalajalatṛṇāder akhilataḥ padārthadyānsṛṣṭisravadamṛtapūrair vikirasi

en: Sated with Your form-nectar, thirst uprooted, drunk — they wander at will.
l3:
Faced with Thy form-fared nectar, sated —
thirst uprooted, heady — they roam to taste.
sa: sākṣatkṛta bhavadrūpaprasṛtāmṛtatarpitāḥ unmūlitatṛṣo mattā vicaranti yathāruci

en: Not then, not always, not once — where no time-thought is: such is Your vision, neither eternal nor otherwise.
l3:
Not then, not ever, not once even —
where no time-thought be: that, this Thy seeing — nor told eternal, nor else.
sa: na tadā na sadā na caikadety api sā yatra na kāladhīr bhavet tad idaṃ bhavadīyadarśanaṃ na ca nityaṃ na ca kathyate 'nyathā

en: May my mind, risen to see You, gain this yoga-fruit always: to enter Your nectar-house by mere resolve, for Your worship.
l3:
Mind risen to see Thee — be this much my yoga-ripe, ever:
that by bare resolve I enter Thy nectar-house, to worship Thee.
sa: tvadvilokanasamutkacetaso yogasiddhir iyatī sadāstu me yad viśeyam abhisandhimātratas tvatsudhāsadanam arcanāya te

en: The clear-minded great ones' pure play and words shine plainly, playfully.
l3:
Mind-blown by winning Thy doubt-free seeing —
great souls: sport stainless their deeds and words, lightly, plain.
sa: nirvikalpabhavadīyadarśanapraptiphullamanasāṃ mahātmanām ullasanti vimalāni helayā ceṣṭitāni ca vacāṃsi ca sphuṭam

en: Dwelling between Your feet, fearless — in those and those world-grounds may I worship the Lord, unbarred in act.
l3:
Dwelling 'tween Thy feet, within indeed, fearless —
on being-grounds those and those may I worship the Lord, unbolted in deed.
sa: bhavanbhavadīyapādayor nivasann antara eva nirbhayaḥ bhavabhūmiṣu tāsu tāsv ahaṃ prabhum arceyam anargalakriyaḥ

en: Dissolved in Your foot-lake, melted seeking, honey-drunk to excess — may I roam satisfied, at will.
l3:
In Thy foot-lotus's belly dissolved, melted of other-longing —
honey-overmuch, sated, may I roam at will.
sa: bhavadaṅghrisaroruhodare parilīno galitaparaiṣaṇaḥ atimātramadhūpayogataḥ paritṛpto vicareyam icchayā

en: Whose resolve to worship You arose even from pretense — to him too, assuredly, has arisen Thy fitting presence.
l3:
Whose resolve to worship Thee rose from sham even —
for him too, needs must, dawns Thy fit nearness.
sa: yasya dambhād iva bhavatpūjāsaṅkalpa utthitaḥ tasyāpy avaśyam uditaṃ sannidhānaṃ tavocitam

en: Lord, with one-taste mind seeking nothing else — the all-laying Lord, easy — may I drink my fill: what am I?
l3:
Lord — mind past others-hoping, one-sapped utterly —
the easy, all-outlying Lord to sating may I drink. What am I?
sa: bhagavann itarān apekṣiṇā nitarām ekarasena cetasā sulabhaṃ sakalopaśāyinaṃ prabhum ātṛpti pibeyam asmi kim

en: By You denied: all where You're absent is to be left; where it's You, to be taken — this is the essence-extract.
l3:
By Thee unmade — all where Thou art not: leave it.
Thou-made: take it up. This, the pith-gist.
sa: tvayā nirākṛtam sarvaṃ heyam etat tad eva tu tvanmayaṃ samupādeyam ity ayaṃ sārasaṃgrahaḥ

en: The world-born, moving inside Thee, is worshipped as chief through its coming-forth — how, Lord, could mere non-being outside Thee be worshipped, and by whom?
l3:
Thy in-dwelling thing-born — worshiped as chief by coming-forth.
Outside Thee, mere unbeing — how, Ruler, could it be, or be worshiped?
sa: bhavato 'ntaracāri bhāvajātaṃ prabhuvanmukhyatayaiva pūjitaṃ tat bhavato bahir apy abhāvamātrā katham īśān bhavet samarcyate vā

en: Noiseless, thought-free, undistracted, always — in agitation too, face to face: I see You alone everywhere, Three-eyed.
l3:
Soundless, doubtless, distractionless —
ever. In churn even, face to face — Three-eyed, Thee alone, everywhere.
sa: niḥśabdaṃ nirvikalpaṃ ca nirvyākṣepam athānisam kṣobhe 'py adhyakṣamī kṣeyaṃ tryakṣa tvām eva sarvataḥ

en: Reveal Your abode where You ever are with the Goddess; foot-dust-ranked servants — why do they look faithless?
l3:
Show Thine own seat, God — where Thou art ever Goddess-joined.
Foot-dust-ranked with the Lord, why seem slaves unbelief's ground?
sa: prakaṭaya nijadhāma deva yasmiṃs tvam asi sadā parameśvarīsametaḥ prabhucaraṇarajaḥsamānakakṣyāḥ kim aviśvāsapadaṃ bhānti bhṛtyāḥ

en: Come to path's seeing yet fled — whence, Lord, to me Your servant? Never for a moment here are You not every being's sight-object.
l3:
Come to seeing's road, yet Thou slippest —
whence from me, my Ruler, Thy slave? Not a wink here art Thou not each breather's sight-mark.
sa: darśanapatham upayāto 'py apasarasi kuto mameśa bhṛtyasya kṣaṇamātrakam iha na bhavasi kasya na jantor dṛśor viṣayaḥ

en: When, Lord, with oneness-nectar's pure unbroken stream wilt Thou flood me — that beyond the flood, bringing non-difference, I may gain Thee and my own body, joyfully?
l3:
By oneness-knowing-nectar's clear unbroken current —
when, All? From the flood, past it, undifference fetching — Thee and my own frame may I win, glad.
sa: aikyasaṃvidamṛtācchadhārayā santataprasṛtayā kadā vibho plāvanāt paramabhedamānayaṃs tvāṃ nijaṃ ca vapur āpnuyāṃ mudam

en: From my understanding fenced off from yonder world, a grain of world-establishment — that I be worshipped by You.
l3:
'I' — from the fenced-off world, from Thy realization-pith —
a grain even of world-groundedness befall me, whereby worshiped by Thee may I be.
sa: aham ity amuto 'varuddhalokād bhavadīyāt pratipattisārato me aṇumātrakam eva viśvaniṣṭhaṃ ghaṭatāṃ yena bhaveyam arcitā te

en: Seeing every thing each moment, O form beyond measure — may I see You well, my own Lord.
l3:
Measureless-shaped — thing and thing, wink by wink beholding —
Thee alone, world-shaped, my own Lord, may I well behold.
sa: aparimitarūpam ahaṃ taṃ taṃ bhāvaṃ pratikṣaṇaṃ paśyan tvām eva viśvarūpaṃ nijanāthaṃ sādhu paśyeyam

en: Why doesn't mind haunt what limbs love, the desired thing for desire? If no nature is harmed and my supreme wish is filled...
l3:
Gone to Thy limbs — why roams not mind after liked thing for thing?
Nature unwronged — and my wish filled wholly supreme.
sa: bhavadaṅgagataṃ tam eva kasmān na manaḥ paryaṭatīṣṭam artham artham prakṛtikṣatir asti no tathāsya mama cecchā paripūryate paraiva

en: Hundreds, they say, by Your power, with this very eye — even plough-walking — always see Your body ahead.
l3:
Hundreds, they say, by Thy might, Lord —
who with this very eye, even plough-gaited roaming, full-behold Thy body ever before.
sa: śataśaḥ kila te tavānubhāvād bhagavan ke 'py amunaiva cakṣuṣā ye api hālikaceṣṭayā carantaḥ paripaśyanti bhavadvapuḥ sadāgre

en: No thought rises unstained by Your will; always good or else — thus I roam as Yours on earth, feast of Your foot unstopped.
l3:
No thought rises unmade of Thy will; fair ever, or else, by the Lord so 'tis wrought.
So Thine-natured, earth-roaming as may be, standing ever at Thy unstopped stainless-foot-feast.
sa: na sā matir udeti yā na bhavati tvadicchāmayī sadā śubham athetarad bhagavataivam ācaryate ato 'smi bhavadātmako bhuvi yathā tathā sañcaran sthi to 'niśam abādhitatvadamalaṅghripūjotsavaḥ

en: May insight rise well in Your deep sayings; then practiced power too, and unpausing worship-addiction.
l3:
'Mid Thy deep sayings may insight rise for me full, first —
then wrought power too, and Thy-worship-passion unpausing.
sa: bhavadīyagabhīrabhāṣiteṣu pratibhā samyag udetu me puro 'taḥ tadanuṣṭhitaśaktir apy atas tadbhavadarcāvyasanaṃ ca nirvirāmam

en: In dealings too, always, may this sense-heap appear to me as Your limb — not self-warranted.
l3:
On dealing-ground even, ever, may this thing-heap dawn for me as Thy limb —
not as self-worthy come.
sa: vyavahārapade 'pi sarvadā pratibhātv arthakalāpa eṣa mām bhavato 'vayavo yathā na tu svata evādaraṇīyatāṃ gataḥ

en: Mind roaming freely in its fields, unswerving — may I ever be worship-skilled toward You.
l3:
Mind by own sap roaming where-go —
I in its ranges, strayed even, unswerving still, Thy-tending-skilled may I ever be.
sa: manasi svarasena yatra tatra pracaraty apy aham asya gocareṣu prasṛto 'py avilola eva yuṣmatparicaryācaturaḥ sadā bhaveyam

en: Lord, by Your will alone Your slave I was made — another's no power here — yet why never see Your face-moon?
l3:
Lord, by Thy will alone Thy slave am I born —
no other's force here. How then Thy face-orb see I never? Strange, this.
sa: bhagavan bhavadicchayaiva dāsas tava jāto 'smi parasya nātra śaktiḥ katham eṣa tathāpi vaktrabimbaṃ tava paśyāmi na jātu citram etat

en: The eager toward You who face You as counter-form — ah, what would befall them, what practice would fruit for them?
l3:
The keen toward Thee who behold Thee from counter-stance —
ah! what has drawn near them, what practice fruited?
sa: samutsukās tvāṃ prati ye bhavantaṃ pratyartharūpād avalokayanti teṣām aho kiṃ tadupasthitaṃ syāt kiṃ sādhanaṃ vā phalitaṃ bhavet tat

en: May things be as things by Your being for me; thus may nothing be otherwise, nothing but You.
l3:
Things be as things by Thy being, for me.
So be naught elsewise — naught but Thine.
sa: bhāvā bhāvatayā santu bhavadbhāvena me bhava tathā na kiñcid apy astu na kiñcid bhavato 'nyathā

en: May nothing-at-all be nothing, something-at-all be something to me; in all ways may You be worship-received.
l3:
What is naught at all, be naught at all; something at all, be something indeed for me.
In all ways be — thereby Thou everywhere art won-and-worshiped.
sa: yan na kiñcid api tanna kiñcid apy astu kiñcid api kiñcid eva me sarvathā bhavatu tāvatā bhavān sarvato bhavati labdhapūjitaḥ

en: In brief, Lord, hear how pleasure and pain stand for me: meeting You is pleasure; being parted from You, my Lord, is pain.
l3:
In brief, Lord —
hear my pain-joy-mark: joy is this, meeting Thee; parted from the Master — pain.
sa: saṃgrahena sukhaduḥkhalakṣaṇaṃ māṃ prati sthitam idaṃ śṛṇu prabho saukhyam eṣa bhavatā samāgamaḥ svāminā viraha eva duḥkhitā

en: Even the subtlest inward moment when You do not appear — wipe it out everywhere, Lord, and reveal Your own stainless form.
l3:
Inside even, past-past minute — the Thee-unshowing black in me:
her too, Ruler, wipe from all sides; Thine own stainless shape show.
sa: antar apy atitarām aṇīyasī yā tvadaprathanakālikāsti me tām apīśa parimṛjya sarvataḥ svaṃ svarūpam amalaṃ prakāśaya

en: Let me live or die or be anything else — if only I abide, always worshipping, in Your world-full body at undying consciousness-nectar time.
l3:
In Thy frame — world-filled, knowing-nectar-sapped, unending —
abiding, ever worshiping the Lord: live, die, else — be mine.
sa: tāvake vapuṣi viśvanirbhare citsudhārasamaye niratyaye tiṣṭhataḥ satatam arcataḥ prabhuṃ jīvitaṃ mṛtam athānyad astu me

en: "I am the Lord, I alone am formed, learned, fortunate — who else is parallel to me in the world?" Such pride shines supreme in Your lovers.
l3:
'Lord am I — I shapely indeed, learned, loved —
who else? my like in the world?' — so shines pride, Thy lovers', highly.
sa: īśvaro 'ham aham eva rūpavān paṇḍito 'smi subhago 'smi ko 'paraḥ matsamo 'sti jagatīti śobhate mānitā tvadanurāgiṇaḥ param

en: By the awareness of things exactly as they stand, make me fit for worshipping Your feet — me, born of telling non-duality's nectar that swallows renown.
l3:
God of gods — birth won me from telling Thy non-dual nectar that swallows fame.
So by things-just-as-they-stand-knowing make me foot-worship-fit.
sa: devadeva bhavadadvayāmṛtākhyātisaṃharaṇalabdhajanmanā tad yathāsthitapadārthasaṃvidā māṃ kuruṣva caraṇārcanocitam

en: Meditated upon, then seen, then the Lord Himself is touched. May this worship-festival of Yours be always mine, by Your power.
l3:
Thought on, then seen, then touched — the High Lord Himself.
Where worship's high feast is, be mine ever, by Thy might.
sa: dhyāyate tad anu dṛśyate tataḥ spṛśyate ca parameśvaraḥ svayam yatra pūjanamahotsavaḥ sa me sarvadāstu bhavato 'nubhāvataḥ

en: Seeing things as they stand, and Your worship-festival — this pair grounds each other, expanding always among devotees.
l3:
Things-as-they-stand-seeing and Thy-worship-high-feast —
this pair, each-other-grounded, in lovers ever unfolds.
sa: yady athāsthitapadārthadarśanaṃ yuṣmadarcanamahotsavaś ca yaḥ yugmam etad itaretarāśrayaṃ bhaktiśāliṣu sadā vijṛmbhate

en: Through every sense-door, constantly, may I drink the wine of Your worship-rasa in all-filled feeling-cups — and be mad.
l3:
By each sense-mouth, ever, Thy-worship-sap-elixir-wine —
in all-thing-cups filled, drinking even, may I be mad.
sa: tattadindriyamukhena santataṃ yuṣmadarcanarasāyanāsavam sarvabhāvacaṣakeṣu pūriteṣv āpibann api bhaveyam unmadaḥ

en: Where not an atom is felt as other, and all expands self-shining — there, Lord, keep me standing, Your constant worshipper, in Your city.
l3:
Other-known, grain even, is not; self-shown, all unfolds.
Where, Lord, in Thy city stands — there make me ever Thine honorer.
sa: anyavedyam aṇumātram asti na svaprakāśam akhilaṃ vijṛmbhate yatra nātha bhavataḥ pure sthitaṃ tatra me kuru sadā tavārcituḥ

en: Though You posted even me to slaves' quarters by Your own will — am I not fit by seeing, even by foot-massage?
l3:
To slave-quarters posted even, by Thine own will, High Lord —
by beholding am I not vesseled, or by foot-rubbing work even?
sa: dāsadhāmni viniyojito 'py ahaṃ svecchayaiva parameśvara tvayā darśanena na kim asmi pātritaḥ pādasaṃvahanakarmaṇāpi vā

en: At the moment of grace's descent You never deliberate, Lord, never — so what has come over You now, delaying the rite of Your self-revelation to me?
l3:
At power's-fall time, weighing — come to it — Thou doest never, Ruler.
Today toward me what has come, that in self-showing-rite Thou lingerest?
sa: śaktipātasamaye vicāraṇaṃ prāptam īśa na karoṣi karhicit adya māṃ prati kim āgataṃ yataḥ svaprakāśanavidhau vilambase

en: In each object shining outside, and inside joined with the Goddess, may I always behold You, world-full — worshipped by my own hands.
l3:
There and there, in things, shining without — within, high-Goddess-yoked —
Thee, three-worlds-filled, ever may I behold, by mine own hands worshiped.
sa: tatra tatra viṣaye bahirvibhāty antare ca parameśvarīyutam tvāṃ jagattritayanirbharaṃ sadā lokayeya nijapāṇipūjitam

en: May I always mount the Master's palace, unobstructed, by mere resolve — bliss-freed in the play of drinking supreme-nectar-wine.
l3:
The Master's palace — by bare resolve, unbarred, climbed —
ever may I be rest, won in grace's high-nectar-wine-drink-sport.
sa: svāmisaudham abhisandhimātrato nirvibandham adhiruhya sarvadā syāṃ prasāda paramāmṛtāsavāpānakeliparilabdhanirvṛtiḥ

en: Whatever wonder arises in all fair things by mere touch — by that the unwavering worship Your body.
l3:
What in all fair-thing-things, by touch-bare-rite, relish —
that offering up, thereby Thy frame worship the steady-loved.
sa: yatsamastasubhagārthavastuṣu sparśamātravidhinā camatkṛtim tāṃ samarpayati tena te vapuḥ pūjayanty acalabhaktiśālinaḥ

en: Swelling all by Thyself, shining — You touch the universe, touching form; whatever whirls by its own juice — that is the swelling world.
l3:
Thou widenest all by Thyself, flashing; the world Thou touchest, touching shape.
What of itself in Thine own sap whirls — that sports, the thing-ring.
sa: sphārayasy akhilam ātmanā sphuran viśvam āmṛśasi rūpam āmṛśan yat svayaṃ nijarasena ghurṇase tat samullasati bhāvamaṇḍalam

en: Who sees this whole object-circle without construction as Your body, Lord — the world filled with his own self's side — for him, ever-happy, whence fear?
l3:
Who doubt-free this thing-ring beholds, Ruler — all Thy frame —
in self-side-filled world, for him ever-glad, whence fear?
sa: yo 'vikalpam idam arthamaṇḍalaṃ paśyatīśa nikhilaṃ bhavadvapuḥ svātmapakṣaparipūrite jagaty asya nityasukhinaḥ kuto bhayam

en: The kālakūṭa poison set in Your throat's corner is great nectar to me; even taken nectar, if difference prevails, does not please me.
l3:
Throat-nook-nestled, Ruler, Thy black-poison even is high-nectar to me.
Taken nectar even — Thy frame in difference-mode — please me it does not.
sa: kaṇṭhakoṇaviniviṣṭam īśa te kālakūṭam api me mahāmṛtam apy upāttam amṛtaṃ bhavadvapur bhedavṛtti yadi rocate na me

en: Graced with song-mouths lovely with prattling of You, may I be — my heart forever gone to what Your worship-loving prefers.
l3:
Lovely ditties made of Thy prattle —
mouth graced with fitting may I be; ever heart gone to what Thy worship-doing loves.
sa: tvatpralāpamayaraktagītikāni tya yuktavadanopaśobhitaḥ syām athāpi bhavadarcanakriyāpreyasīparigatāśayaḥ sadā

en: Alas, the Supreme's play cannot be counted — and so the nectar-full body He gave me, He does not let me drink — so it is.
l3:
Willed — ah! — of the High Lord, count it none can.
And my given nectar-teeming frame — drink it He sanctions not.
sa: īhitaṃ na bata pārameśvaraṃ śakyate gaṇayituṃ tathā ca me dattam apy amṛtanirbharaṃ vapuḥ svaṃ na pātum anumanyate tathā

en: Entering You — fathomless, construction-free, non-dual, devourer of all things' meaning — O Umā's Lord, may I always worship and praise.
l3:
Thee — bottomless, doubt-free, two-free, Thine own shape, all-thing-devouring —
entering, I, Umā's Lord, ever worship and high-praise.
sa: tvām agādham avikalpam advayaṃ svaṃ svarūpam akhilārthaghasmaram āviśann aham umeśa sarvadā pūjayeyam abhisaṃstuvīya ca

en: Before my own master, treasure of victory-fortune — may I taste for a moment the nectar of victory-proclamation.
l3:
Before mine own master — victory-fortune's treasure —
may I taste a wink the victory-shout's nectar-sap.
sa: jayalakṣmīnidhānasya nijasya svāminaḥ puraḥ jayodghoṣaṇapīyūṣarasam āsvādaye kṣaṇam

en: Victory: one Rudra, one Śiva, great god, great Lord — Pārvatī's lover, Śarva, eldest of all gods.
l3:
Hail: Rudra the One, Śiva the One, Great God, Great Lord —
Pārvatī's lover, Śarva, first-born of all gods.
sa: jayaikarudraikaśiva mahādeva maheśvara pārvatīpraṇayiñ śarva sarvagīrvāṇapūrvaja

en: Victory: brow-eyed sole mark of the three-worlds' Lord; victory: poison-mark-throated, who drank the black poison for the worlds' pain.
l3:
Hail: brow-eyed sole badge of the three-worlds' Lord. Hail: black-poison-throated —
who drank the pain-struck world's pain.
sa: jaya trailokyanāthaikalāñchanālikalocana jaya pītartalokārtikālakūṭāṅkakandhara

en: Victory: whose self is the embodied three powers, hundred-spike-bright-handed; victory: whose lotus-feet are worshipped, wishes accomplished by mere will.
l3:
Hail: three-powers-bodied self, hundred-pike-bright-handed.
Hail: lotus-feet worship-worthy — aims ripened by will alone.
sa: jaya mūrtatriśaktyātmiśataśūlollasatkara jayecchāmātrasiddārthapūjārhacaraṇāmbuja

en: Victory: bearer of a body beyond worlds, streaming a hundred beauties; victory: single-braided, Ganges-thinned, ash-seized.
l3:
Hail: other-world-body-bearer, streaming hundred beauties.
Hail: single-topknotted — unwasting Ganges, rite-ash-seized.
sa: jaya śobhaśatasyandilokottaravapurdhara jayaikajaṭikākṣīṇagaṅgākṛtyāttabhasmaka

en: Victory: smeared with milk-ocean-spread moonlight shade; victory: snow-ornamented with jewel-light risen from the Lord's limb-contact.
l3:
Hail: smeared with milk-sea-spread moonlight shade.
Hail: jewel-darling-snow-decked — risen from the Lord's limb-touch.
sa: jaya kṣīrodaparyastajyotsnācchāyānulepana jayeśvarāṅgasaṅgottharatnakāntāhimaṇḍana

en: Victory: refuge like the one undying cool-rayed digit; victory: consecrated by ever-Ganges and universal lordship.
l3:
Hail: shelter like the one undying cool-rayed digit.
Hail: all-lordship-anointed, ever-damp with Ganges.
sa: jayākṣayaikaśītāṃśukalāsadṛśasaṃśraya jaya gaṅgāsadārbdhaviśvaiśvaryābhiṣecana

en: Victory: whose lowest-limb-touch purifies cowherds; victory: fixed-present where intoxicated devotees gather.
l3:
Hail: whose low-limb-touch hallows cowherds.
Hail, ever-present where love-drunk gather.
sa: jayādharāṅgasaṃsparśapāvanīkṛtagokula jaya bhaktimadābaddhagoṣṭhīniyatasannidhe

en: Victory: who dupes the childish, showing a hot place of His own will; victory: fit vessel for Gauri-embrace-fortune.
l3:
Hail: who dupes the sillies, showing hot places at will.
Hail: fit vessel of Gauri-embrace-fortune.
sa: jaya svecchātapodeśavipralambhitabāliśa jaya gaurīpariṣvaṅgayogyasaubhāgyabhājana

en: Victory: greedy for love-gifts wet with devotion-rasa; victory: pleased by the speech-dance of devotees drunk with devotion.
l3:
Hail: greedy for love-gifts wet-and-wet with love-sap.
Hail: gladdened by lovers' word-dance — love-drunk and wild.
sa: jaya bhaktirasārdrārdrabhāvopāyanalampaṭa jaya bhaktimadoddāmabhaktavāṅnṛttatoṣita

en: Victory: whose rise-and-fall is the power of Brahmā-and-first-gods; victory: whose command world-lord-rows bear on heads.
l3:
Hail: Brahmā-and-first-gods' might —
rise and fall. Hail: whose edict world-lord-rows bear on heads.
sa: jaya brahmādideveśaprabhāvaprabhavavyaya jayalokeśvaraśreṇiśirovidhṛtaśāsana

en: Victory: whose manifest glory is His seal set on all worlds; victory: great Lord of all, down to giving the very self.
l3:
Hail: glory shown by self-seal set on all worlds.
Hail: All-Lord, Great Lord — down to self-gift.
sa: jayasarvajagannyastasvamudrāvyaktavaibhava jayātmadānaparyantaviśveśvaramaheśvara

en: Victory: secondless at the creation-wish moment; victory: with sole Goddess-helper bearing lordship's burden.
l3:
Hail: matchless at three-worlds' creation-wish-moment.
Hail: with Goddess alone helping bear lordship's load.
sa: jaya trailokyasargecchāvasarāsaddvitīyaka jayaiśvaryabharodvāhadevīmātrasahāyaka

en: Victory: who seized all three worlds in one stride; victory: unbroken Lord-sound sung from childhood.
l3:
Hail: who strode all three worlds with no step.
Hail, unsatirized Lord-din, sung from childhood.
sa: jayākramasamākrāntasamastabhuvanatraya jayāvigītam ābālagīyamāneśvaradhvane

en: Victory: innately high, needing no pity and the rest; victory: Bhairava before whom great Death is made.
l3:
Hail, inborn-high, past pity-and-Co.
Hail, Bhairava before whom dread great Death is wrought.
sa: jayānukampādiguṇānapekṣasahajonnate jaya bhīṣmamahāmṛtyughaṭanāpūrvabhairava

en: Victory: unopposed in fierce world-ending acts; victory: hundredfold-good-named recitation-following.
l3:
Hail, unrivalled in world-burn's raging work.
Hail, hundred-weal-praised name-chant.
sa: jaya viśvakṣayoccaṇḍakriyāniṣparipanthika jaya śreyaḥśataguṇānuganāmānukīrtana

en: Victory: nectar-mine-ocean poured out in play; victory: whose instant anger dries the world-ending in a flash.
l3:
Hail, nectar-mine-sea spilt in play.
Hail, whose wink-anger parches the world-burn dry.
sa: jaya helāvitīrnaitadamṛtākarasāgara jaya viśvakṣayakṣepikṣaṇakopāśuśukṣaṇe

en: Victory: sole lamp of beings blind in delusion-darkness; victory: wakeful supreme Person while the sleeping world...
l3:
Hail, sole lamp of delusion-dark-blind breathing-folk.
Hail, wakeful high Person of the sleeping world.
sa: jaya mohāndhakārāndhajīvalokaikadīpaka jaya prasuptajagatījāgarūkādhipūruṣa

en: Victory: life-of-life humming inside the body-mountain cave; victory: best rasa sporting in good minds' sky.
l3:
Hail, life's-life warbling in the body-mountain-bower.
Hail, choice lake-bird sporting in true minds' sky.
sa: jaya dehādrikuñjāntarnikūjañjīvajīvaka jaya sanmānasavyomavilāsivarasārasa

en: Victory: mountain-lord born of high gold-ore; victory: moon rising as calamity-portent over the wicked.
l3:
Hail, mountain-lord born of high gold-vein.
Hail, moon rising blame-meteor-fall-portent over sinners.
sa: jaya jāmbūnadodagradhātūdbhavagirīśvara jaya pāpiṣu nindolkāpātanotpātacandramaḥ

en: Victory: hard to reach by austerity-tormented sages and gods; victory: seen by the world of devotion-madmen mounted on every state.
l3:
Hail, unneared by pain-burnt sages and gods.
Hail, seen by love-mad-folk mounted on every state.
sa: jaya kaṣṭatapaḥkliṣṭamunidevadurāsada jaya sarvadaśārūḍhabhaktimallokalokita

en: Victory: who leafed His dependents spreading His own wealth; victory: whose sole purpose is fondling surrendered people.
l3:
Hail, who leafs home-come ones spreading Thine own wealth.
Hail, whose one use is petting surrender-folk.
sa: jaya svasampatprasarapatrīkṛtanijāśrita jaya prapannajanatālālanaikaprayojana

en: Victory: sole performer of creating-staying-destroying; victory: festival of the play-lotus blooming in drunken devotion.
l3:
Hail, sole bright deed of making, staying, unmaking.
Hail, high feast of play-lotuses swaying in love's headiness.
sa: jaya sargasthitidhvaṃsakāraṇaikāvadānaka jaya bhaktimadālolalīlotpalamagotsava

en: Victory, worthy of victory! Victory, conqueror of birth, aging, dying! Victory, eldest of worlds... victory, victory... O three-eyed One.
l3:
Hail, victory's vessel! Hail, birth-age-death-conqueror! Hail, world's eldest!
Hail hail hail hail hail hail hail hail hail hail hail hail hail — Three-eyed!
sa: jaya jayabhājana jaya jitajanmajarāmaraṇa jaya jagajjyeṣṭha jaya jaya jaya jaya jaya jaya jaya jaya jaya jaya jaya jaya jaya tryakṣa

en: Stain-washing books exist, and their crossers too — yogins, scholars stand healthy — but devotees alone, in truth.
l3:
Stain-washing books there are, and their far-siders too; yogins, pundits stand hale —
Thy lovers alone, in truth.
sa: trimalakṣālino granthāḥ santi tatpāragāstathā yoginaḥ paṇḍitāḥ svasthās tvadbhaktā eva tattvataḥ

en: Māyā-time-limit-passion and the rest as food, fully fed — devotees stroll happy, Lord, on the world's shore.
l3:
Sated with Māyā-time-fate-love-and-Co. for food, they stroll glad, Lord —
love-ful — on the world's shore.
sa: māyīyakālaniyatirāgādyāhāratarpitāḥ caranti sukhino nātha bhaktimanto jagattaṭe

en: Laughing or crying, they babble You aloud — devotees, whose praise-word offerings are ornaments apart.
l3:
Weeping or laughing, Thee aloud they babble —
these lovers; praise-word-lift-offerings apart indeed are they.
sa: rudanto vā hasanto vā tvām uccaiḥ pralapanty amī bhaktāḥ stutipadoccāropacārāḥ pṛthag eva te

en: Not detached, not master, not liberation-desiring is Your worshipper — but drunk with soaring devotion-liquor-rasa.
l3:
No passionless one, no master either, no freedom-hungerer is Thy worshipper. May I be —
but — brimming-love-wine-sap-mad.
sa: na virakto na cāpīśo mokṣākāṅkṣī tvadarcakaḥ bhaveyam api tūdriktabhaktyāsavarasonmadaḥ

en: Who worships by drawing the outer inside the heart alone — to him, in devotion-nectar floods, I bow.
l3:
Who, dragging the outside into heart's inside itself, worships Thee, Ruler —
with love-nectar-sap-floods him I bow.
sa: bāhyaṃ hṛdaya evāntar abhihṛtyaiva yo 'rcati tvām īśa bhaktipīyūṣarasapūrair namāmi tam

en: Between dharma and adharma acts, knowledges, pleasure and pain selves — devotees taste SOMETHING — ah!
l3:
'Tween right and unright selves, 'tween doings, 'tween knowings —
so 'tween joy-and-pain selves — lovers taste some. Ah!
sa: dharmādharmātmanor antaḥ kriyayor jñānayos tathā sukhaduḥkhātmanor bhaktāḥ kim apy āsvādayanty aho

en: Blind ones, lepers even — they shine, supreme, ornamented by blazing devotion to You.
l3:
Stir-and-still's Lord, Master — though blind, though leprous —
they shine past measure, wild-Thy-love-jeweled.
sa: carācarapitaḥ svāmin apy andhā api kuṣṭhinaḥ śobhante param uddāmabhavadbhaktivibhūṣaṇāḥ

en: Gleaners, winnowers, enemies' shadows even — yet by devotion's heat they rule even the king of kings.
l3:
Gleaners, grain-pickers, foes' shadow-limbed even, Ruler —
by Thy-love's great heat the king of kings even they lord.
sa: śiloñchapicchakaśipuvicchāyāṅgā api prabho bhavadbhaktimahoṣmaṇo rājarājam apīśate

en: Though rolling in nectar-wet devotion, yet wanting to climb — some worship You with mind alone, standing all around.
l3:
In nectar-wet Thy-love though wallowing, yet climb-hungering —
with mind alone, All, some worship Thee, standing round about.
sa: sudhārdrāyāṃ bhavadbhaktau luṭhatāpy ārurukṣuṇā cetasaiva vibho 'rcanti kecit tvām abhitaḥ sthitāḥ

en: To be guarded, grown, honored, Lord — this great wealth of devotion that ends bad rebirths.
l3:
To be guarded, to be grown, to be honored —
this, Ruler: passing's ill-faring-smasher, Thy-love's great hoard.
sa: rakṣaṇīyaṃ vardhanīyaṃ bahumānyam idaṃ prabho saṃsāradurgatiharaṃ bhavadbhaktimahādhanam

en: Lord, though Your devotees love You — abandoning jealousy toward Her, may She always be pleased, the Mistress.
l3:
Lord, though Thy lover-folk love Thee —
yet envy dropped toward Her, gladdened ever be the Mistress.
sa: nātha te bhaktajanatā yady api tvayi rāgiṇī tathāpīrṣyāṃ vihāyāsyās tuṣṭāstu svāminī sadā

en: Your future being first; when devotion's occasion comes and the milk-ocean is churned — curd-greed is killed.
l3:
Thy state first, to be —
when Thy-love's birth-time comes, won the milk-great-jar: slain, in curds, greed.
sa: bhavadbhāvaḥ puro bhāvī prāpte tvadbhaktisambhave labdhe dugdhamahākumbhe hatā dadhani gṛdhnutā

en: Is this not attainment beyond compare — ever-growing devotion to Śambhu, always new? What happiness does it not stream?
l3:
What — is this not attainment past compare? What chief joy streams it not?
Love, ever-waxing — this, the Kind One's, ever-new.
sa: kim iyaṃ na siddhir atulā kiṃ vā mukhyaṃ na saukhyam āsravati bhaktir upacīyamānā yeyaṃ śambhoḥ sadātanī bhavati

en: Sunk in my dirty mind, Your devotion gem-creeper — alas — does not spread its own superhuman wealth-blossomings.
l3:
In my stained mind sunk, Thy-love's gem-creeper — hard! —
spreads not even its own, those unmanned own-hoard-blossomings.
sa: manasi maline madīyemagnā tvadbhaktimaṇilatā kaṣṭam na nijān api tanute tānapauruṣeyān svasampadullāsān

en: Devotion to the Lord of three worlds IS supreme attainment — but lacking supernormal powers, is it not full? — that is my worry.
l3:
Love in the Lord, in three-worlds' Master — is it not highest attainment?
Yet for want of wonder-powers, is it not full? — this, my worry.
sa: bhaktir bhagavati bhavati trilokanāthe nanūttamā siddhiḥ kiṃ tv aṇimādikavirahāt saiva na pūrṇeti cintā me

en: Outside and in, the fragrance of Your praise-blossoms' opening perfumes even hostile ascetics dwelling near.
l3:
Without, within too —
keen-blooming Three-eyed's-bouquet-scents, fair, scent even cross-scented yogins, near-dwelling, all.
sa: bāhyato 'ntar api cotkaṭonmiṣattryambakastavakasaurabhāḥ śubhāḥ vāsayanty api viruddhavāsanān yogino nikaṭavāsino 'khilān

en: By no account is there any light; the whole world fast asleep — yet at Your Śivarātri post, devotees always worship You.
l3:
Light is there, by no tale, none; the world even, all past-sleep.
Where, Lord, at Śiva-night's post, ever lover-folk worship Thee.
sa: jyotir asti kathayāpi na kiṃ cid viśvam apy atisuṣuptam aśeṣam yatra nātha śivarātripade 'smin nityam arcayati bhaktajanas tvām

en: Let goodness expand in true worship of gracious Śiva; let Śaṅkara-foot-dust heaps sport on the crown — to cut even passion-memories, let darkness swell, or the triple world dissolve in Your self-loss.
l3:
Goodness — in true mood, in kindly Lord — widen in worship. On the crown sport Kind-Maker's-foot-dust-risen-heaps.
To sever love-and-Co.-mind-scents even, gloom gape, Kind One, be mine — or in Thy-self-loss, the three-strand-throng.
sa: sattvaṃ satyaguṇe śive bhagavati sphārībhavatv arcane cūḍāyāṃ vilasantu śaṅkarapadaprodyadrajaḥsaṅcayāḥ rāgādismṛtivāsanām api samucchettuṃ tamo jṛmbhatāṃ śambho me bhavatāt tvadātmavilaye traiguṇyavargo 'thavā

en: The world-road is long; limbs burnt by harsh diseases; pleasures unenjoyed; happiness never long — thus I have become useless, moon-crest-foot-pressed, wholly Yours — so make me, quickly, long-and-rich in great fortune, as Your devotee.
l3:
Passing's road far-far; limb-stalk burnt with keen-and-sundry ills; joys nowise tasted — what joy was, never ours long.
Thus vain am I grown — moon-bearer's-foot-pressed-fair-crowned, and Thy lover. So me make — now — high-fortuned, long-long.
sa: saṃsārādhvā sudūraḥ kharataravividhavyādhidagdhāṅgayaṣṭiḥ bhogā naivopabhuktā yad api sukham abhūj jātu nanno cirāya itthaṃ vyartho 'smi jātaḥ śaśidharacaraṇākrāntikāntottamāṅgas tvadbhaktaś ceti tan me kuru sapadi mahāsampado dīrghadīrghāḥ

en: Nothing blocks folk, nothing blocks devotees from Your veiling.
l3:
Naught of folk stands toward Thy veiling.
