Naught of lovers either.
sa: na kiñcid eva lokānāṃ bhavadāvaraṇaṃ prati  na kiñcid eva bhaktānāṃ bhavadāvaraṇaṃ prati

en: Though reached by method-ladders, crowded with attributes — to devotees the self appears at once, pure.
l3:
Though won by method-ladder-steps, though thick with epithets —
to love-sharers Thou, the self, at once, pure, dawns.
sa: apy upāyakramaprāpyaḥ saṅkulo 'pi viśeṣaṇaiḥ bhaktibhājāṃ bhavān ātmā sakṛc chuddho 'vabhāsate

en: Laughing victors, laughing conquered — drunk on His devotion-nectar, whoever they are, Lord.
l3:
Winning even, laugh these; won even, laugh too —
muddy with drinking Thy love-nectar, whoever indeed, Lord.
sa: jayanto 'pi hasanty ete jitā api hasanti ca bhavadbhaktisudhāpānamattāḥ ke 'py eva ye prabho

en: May I never dry up, never seek release — full of His devotion-rasa, best-liked, attained.
l3:
May I never dry up, never seek release —
brimmed with Thy-love-sap, best-tasted, past-topped.
sa: śuṣkakaṃ maiva siddheya maiva mucyeya vāpi tu svādiṣṭhaparakāṣṭāptatvadbhaktirasanirbharaḥ

en: As unknown before was this devotion-rasa of Yours to me — so, Lord, may that same one grow.
l3:
As unmet before, this Thy-love-sap of mine befell —
so, Ruler, may that same fatten.
sa: yathaivajñātapūrvo 'yaṃ bhavadbhaktiraso mama ghaṭitas tadvad īśāna sa eva paripuṣyatu

en: Truly, Lord, I have no other prayer-course — only may such immersion-possession by devotion be mine always.
l3:
Truly, Lord — no other prayer's reach is mine. Only —
be that, somehow some, love's seizure mine, ever.
sa: satyena bhagavan nānyaḥ prārthanāprasaro 'sti me kevalaṃ sa tathā ko 'pi bhaktyāveśo 'stu me sadā

en: Drunk on devotion I may rage, repent, leap, shout "Śiva" — enough.
l3:
Love-drunk even —
may I rage, for Becoming rue, laugh, up leap, yell 'Śiva'. Enough.
sa: bhaktikṣīvo 'pi kupyeyaṃ bhavāyānuśayīya ca tathā haseyaṃ udyāṃ ca raṭeyaṃ ca śivety alam

en: In crisis or at peace, weeping or laughing, deep or distracted — may I be, Lord, by devotion.
l3:
Pit-standing even, hale even, weeping even, laughing even —
deep even, scatter-minded even — may I be, by love, Ruler.
sa: viṣamastho 'pi svastho 'pi rudann api hasann api gambhīro 'pi vicitto 'pi bhaveyaṃ bhaktitaḥ prabho

en: For devotees nothing to be known, inside You or out — where consciousness-natured You stand thought-free.
l3:
For lovers naught to be felt — in Thee within, or without —
where Thou, knowing-natured, doubtfree standest, Thyself.
sa: bhaktānāṃ nāsti saṃvedyaṃ tvadantar yadi vā bahiḥ ciddharmā yatra na bhavān nirvikalpaḥ sthitaḥ svayam

en: Devotees rejoice even at abusers — pierced within, bristling with sharp horripilation, as if by nectar-drops.
l3:
Lovers, at blame-mimicking even, thrill —
by Thy nectar-drops, as if — inward-pierced by keen thrill-needles.
sa: bhaktā nindānukare 'pi tavāmṛtakaṇair iva hṛṣyanty evāntarāviddhās tīkṣṇaromāñcasūcibhiḥ

en: Even pain-feeling ripens to enjoyment for devotees, whose all-awareness, moon-wet, is moonlight-made.
l3:
Pain-feeling even, for lovers, ripens to feasting —
whose knowing, all of it, nectar-wet, is Thy-moonshine-made.
sa: duḥkhāpi vedanā bhaktimatāṃ bhogāya kalpate yeṣāṃ sudhārdrā sarvaiva saṃvit tvaccandrikāmayī

en: Wherever held, devotees — inside and out — unfeigned, Your body-touch-taste-joy the same.
l3:
Where-go held, of lovers, without-within —
guileless, Thy-frame-touch-sap-taste-joy same.
sa: yatra tatroparuddhānāṃ bhaktānāṃ bahirantare nirvyājaṃ tvadvapuḥsparśarasāsvādasukhaṃ samam

en: In worship of Thy devotion, wiping out wretchedness's share that rests on duality — some taste the clear nectar-body.
l3:
Lord —
in Thy love's worship, the abject share that leans on two wiped out, some savor a frame clear, nectar-made.
sa: taveśa bhakter arcāyāṃ dainyāṃśaṃ dvayasaṃśrayam vilupyāsvādayanty eke vapur acchaṃ sudhāmayam

en: Erring are pilgrim-eyes, divided — for division is just erring; but matchless, strifeless Being shines for devotees.
l3:
Astray, ford-seers, split — for split is but straying's.
Foeless, thing one — for lovers Thou shinest.
sa: bhrāntās tīrthadṛśo bhinnā bhrānter eva hi bhinnatā niṣpratidvandvi vastv ekaṃ bhaktānāṃ tvaṃ tu rājase

en: Mind ripened past honor, contempt, love and the rest into stainlessness — how could its bearer be world-mannered?
l3:
Mind stainless-ripe past honor, scorn, love-and-Co. —
whose is he, the lover? World-like-mannered how could he be?
sa: mānāvamānarāgādiniṣpākavimalaṃ manaḥ yasyāsau bhaktimāṃl lokatulyaśīlaḥ kathaṃ bhavet

en: Passion-aversion-darkness conquered by devotion-light — who are the knowledge-rich before them?
l3:
Love-hate-gloom even, whose love-shine conquered —
before those greater ones, which are the knowing-rich?
sa: rāgadveṣandhakāro 'pi yeṣāṃ bhaktitviṣā jitaḥ teṣāṃ mahīyasām agre katame jñānaśālinaḥ

en: Whose rite is devotion-nectar-drink-and-bath — high joy from beginning through end.
l3:
Whose rite-and-means is love-nectar-bath-and-drink —
his, in begun-middle-end states, high ease-seat.
sa: yasya bhaktisudhāsnānapānādividhisādhanam tasya prārabdhamadhyāntadaśāsūccaiḥ sukhāsikā

en: Praised, sought, worshipped — for that alone devotees' world-life is praiseworthy.
l3:
Praised be, thought be, sought be, worshiped —
whereby Thou alone: of Thy lovers, praised be world-faring, Thee-made.
sa: kīrtyaś cintāpadaṃ mṛgyaḥ pūjyo yena tvam eva tat bhavadbhaktimatāṃ ślāghyā lokayātrā bhavanmayī

en: Liberation's name is but Your ripe devotion — mounted on its first stage, we are near-free.
l3:
Freedom's name is but ripe love in Thee, Lord.
Thereon, first-stage-mounted, freed-like are we.
sa: muktisaṃjñā vipakvāyā bhakter eva tvayi prabho tasyām ādyadaśārūḍhā muktakalpā vayaṃ tataḥ

en: May pain's coming be great for me, self filled with devotion to Thee — may even pleasure's succession not turn from Thee.
l3:
Pain's coming even — great be mine, love-brimmed-souled.
From-Thee-turned, All, be never — joy's train even.
sa: duḥkhāgamo 'pi bhūyān me tvadbhaktibharitātmanaḥ tvatparācī vibho mā bhūd api saukhyaparamparā

en: You are pleased by devotion; devotion, You pleased — this mutual dependence is fitting, as You alone know.
l3:
Thou by love art gladdened; love, gladdened in Thee —
and, Lord, since that mutual-ground is fit, as Thou alone knowest it.
sa: tvaṃ bhaktyā prīyase bhaktiḥ prīte tvayi ca nātha yat tadanyonyāśrayaṃ yuktaṃ yathā vettha tvam eva tat

en: With form or formless, inside or out — to devotion-selves, always nectar, Lord.
l3:
Shaped or shapeless, in or out even —
to lover-selves, Ruler, ever art Thou nectar-made.
sa: sākāro vā nirākaro vāntar vā bahir eva vā bhaktimattātmanāṃ nātha sarvathāsi sudhāmayaḥ

en: In this very world, for Your devotees, another world-stand exists — fruit of joy-showing.
l3:
In this world itself, within, toward Thy lover —
joy-showing-fruited, another world-stand stands.
sa: asminn eva jagaty antar bhavadbhaktimataḥ prati harṣaprakāśanaphalam anyad eva jagatsthitam

en: Devotion hidden, devotion supreme, devotion to the world-great Lord — devotion, ah, something in You, Śiva.
l3:
In the hidden, love; in the high, love; love in the world's Great Lord —
in Thee, Kind One, in Śiva — love, forsooth, some! Ah!
sa: guhye bhaktiḥ pare bhaktir bhaktir viśvamaheśvare tvayi śambhau śive deva bhaktir nāma kim apy aho

en: Devotion, devotion, supreme devotion — I cry loud: let fierce devotion be mine supreme.
l3:
Love, love — high love, love forsooth fierce!
Loud I wail, that fierce love be mine, high, in Thee.
sa: bhaktir bhaktiḥ pare bhaktir bhaktir nāma samutkaṭā tāraṃ viraumi yat tīvrā bhaktir me 'stu paraṃ tvayi

en: Since I am the birth-ground of all beauties — stuck to You, jewel or straw becomes priceless.
l3:
Since I am all beauties' birth-ground, Ruler —
in Thee stuck, priceless be jewel or straw.
sa: yato 'smi sarvaśobhānāṃ prasavāvanir īśa tat tvayi lagnam anarghaṃ syād ratnam vā yadi vā tṛṇam

en: From knower and from knowable, on whose knowing-road there is no parting from You — they win, Your devotees, ever fearless.
l3:
From knower to known, on whose feeling-road by Thee no parting is —
they win, Thy partakers.
sa: āvedakād ā ca vedyād yeṣāṃ saṃvedanādhvani bhavatā na viyogo 'sti te jayanti bhavajjuṣaḥ

en: Outside saṃsāra's hall, by some Thou art embraced — Lord, by others in that very place, self-tormenting, unreined.
l3:
Outside passing's hall, by some art Thou clasped —
Master. But by others, right there, drooping, rein-dropped.
sa: saṃsārasadaso bāhye kaiś cittvaṃ parirabhyase svāmin parais tu tatraiva tāmyadbhis tyaktayantraṇaiḥ

en: With Śivā who eats, decks, celebrates the world, festival-hurried — hug tight, Śiva, I bow.
l3:
With Bhavānī — drinking, eating, decking, feasting the all-world whole —
dissolution-feast-hurried, hard-clasped Śiva I bow.
sa: pānāśanaprasādhanasambhuktasamastaviśvayā śivayā pralayotsavasarabhasayā dṛḍham upagūḍhaṃ śivaṃ vande

en: Peerless overlordship wins, world-Lord, being subject-free — and so does Your otherness, by which this world shines as it does not.
l3:
High-lordship wins, matchless, Thine, All-Lord — being commanded-free.
Other too, likewise Thine — whereby this world shines as it shines-not.
sa: parameśvaratā jayaty apūrvā tava viśveśa yadīśitavyaśūnyā aparāpi tathaiva te yayedaṃ jagad ābhāti yathā tathā na bhāti

en: Ah, this wins — sweet, this festival of worship — since tears give nectar-taste amply.
l3:
Ah! somehow wins —
this sweet worship-high-feast, since nectar-sap-taste tears even give amply.
sa: aho ko 'pi jayaty eṣa svāduḥ pūjāmahotsavaḥ yato 'mṛtarasāsvādam aśrūṇy api dadaty alam

en: All acts with His worship vanguard are successes; devotees made of Him are themselves successes.
l3:
Dealings success-giving, all — whose vanguard is Thy worship.
Lovers, Thee-made — all, themselves ripe attainments.
sa: vyāpārāḥ siddhidāḥ sarve ye tvatpūjāpuraḥsarāḥ bhaktānāṃ tvanmayāḥ sarve svayaṃ siddhaya eva te

en: In all beings, all states, at once, all-formed — worshipping You unceasing, they are my gods.
l3:
Ever, in all states, at once, all-shaped —
Thee they worship restless. They — my high gods.
sa: sarvadā sarvabhāveṣu yugapat sarvarūpiṇam tvām arcayanty aviśrantaṃ ye mamaite 'dhidevatāḥ

en: Meditation-perfected touch-festival of You — thus famed as worship-rule — be mine always.
l3:
Touch-Thee-feast, ripe by scorning thought-strain —
worship's rule, so famed — be mine ever.
sa: dhyānāyasatiraskārasiddhas tvatsparśanotsavaḥ pūjāvidhir iti khyāto bhaktānāṃ sa sadās tu me

en: Equanimity-essence equinox-moment of devotees is always — ever-worshipping with Your being-rasa-nectar.
l3:
Lovers' evenness-pith-equinox-tide, ever —
by Thy-state-sap-nectar-sap, their ever-worship.
sa: bhaktānāṃ samatāsāraviṣuvatsamayaḥ sadā tvadbhāvarasapīyūṣarasennaiṣāṃ sadārcanam

en: Whose beginning and end are not, nor time-order — that deed is Yours, and its doers resort only to You.
l3:
Whose start-and-end are not, nor time-rank, Ruler —
worship-selved is that deed; its doers, Thy-partakers, merely.
sa: yasyānārambhaparyantau na ca kālakramaḥ prabho pūjātmāsau kriyā tasyāḥ kartāras tvajjuṣaḥ param

en: Brahmā and the rest are fortunate, lords — in whose dream, even delusion, stands Your worship-festival.
l3:
Brahmā-and-first ones even — rulers, fortune-sharers —
in whose dream even, swoon even, stands Thy worship-feast.
sa: brahmādīnām apīśāste te ca saubhāgyabhāginaḥ yeṣāṃ svapne 'pi mohe 'pi sthitas tvatpūjanotsavaḥ

en: Chanting, offering, bathing, meditating — and not only: ah, devotees' worshipping You — whenever, whatever, however much.
l3:
Mutterers, offerers, bathers, thinkers —
and not barely: lovers' Thee-worship — ah! — as-far, when, then...
sa: japatāṃ juhvatāṃ snātāṃ dhyāyatāṃ na ca kevalam bhaktānāṃ bhavadabhyarcāmaho yāvad yadā tadā

en: Tasting Your worship-nectar-joy, enjoying — to Indra and the rest, to Brahmā-chiefs: is anyone equal?
l3:
Thy-worship-nectar-taste-wedding-glad, ever —
'mid Indra-and-first, ay, Brahmā-chiefs: is who their match?
sa: bhavatpūjāsudhāsvādasambhogasukhinaḥ sadā indrādīnām atha brahmamukhyānām asti kaḥ samaḥ

en: World-shaking, one-cause festival — what is got thereby, only devotees know who get it.
l3:
At Thy worship-high-feast, sole-born of world-churn —
what won is won, some: lovers alone ken it.
sa: jagatkṣobhaikajanake bhavatpūjāmahotsave yatprāpyaṃ prāpyate kiṃcid bhaktā eva vidanti tat

en: Standing in Your abode, consciousness-formed, with body-speech-mind acts of all 36 principles — I always worship You, Lord.
l3:
In Thy knowing-made seat standing, by six-and-thirty-principle-deeds —
by body-speech-mind-stirs-and-Co. — worship I Thee ever, All.
sa: tvaddhāmni cinmaye sthitvā ṣaṭtriṃśattattvakarmabhiḥ kāyavākcittaceṣṭādyair arcaye tvāṃ sadā vibho

en: Of me, enjoying union with Your worship — may all time pass, even endless: this I pray.
l3:
Glad in Thy-worship-woven-clinging-wedding, of me —
fare, time, all, ay, endless. This I pray.
sa: bhavatpūjāmayāsaṅgasambhogasukhino mama prayātu kālaḥ sakalo 'py ananto 'pīyadarthaye

en: Greedy for Your worship-enjoyment-nectar — may it grow daily for me and fruit always.
l3:
Greed for Thy-worship-nectar-sap-feasting —
All! Wax day on day, and ever fruit, for me.
sa: bhavatpūjāmṛtarasābhogalampaṭata vibho vivardhatām anudinaṃ sadā ca phalatāṃ mama

en: In Your ocean, nectar-one-rasa-full, worshipping You, great self, may I always sit.
l3:
In Thine ocean — brimmed with world-play-born nectar-one-sap —
Thee, high-souled, worshiping may I sit, ever.
sa: jagadvilayasañjātasudhaikarasanirbhare tvadabdhau tvāṃ mahātmānam arcannāsīya sarvadā

en: Mind offered as sweet in Your rite — knots ever cut simply.
l3:
Ever plain by all-hankering-knot-severing —
mind is laid before Thee by lovers, sweet, in Thy worship-rule.
sa: aśeṣavāsanāgranthivicchedasaralaṃ sadā mano nivedyate bhaktaiḥ svādu pūjāvidhau tava

en: Having taken stand on objects — these sense-courses of devotees — send them for Your worship-nectar-wine.
l3:
Standing upon these sense-fields, sense-plays of lovers send,
for Thy-worship-sake, nectar-wine.
sa: adhiṣṭhāyaiva viṣayānimāḥ karaṇavṛttayaḥ bhaktānāṃ preṣayanti svatpūjārtham amṛtāsavam

en: Agitated by devotion-heat, self-mastered — what else could liberate but drowning in worship of You?
l3:
Lovers, love-surge-great-heat-helpless-souled —
what other freedom-cause, but drowning in Thy-worship-nectar?
sa: bhaktānāṃ bhaktisaṃvegamahoṣmavivaśātmanām ko 'nyo nirvāṇahetuḥ syāt tvatpūjāmṛtamajjanāt

en: Perpetual foot-worship-nectar-drinking festival — may it be my sole grace-getting cause, Lord.
l3:
Ever, Thy-foot-honoring-nectar-drink-high-feast —
my Thy-grace-one-winning-cause, Ruler, may it avail.
sa: satataṃ tvatpadābhyarcāsudhāpānamahotsavaḥ tvatprasādaikasamprāptihetur me nātha kalpatām

en: Experiencing, Lord, moment by moment — Your worship-nectar-drinking-madness-joy-great-joy.
l3:
May I feel, Ruler, deed by deed, wink by wink —
Thy-worship-nectar-drink-frenzy-taste-high-glee.
sa: anubhūyāsamīśāna pratikarma kṣaṇāt kṣaṇam bhavatpūjāmṛtāpānamadāsvādamahāmudam

en: Seen is the point of devotees' great worship-undertaking: that they taste impossible joy then.
l3:
Seen-fruited indeed is lovers' Thy-worship-high-venture: at once —
unthinkable joy they taste.
sa: dṛṣṭartha eva bhaktānāṃ bhavatpūjāmahodyamaḥ tadaiva yad asambhāvyaṃ sukham āsvādayanti te

en: Till Your worship-nectar-taste-festival is got, I count no drop of fortune's happiness tasted.
l3:
While unwon, Thy-worship-nectar-taste-high-feast —
while, untasted I deem a speck even of joy's hoard.
sa: yāvan na labdhas tvatpūjāsudhāsvādamahotsavaḥ tāvan nāsvādito manye lavo 'pi sukhasampadaḥ

en: Without sense-seeking strain, Your abode's abiding is born in devotees — no getting needed, only madness with worship.
l3:
Lovers' — without sense-hunt-shine-strain even:
strain-free-ripe, Thy-seat-standing in worships is born.
sa: bhaktānāṃ viṣayanveṣābhāsāyāsād vinaiva sā ayatnasiddhaṃ tvaddhāmasthitiḥ pūjāsu jāyate

en: Nothing ungettable for devotees, nothing hard — they only roam, mad with worship.
l3:
Naught to win is there for lovers, nor aught scarce to them.
Merely roam they — Thy-worship-wine-frenzy-mad.
sa: na prāpyam asti bhaktanāṃ nāpy eṣām asti durlabham kevalaṃ vicaranty ete bhavatpūjāmadonmadāḥ

en: Ah, the devotees' heart-heavy worship-rule: praised, unmarked by begging.
l3:
Ah! love-heavy-open-hearted — Boon-lord —
toward Thee: praised the worship-rule, somehow — by begging unstained.
sa: aho bhaktibharodāracetasāṃ varada tvayi slāghyaḥ pūjāvidhiḥ ko 'pi yo na yācñākalaṃkitaḥ

en: What beauty is not, what joy not, what fortune not, what liberation not — this Mahādeva, since He is worshipped.
l3:
What beauty is not, what glee not, what thrive not, or else —
what freedom not — since this Great God is worshiped.
sa: kā na śobhā na ko hlādaḥ kā samṛddhir na vāparā ko vā na mokṣaḥ ko 'py eṣa mahādevo yad arcyate

en: Nourished within by welling bright devotion-nectar — may this body be for Thy worship's use, always devoted.
l3:
Inward-sporting-clear-clear-love-nectar-fed —
for Thy-worship-use be this frame mine.
sa: antarullasadacchācchabhaktipīyūṣapoṣitam bhavatpūjopayogāya śarīram idam astu me

en: Dependent on Your foot-worship-enjoyment — may I, O world-Lord, be the one self-willed in movement.
l3:
Thy-foot-worship-wedding-bound ever, All —
may I be, worlds' Ruler, alone, free-stirring.
sa: tvatpādapūjāsambhogaparatantraḥ sadā vibho bhūyāsaṃ jagatām īśa ekaḥ svacchandaceṣṭitaḥ

en: To quench vision-touch-thirst for You — arises the cool, sweet great lake of Your worship.
l3:
Thy-thought-seeing-touch-thirst — of some even, Ruler —
is born cool-sweet Thy-worship-high-lake.
sa: tvaddhyānadarśanasparśatṛṣi keṣām api prabho jāyate śītalasvādu bhavatpūjāmahāsaraḥ

en: As You alone are the world's worship-enjoyment-vessel — so, Lord, is the devotee a vessel of worship-enjoyment.
l3:
As Thou alone art the world's worship-wedding-bowl —
so, Ruler, the lover alone is worship-wedding-bowl.
sa: yathā tvam eva jagataḥ pūjāsambhogabhājanam tatheśa bhaktimān eva pūjāsambhogabhājanam

en: Victor, Your festival — even the 36 agitated by it — great day.
l3:
Somehow wins — Master —
Thy worship-high-feast, where of six-and-thirty principles even churn sports amply.
sa: ko 'py asau jayati svāmin bhavatpūjāmahotsavaḥ ṣaṭtriṃśato 'pi tattvānāṃ kṣobho yatrollasaty alam

en: Bow to those whose worship-things are themselves worshipped, by devotion-nectar-water.
l3:
Bow to them, All —
whose, by love-nectar-water, hallowed themselves turn Thy worship-gear even.
sa: namas tebhyo vibho yeṣāṃ bhaktipīyūṣavāriṇā pūjyāny eva bhavanti tvatpūjopakaraṇāny api

en: At worship's start, meditating mantra-placed His selfhood — devotees rest in supreme self, nowhere roaming.
l3:
At worship's start, All — thought on, mantra-laid Thy-selfness —
in self alone, high, lovers shine with glee — nowhither.
sa: pūjārambhe vibho dhyātvā mantrādheyāṃ tvadātmatām svātmany eva pare bhaktā mānti harṣeṇa na kvacit

en: Kingdoms blooming, world shared out in nectar-wine by festival-goers.
l3:
By kingdom-winning-and-Co.-blooming ones at Thy worship-high-feast —
with nectar-wine the all-earth is shared out.
sa: rājyalābhādivotphullaiḥ kaiś cit pūjāmahotsave sudhāsavena sakalā jagatī saṃvibhajyate

en: Whose moment-drink is worship-nectar — are they gods, freed, or whatever people?
l3:
Worship-nectar-drink-made, whose feasting wink by wink —
are they gods? or freed? or whatever folk indeed?
sa: pūjāmṛtāpānamayo yeṣāṃ bhogaḥ pratikṣaṇam kiṃ devā uta muktās te kiṃ vā ke 'py eva te janāḥ

en: The world's dignity as worship-gear is theirs — ah, something of devotees, and just lightness!
l3:
By world-turned-worship-gear-guise, weight. Ah!
some of lovers — and some indeed lightness.
sa: pūjopakaraṇībhūtaviśvaveśena gauravam aho kim api bhaktānāṃ kim apy eva ca lāghavam

en: From worship-made eye-throw agitation, nectar-rising for devotees — as from the gods' milk-ocean churning.
l3:
From worship-made-glance-toss-churn alone, nectar-upcoming —
for lovers; as from milk-sea-churn for sky-dwellers.
sa: pūjāmayākṣavikṣepakṣobhādevāmṛtodgamaḥ bhaktānāṃ kṣīrajaladhikṣobhād iva divaukasām

en: Some take worship as the wish-cow; others, inward-turned, milk the nectar-stream.
l3:
Worship some deem a wish-cow.
Nectar-stream-over-sapped, suck the inward-faced others.
sa: pūjāṃ ke cana manyante dhenuṃ kāmadughām iva sudhādhārādhikarasāṃ dhayanty antarmukhāḥ pare

en: Even eye-throws, world-approved, bring something within — may the festival grow.
l3:
Lovers' glance-toss even — this, passing-approved —
fetching some within, fattens the worship-high-feast.
sa: bhaktānām akṣavikṣepo 'py eṣa saṃsārasaṃmataḥ upanīya kim apy antaḥ puṣṇāty arcāmahotsavam

en: By devotion-agitation, worship in self-become-Him — wonder: poverty's top fruit is lowliness' fruit.
l3:
By love-churn's force, Ruler — worship in Thee, self-become. Strange —
for abjectness? Nay — till abjectness's high fruit.
sa: bhaktikṣobhavaśād īśa svātmabhūte 'rcanaṃ tvayi citraṃ dainyāya no yāvad dīnatāyāḥ paraṃ phalam

en: For some, rite is upacāra-step to His feet; for devotees, non-duality-bliss-spread.
l3:
Courtesy-tread is worship, for some, to win Thy feet.
For lovers, Thine-one-self-bliss-spread is it.
sa: upacārapadaṃ pūjā keṣāṃ cit tvatpadāptaye bhaktānāṃ bhavadaikātmyanirvṛttiprasaras tu saḥ

en: Spread by unbound mad devotion to the formless-seeming, it gains some foothold in You.
l3:
By unbound-mad-love's-unbarred — worship of unjoined-shape even —
spread out, it wins a stand in Thee, some.
sa: apy asambaddharūpārcābhaktyunmādanirargalaiḥ vitanyamānā labhate pratiṣṭhāṃ tvayi kām api

en: Taste-stunned mind; He alone as worship's vessel, they say.
l3:
Mind stilled by tasting sweet-love-sap — fallen. Kind One —
Thou alone, lovely, art worships' bowl, they say.
sa: svādubhaktirasāsvādastabdhībhūtamanaś cyutām śambho tvam eva lalitaḥ pūjānāṃ kila bhājanam

en: Full, pure, steady, devoted means be mine for His worship, Lord.
l3:
Brimmed, pure, loving, steady —
in Thy worship-rule, Ruler, means be mine.
sa: paripūrṇāni śuddhāni bhaktimanti sthirāṇi ca bhavatpūjāvidhau nātha sādhanāni bhavantu me

en: In the whole worship-treasure, what fortune of the organ-host blooms?
l3:
In all-worship's true-treasury, in Thy worship-work, Ruler —
ah! sense-throng's some fortune unfolds.
sa: aśeṣapūjāsatkośe tvatpūjākarmaṇi prabho aho karaṇavṛndasya kāpi lakṣmīr vijṛmbhate

en: This prettiness is Yours alone, Lord: though Lord of all, worshipped by servants — and found.
l3:
This prettiness, Ruler —
Thine alone, they say, is seen: All-Lord even, by slaves art Thou worshiped and won.
sa: eṣā peśalimā nātha tavaiva kila dṛśyate viśveśvaro 'pi bhṛtyair yad arcyase yaś ca labhyase

en: Rise from formed or formless, being or non-being — may my festival rise.
l3:
From ever-formed or formless, from being or even unbeing —
may rise, mine, of the praised, Thy worship-high-feast.
sa: sadāmurttād amūrttādvā bhāvād yad vāpy abhāvataḥ uttheyān me praśastasya bhavatpūjāmahotsavaḥ

en: With lust, anger, pride made offering, who always worship — bow to them; of them I am pleased, in truth.
l3:
With lust, anger, pride made offering ever —
who worship: bow to them. Of them pleased am I, in truth.
sa: kāmakrodhābhimānais tvām upaharīkṛtaiḥ sadā ye 'rcayanti namas tebhyas teṣāṃ tuṣṭo 'smi tattvataḥ

en: Victor, Your festival of devotees' supreme rule — though made with straw, yet furnished with jewels.
l3:
Wins — this, Thy-love-sharers' worship-rule, high —
with straws wrought even, with jewels fitted.
sa: jayaty eṣa bhavadbhaktibhājāṃ pūjāvidhiḥ paraḥ yas tṛṇaiḥ kriyamāno 'pi ratnair evopakalpate

en: Finding You inside the world, they get inside You — never far are Your devotees.
l3:
From the world's inside, winning Thee — again, from Thine inside, they win this. World-Lord —
Thine alone, love-sharers: for naught of theirs here is from afar.
sa: jagato 'ntarato bhavantam āptvā punar etad bhavato 'ntarāl labhante jagadīśa tavaiva bhaktibhājo na hi teṣām iha dūrato 'sti kiñcit

en: He here, She everywhere, pregnant with the order of all things, supreme — but at the ultimate step, no division of Her nor of the triple world.
l3:
Here Thou, there Bhavānī — all-things'-rank-pregnant, first.
But at truth's station, neither Hers nor Thine, nor triple-world's, is split.
sa: kvacid eva bhavān kvacid bhavānī sakalārthakramagarbhiṇī pradhānā paramārthapade tu naiva devyā bhavato nāpi jatattrayasya bhedaḥ

en: The ungrateful know not the auspicious, though proud; all things, though effort-favored — but this mind, though risen, does not perceive the self-form here; ah, alas, I am destroyed.
l3:
The smug know not the lovely even; though try-favored, all things indeed. But mind —
though risen this even — kens not self-shape here. Ah! then — ah! — I am slain.
sa: no jānate subhagam apy avalepavanto lokāḥ prayatnasubhagā nikhila hi bhāvāḥ cetaḥ punar yad idam udyatam apy avaiti naivātmarūpam iha hā tad aho hato 'smi

en: Who has gained dwelling in the self made of You, Your feet worshipped with full wealth — needing neither food nor covering ever: to him I bow.
l3:
Thy feet honored with full wealth, won by dwelling in Thee-made self —
who needs not food nor cloak ever: to him bowed am I.
sa: bhavanmayasvātmanivāsalabdhasampadbharābhyarcitayuṣmadaṅghriḥ na bhojanācchādanam apy ajasram apekṣate yas tam ahaṃ nato 'smi

en: Ever dwelling in Your body-abode yet inwardly supreme-burning, this world — by Your will make me here, of worship-joy-nature.
l3:
Ever in Thy-frame-dwelling hale, yet inside supremely burns this world.
By Thy will, so do for me that here, Thy-worship-joy-made, I be.
sa: sadā bhavaddehanivāsasvastho 'py antaḥ paraṃ dahyata eṣa lokaḥ tavecchayā tat kuru me yathātra tvadarcanānandamayo bhaveyam

en: Spontaneously risen, touching Your lotus-feet pair, drinking the worship-nectar — mind intent, may I be, in gathering my aims, with mere touch-happiness as world-tour.
l3:
By own sap risen — Thy-foot-lotus-pair-worship-nectar-drink-glued-mind —
'mid all-aims'-gatherings may I be, touch-joy-alone for world-faring.
sa: svarasoditayuṣmadaṅghripadmadvayapūjāmṛtapānasaktacittaḥ sakārthacayeṣv ahaṃ bhaveyam sukhasaṃsparśanamātralokayātraḥ

en: In the whole field of dealings, plainly, while You throb inside, Lord — coming and going ever, may my things shine always.
l3:
In all-dealings'-pasture, plain — within throbs, in Thee, Ruler.
They near and leave ever — my things, shine they ever.
sa: sakalavyavahāragocare sphuṭam antaḥ spurati tvayi prabho upayānty apayānti cāniśam mama vastūni vibhāntu sarvadā

en: Ever in Your city, or parted and roaming — may I be, by You: never even a moment's defeat for me, where I am become of You.
l3:
Ever in Thine own city — or cityless, roaming with Thee:
not a wink's crumb even be mine of defeat, forsooth, where Thee-made.
sa: satatam eva tavaiva pure 'thavāpy arahito vicareyam ahaṃ tvayā kṣaṇalavo 'py atha mā sma bhavet sa me na vijaye nanu yatra bhavanmayaḥ

en: Filled all round with cool nectar-floods streaming from Your limbs — in the wealth of worshipping You here, Your devotees move in saṃsāra's middle.
l3:
In Thy-limb-oozed well-cool-nectar-floods brimmed, all round even —
in Thy-worship-wealth here, Thy lovers in passing's lake within roam.
sa: bhavadaṅgaparisravatsuśītāmṛtapūrair bharite samantato 'pi bhavadarcanasampadeha bhaktās tava saṃsārasaro 'ntare caranti

en: In the cool shade of the great-mantra tree, in Your great forest, in my own self always, Lord, may I dwell as Your worshipper.
l3:
In great-chant-tree-shade-cool, in Thy high woods,
in mine own self ever, Ruler, may I dwell, Thy honorer.
sa: mahāmantratarucchāyāśītale tvanmahāvane nijātmani sadā nātha vaseyaṃ tava pūjakaḥ

en: As everything living mirrors You, mirror-formed — so before me, Lord, come forth graced with three eyes and trident.
l3:
To each thing of all breathers Thou dawnest, dawn-made —
as. So, my Ruler, forth to show fare, three-eyes-trident-graced.
sa: prativastu samastajīvataḥ pratibhāsi pratibhāmayo yathā mama nātha tathā puraḥ prathāṃ vraja netratrayaśūlaśobhitaḥ

en: From pride-offering, love-held devotion-built — pleased, when will You be everywhere my eyes' ground?
l3:
From pride-cake-offering, by mine-love's-weight built —
gladdened, when wilt Thou be my eyes' ground everywhere?
sa: abhimānacarūpahārato mamatābhaktibhareṇa kalpitāt paritoṣagataḥ kadā bhavān mama sarvatra bhaved dṛśaḥ padam

en: Dwelling in the nectar-ocean middle, mind drowned in Your worship-rite alone — may I do all people's business, tasting everything everywhere.
l3:
Dwelling in high-nectar-sea's middle, in Thy-honor-rule-alone sunk-mind —
all folk-faring may I ply, savoring, everywhere indeed, aught even.
sa: nivasanparamāmṛtābdhimadhye bhavadarcāvidhimātramagnacittaḥ sakalaṃ janavṛttam ācareyaṃ rasayan sarvata eva kiñcanāpi

en: Your thing here, Your truth — who is fit to disclose the matter? This same name-form-sport-unequalled of Yours takes away — since You are Hara, the Taker.
l3:
Thine here — be thing, be truth. To bare it, who here is vessel fit? This alone —
name-shape-stir-and-Co.-unequalled of Thine — takes. Taker art Thou, since.
sa: bhavadīyam ihāstu vastu tattvaṃ vivarītuṃ ka ivātra pātram arthe idam eva hi nāmarūpaceṣṭādyasamaṃ te harate haro 'si yasmāt

en: For peace, no hankering for pleasure at all, among those drunk with devotion amassed — nor even begging the fruit of seeking liberation remembered before the heart-thief.
l3:
For calm, no joy-hunger a jot — in love-heaped-frenzies. Freedom-wooing's fruit even —
no begging minded, before the heart-thief.
sa: śāntaye na sukhalipsutā manāg bhaktisambhṛtamadeṣu taiḥ prabhoḥ mokṣamārgaṇaphalāpi nārthanā smaryate hṛdayahāriṇaḥ puraḥ

en: Waking or other state, or any beyond, while slightly steady — for the devotee-people, all is Your festival in the ever-present mind.
l3:
Wake-or-other-state, or high — whatever even, a jot of standing: for love-bowl-folk, all is —
Thou-lorded-mind's — high feast.
sa: jāgaretaradaśāthavā parā yāpi kācana manāg avasthiteḥ bhaktibhājanajanasya sākhilā tvatsanāthamanaso mahotsavaḥ

en: Mind's eye-wheel courses, everywhere loosened yet still — reaching You, of firm-long awareness: Lord, how, by devotion-wealth's heat?
l3:
Mind's eye-ring's turns — everywhere slack-turned even, they —
Thee winning, hard-long-knowing, Ruler — by love-hoard's heat? How?
sa: āmano 'kṣavalayasya vṛttayaḥ sarvataḥ śithilavṛttayo 'pi tāḥ tvām avāpya dṛḍhadīrghasaṃvido nātha bhaktidhanasoṣmaṇāṃ katham

en: Nothing divided was left uncreated, no non-pleasure unmade here — yet all suffers and divides in every way: bow to the wonder-abode.
l3:
Nor sundered was unmade aught — yet unjoy here was never built.
Yet pained and parted in all ways — O matchless-wonder-home, bow be to Thee.
sa: na ca vibhinnam asṛjyata kiñcid asty atha sukhetarad atra na nirmitam atha ca duḥkhi ca bhedi ca sarvathāpy asamavismayadhāma namo 'stu te

en: Of me whose thought-stain is washed bright by hard-denier nectar-filling flood, whose unconquered-doubt-foe is crushed — may Your sight be unbroken.
l3:
Thought-stain washed bright by splashed denial-blade-nectar-filling —
doubt-foe unconquered crushed: Thy beholding be unbroken.
sa: kharaniṣedhakhadāmṛtapūraṇocchalitadhautavikalpamalasya me dalitadurjayasaṃśayavairiṇas tvadavalokanam astu nirantaram

en: Enter me plainly, then may I enter Thee — always, Lord, for I am Thine: with violent speed may I worship Thy body face to face.
l3:
Plain, enter me — then may I enter, ever, Ruler — Thine am I, since.
With rush Thy frame itself — outright, high-neared — may I honor.
sa: sphuṭam aviśa mām athāviśeyaṃ satataṃ nātha bhavantamasmi yasmāt rabhasena vapus tavaiva sākṣāt paramāsattigataḥ samarcayeyam

en: In You no one's is praise-power — yet it exists since You are so beautiful; my constant prayer again is this: that I behold You, Lord, unwearied.
l3:
In Thee no praise-might is any one's — or is indeed, since passing-fair art Thou.
Ever again my begged is this: that restless I behold the Ruler.
sa: tvayi na stutiśaktir asti kasyāpy athavāsty eva yato 'tisundaro 'si satataṃ punar arthitaṃ mamaitad yad aviśrānti vilokayeyam īśam

en: Beyond prayer-grounds, strange-fruit-giver — victorious, unprecedented in story, Śiva the true wish-tree.
l3:
Prayer-grounds-past, strange-fruit-giving —
wins, unheard-storied Śiva, true-wish-tree.
sa: prārthanābhūmikātītavicitraphaladāyakaḥ jayaty apūrvavṛttāntaḥ śivaḥ satkalpapādapaḥ

en: Since from the One container all is got through the self, from You — yet this own self of mine does not join Thee, the Highest — her.
l3:
In all things, from one hoard, through self —
from Thee all, they say, is won. But my own self, hers — joins Thee not, Highest.
sa: sarvavastuni ca yaikanidhānāt svātmanas tvad akhilaṃ kila labhyam asya me punar asau nijā ātmā na tvam eva ghaṭase paramās tām

en: The self, knowledge-action-formed consciousness-body, is in every way the Lord alone — but would there even be a body among all these things, or what else?
l3:
Knowing-doing-made knowing-frame, the self — in all ways High Lord alone may it be.
A frame amid all these things — forsooth, be it not? What else then?
sa: jñānakarmamayacidvapur ātmā sarvathaiṣa parameśvara eva syād vapus tu nikhileṣu padārtheṣv eṣu nāma na bhavet kim utānyat

en: By unequalled fruit, stealing pain — melt into His sight-natured form; may my going be His-formed.
l3:
By matchless pain-thieving fruit, by Thy-glance-natured —
melted, by the road, Lord — be mine Thy-made faring.
sa: viṣamārtimuṣānena phalena tvaddṛgātmanā abhilīya pathā nātha mamāstu tvanmayī gatiḥ

en: When will foot-thought-jewel-creeper-fruition, amazing the perfected, befall me, from You?
l3:
Thy-stainless-feet-thought-jewel-creeper-decked —
when, ripening, perfect-folks'-minds'-wonder-birthing, befall me from Thee?
sa: bhavadamalacaraṇacintāratnalatālaṅkṛtā kadā siddhiḥ siddhajanamānasānāṃ vismayajananī ghaṭeta mama bhavataḥ

en: When, Lord, shall I fully see Your pure face-orb, from which streams unprecedented nectar-flood, which drowns the whole world?
l3:
When, Lord — stainless Thy face-orb —
shall I full-behold, which streams nectar-flood unheard, drowning the world whole?
sa: karhi nātha vimalaṃ mukhabimbaṃ tāvakaṃ samavalokayitāsmi yatsravaty amṛtapūram apūrvaṃ yo nimajjayati viśvam aśeṣam

en: Your form, risen at mere meditation — when, Lord, will it ever fill with supreme-nectar floods my far gaps named non-duality-liberation?
l3:
Thought-barely-glad Thy shape —
when, Lord, with high-nectar-floods fill my far gaps, named Thy-undifference-freedom, ever?
sa: dhyātamātramuditaṃ tava rūpaṃ karhi nātha paramāmṛtapūraiḥ pūrayet tvadavibhedavimokṣākhyātidūravivarāṇi sadā me

en: By touch of Your peerless rasa, unroaming abandoned — not even now is my mind, Lord: when will it be? Let it be soon.
l3:
By Thine unexcelled-sap-touch, restlessness dropped —
not yet today my mind, Lord. When be it? Be it soon.
sa: tvadīyānuttararasāsaṅgasaṃtyaktacāpalam nādyāpi me mano nātha karhi syād astu śīghrataḥ

en: Not dry-bitter things only — bring on all, always, gained by offering to You; let even opposites befall me.
l3:
Not dry-bitter alone —
nay, all, ever, to Thee offered, won — clashes even rush me.
sa: mā śuṣkakaṭukāny eva paraṃ sarvāṇi sarvadā tavopahṛtya labdhāni dvandvāny apy āpatantu me

en: Lord, may Your pure rays come face to face, as long as body-mind-heat-dark is wiped out.
l3:
Lord —
face-to-face come Thy stainless rays, till frame-mind-fever-glooms are licked away.
sa: nātha sāṃmukhyam āyāntu viśuddhās tava raśmayaḥ yāvat kāyamanastāpatamobhiḥ parilupyatām

en: God, be gracious till my path-blockers, truth-stealing, sense-thieves are tamed.
l3:
God, clear — till my Thy-road-blockers, truth-thieving, tamed be —
strand-thieves.
sa: deva prasīda yāvan me tvanmārgaparipanthikāḥ paramārthamuṣo vaśyā bhūyāsur guṇataskarāḥ

en: With Your devotion-nectar-essence fill my mind fast, Lord — till these are carried off, drowned: all sapless habits.
l3:
With Thy love-nectar-piths be my mind brimmed — swift, All —
till these be carted off, flooded: sapless hankerings all.
sa: tvad bhaktisudhāsārair mānasam āpūryatāṃ mamāśu vibho yāvad imā uhyantāṃ niḥśeṣāsāravāsanāḥ plutvā

en: In liberation-state, where is devotion to You — how could it shine even for the mortal-natured? So set me, Unborn, on a fitting attainment-ground.
l3:
In freedom's state, whence would love in Thee shine —
for death-lawed even? Nay. So, befitting, raise me to attainment-ground, Unborn.
sa: mokṣadaśāyāṃ bhaktis tvayi kuta iva martyadharmiṇo 'pi na sā rājati tato 'nurūpām āropaya siddhibhūmikām aja mām

en: Greedy for a siddhi-drop's gain, don't settle proud me — thin is liberation beside Your devotion-face's sprouting aṇimā-wings.
l3:
Greedy for ripening's speck-winning, me — with smugness settle not, All.
Starved, before Thy love's face, is freedom — beside sprouting wonder-wings.
sa: siddhilavalābhalubdhaṃ mām avalepena mā vibho saṃsthāḥ kṣāmas tvadbhaktimukhe prollasadaṇimādipakṣato mokṣaḥ

en: May the Lord be pleased with me, His slave — I ask only this, since the three-worlds Giver exceeds my sight.
l3:
On me Thy slave clear, Lord — this much alone forsooth I beg.
Giver, three-worlds' Lord — past such-as-me's sight.
sa: dāsasya me prasīdatu bhagavān etāvad eva nanu yāce dātā tribhuvananātho yasya na tanmādṛśāṃ dṛśo viṣayaḥ

en: In mind full of Your body-mindfulness-nectar-rasa, may Your lotus-feet-pair bloom in mine, ever dripping honey, supramundane.
l3:
In mind brimmed with Thy-frame-mindfulness-nectar-sap —
Thy foot-lotus-pair in mine, blooming be it ever — honey-oozing, some, past-world.
sa: tvadvapuḥsmṛtisudhārasapūrṇe mānase tava padāmbujayugmam māmake vikasad astu sadaiva prasravanmadhu kim apy atilokam

en: I have a Lord, a father — Tryambaka — and a mother, Bhavānī; no second exists for me here — thus most-fulfilled may I roam.
l3:
Mine is the Master, yonder — father, then Three-eyed, then mother Bhavānī.
No second here, whoever, mine is. Thus most-content may I roam.
sa: asti me prabhur asau janako 'tha tryambako 'tha jananī ca bhavānī na dvitīya iha ko 'pi mamāstīty eva nirvṛtatamo vicareyam

en: Bow to the three-worlds' Lord, ash-white, three-eyed, trident-bearing, snake-threaded, moon-crested.
l3:
Lord — three-worlds' Lord —
ash-pale, three-eyed, trident-wielding, snake-threaded, moon-digit-crested: I bow.
sa: nathaṃ tribhuvananāthaṃ bhūtisitaṃ trinayanaṃ triśūladharam upavītīkṛtabhoginam indukalāśekharaṃ vande

en: I praise, self-forgetting, white-robed in bite-torn cloth, dancing to the tune of the skull-garland.
l3:
I praise —
self-frame-forgetting, bite-torn-cloth-wrapped-white-garbed, sporting-skull-chaplet-timed-dance-feast-ready.
sa: naumi nijatanuvinismaradaṃśukapariveṣadhavalaparidhānam vilasatkapālamālākalpitanṛttotsavākalpam

en: Bow to those whose god is Hara, whose acts are Hara-fit, whose lives lean wholly to Hara — the fortunate abodes.
l3:
I bow to them —
whose godhead is Hara, whose stirs are Hara-fit, Hara-alone-bent breaths ever: fortune's houses.
sa: vande tān daivataṃ yeṣāṃ haraś ceṣṭā harocitāḥ haraikapravaṇāḥ prāṇāḥ sadā saubhāgyasadmanām

en: Your play, behind lordship — and this too, as wished-fulfilled in gifts, by self I reach the supreme means.
l3:
Played, Thine — of great-lordship, behind. Other, this alone, as this:
'mid wished-barely-wrought bright deeds, by self I near the high means.
sa: krīḍitaṃ tava maheśvaratāyāḥ pṛṣṭhato 'nyad idam eva yathaitat iṣṭamātraghaṭiteṣv avadāneṣv ātmanā param upāyam upaimi

en: In Your world-venerated abode, in this play — how great would my bliss-birth be?
l3:
In Thy world-honored seat, this play being —
Thine, Ruler — how great be bliss-sap's birth?
sa: tvaddhāmni viśvavandye 'sminn iyati krīḍane sati tava nātha kiyān bhūyānn ānandarasasambhavaḥ

en: How could He not be fortunate — Hara, Gauri's beloved? And how could Hara not be Gauri's supreme beloved?
l3:
How be he not favored — who is Gauri's lover, Hara?
Though Hara He be — what then? Gauri's highest lover!
sa: kathaṃ sa subhago mā bhūdyo gauryā vallabho haraḥ haro 'pi mā bhūd atha kiṃ gauryāḥ paramavallabhaḥ

en: Whose meditation-nectar is undying, self-rooted, ever-fresh consciousness-creepers, like some tree of being.
l3:
Thought-nectar-made, self-rooted, undying —
knowing-creepers, so-shaped: his, some being-tree's.
sa: dhyānāmṛtamayaṃ yasya svātmamūlam anaśvaram saṃvillatās tathārūpās tasya kasyāpi sattaroḥ

en: At devotion-itch's showing, Lord's pillar-firmness arises — by it the world, great festival, is won.
l3:
Love-itch at bliss-tide, High Lord —
great-touchstone-rock-pillar: worship itself is born.
sa: bhaktikaṇḍūsam ullāsāvasare parameśvara mahānikaṣapāṣāṇasthūṇā pūjaiva jāyate

en: Ever to creation-sport, ever seated in staying-pleasure, ever world-eating-sated — to the Master, bow.
l3:
Ever to world-birthing-sport, ever to staying-joy-seated, ever to three-worlds'-food-sated Master —
bow.
sa: sadā srṣṭivinodāya sadā sthitisukhāsine sadā tribhuvanāhāratṛptāya svāmine namaḥ

en: Nowhere gone, nothing left — who see Your abode as to-be here, fortunate: bow to them.
l3:
Nowhither gone, naught left —
who, just this, see Thy seat as blest-to-be — the blest: to them bow, bow.
sa: na kvāpi gatvā hitvāpi na kiṃcid idam eva ye bhavyaṃ tvaddhāma paśyanti bhavyās tebhyo namo namaḥ

en: For the devotion-fortuned, what else is begged; for the devotion-poor, what else is begged?
l3:
For love-fortune-rich, what else is begged?
By this, for the poor — what else is begged?
sa: bhaktilakṣmīsamṛddhānāṃ kim anyad upayācitam etayā vā daridraṇāṃ kim anyad upayācitam

en: Where pains turn pleasures, poison turns nectar, saṃsāra turns liberation — that path is Śiva.
l3:
Pains even grow joys, poison even grows nectar, and passing grows freedom —
where? The road: He, Kind-Maker.
sa: duḥkhāny api sukhāyante viṣam apy amṛtāyate mokṣāyate ca saṃsāro yatra mārgaḥ sa śaṅkaraḥ

en: At root, middle, end, no suffering for Your people — yet we sink, Lord: tell why.
l3:
At root, middle, end —
no pain for Thy partakers. Yet we, Ruler, sink. How? — say.
sa: mūle madhye 'vasāne ca nāsti duḥkhaṃ bhavajjuṣāṃ tathāpi vayam īśāna sīdāmaḥ katham ucyatām

en: Light is worth begging even by others, beginners in knowledge-yoga — You, Lord of devotees, are like the light of the free.
l3:
By knowing-yoga-and-Co., others' even —
worth awaiting is light, of the free-ranging, as it were. Art Thou — of lovers, Ruler.
sa: jñānayogādinānyeṣām apy apekṣitum arhati prakāśaḥ svairiṇām iva bhavān bhaktimatāṃ prabho

en: Devotees have no prayers, no remembrance of You the self — yet this "Śiva" of theirs, something, on the lip.
l3:
Lovers' are no pangs, nor brooding on Thy self. Yet there is 'Śiva' —
this, some, on their outward mouth.
sa: bhaktānāṃ nārtayo nāpy asty ādhyānaṃ svātmanas tava tathāpy asti śivety etat kim apy eṣāṃ bahirmukhe

en: Who lights all appearances, wrapped in vimarśa — "I am this": I praise Your action-power, Lord.
l3:
Who lights all showings, relish-girt — all; 'I am this' —
so I praise her, deed-power, Ruler — Thine.
sa: sarvābhāsāvabhāso yo vimarśavalito 'khilam aham etad iti staumi tāṃ kriyāśaktim īśa te

en: All beings, from Brahmā to Viṣṇu, being devoured — so I bow, God, to the world as Your-formed.
l3:
Fare breathers all — ay, Brahmā-Indra-Viṣṇu —
guzzled. So I bow, God, to the world Thee-made.
sa: vartante jantavo 'śeṣā api brahmendraviṣṇavaḥ grasamānās tato vande deva viśvaṃ bhavanmayam

en: All beyond Me is false, by relation to destruction — thus engaged, Lord, by Your destruction-play alone.
l3:
By beings' ruin-tie, past me all is sham. So indeed is roused, Ruler —
by Thee, with ending-sport.
sa: sato vināśasambandhān matparaṃ nikhilaṃ mṛṣā evamevodyate nātha tvayā saṃhāralīlayā

en: Meditated, Your form stands present for devotion-rich — unconquered by unthinkable-wonder-makers.
l3:
Thought on, stands by itself Thy frame, Boon-lord —
for love-rich. Past thought even — 'gainst all-marvel-thought-makers, they win.
sa: dhyātam ātmupatiṣṭhata eva tvadvapur varada bhaktidhanānām apy acintyam akhilādbhutacintākartṛtāṃ prati ca te vijayante

en: By Your devotion-wine-taste nerves' thrill, night-heroes dance, roused by vetālas.
l3:
As if by Thy-love-sap-wine-sprinkling, by glad-pith-ring-throbs —
dances hero-folk at night, by corpse-fiend-throngs spurred.
sa: tāvakabhaktirasāsavasekād iva sukhitamarmamaṇḍalasphuritaiḥ nṛtyati vīrajano niśi vetālakulaiḥ kṛtotsāhaḥ

en: The praise begun with this limb of mine — by it may all this time be firmly unending.
l3:
Begun, Thy high-praise — with this, by which limb, mine, Kind One —
thereby, to no end, this time, firm, all — may it be.
sa: ārabdhā bhavadabhinutir amunā yenāṅgakena mama śambho tenāparyantam imaṃ kālaṃ dṛḍham akhilam eva bhaviṣīṣṭa

1.1: caitanyam ātmā | 1.2: jñānaṃ bandhaḥ | 1.3: yonivargaḥ kalāśarīram | 1.4: jñānādhiṣṭhānaṃ mātṛkā | 1.5: udyamo bhairavaḥ | 1.6: śakticakrasaṃdhāne viśvasaṃhāraḥ | 1.7: jñānaṃ jāgrat | 1.8: svapno vikalpāḥ | 1.9: aviveko māyā sauṣuptam | 1.10: tritayabhoktā vīreśaḥ

1.11: vismayo yogabhūmikāḥ | 1.12: icchā śaktir umā kumārī | 1.13: dṛśyaṃ śarīram | 1.14: śuddhatattvasaṃdhānād vāpaśuśaktiḥ | 1.15: vitarka ātmajñānam | 1.16: lokānandaḥ samādhisukham | 1.17: śaktisaṃdhāne śarīrotpattiḥ | 1.18: bhūtasaṃdhānabhūtapṛthaktvaviśvasaṃghaṭṭāḥ | 1.19: śuddhavidyodayāc cakreśatvasiddhiḥ | 1.20: mahāhradānusaṃdhānān mantravīryānubhavaḥ

2.1: cittaṃ mantraḥ | 2.2: prayatnaḥ sādhakaḥ | 2.3: vidyāśarīrasattā mantrarahasyam | 2.4: garbhe cittavikāso 'viśiṣṭavidyāsvapnaḥ | 2.5: vidyāsamutthāne svābhāvike khecarī śivāvasthā | 2.6: gurur upāyaḥ | 2.7: mātṛkācakrasaṃbodhaḥ | 2.8: śarīraṃ haviḥ | 2.9: jñānam annam | 2.10: vidyāsaṃhāre tadutthasvapnadarśanam

3.1: ātmā cittam | 3.2: jñānaṃ bandhaḥ | 3.3: kalādīnāṃ tattvānām aviveko māyā | 3.4: śarīre saṃhāraḥ kalānām | 3.5: nāḍīsaṃhārabhūtajayabhūtakaivalyabhūtapṛthaktvāni | 3.6: mohāvaraṇāt siddhiḥ | 3.7: mohajayād anantābhogāt sahajavidyājayaḥ | 3.8: jāgrad dvitīyakaraḥ | 3.9: nartaka ātmā | 3.10: raṅgo 'ntarātmā

3.11: prekṣakāṇīndriyāṇi | 3.12: dhīvaśāt sattvasiddhiḥ | 3.13: siddhaḥ svatantrabhāvaḥ | 3.14: yathā tatra tathānyatra | 3.15: bījāvadhānam | 3.16: āsanasthaḥ sukhaṃ hrade nimajjati | 3.17: svamātrānirmāṇam āpādayati | 3.18: vidyāvināśe janmavināśaḥ | 3.19: kavargādiṣu māheśvaryādyāḥ paśumātaraḥ | 3.20: triṣu caturthaṃ tailavad āsecyam

3.21: magnaḥ svacittena praviśet | 3.22: prāṇasamācāre samadarśanam | 3.23: madhye 'varaprasavaḥ | 3.24: mātrāsv apratyayasaṃdhāne naṣṭasya punar utthānam | 3.25: śivatulyo jāyate | 3.26: śarīravṛttir vratam | 3.27: kathā japaḥ | 3.28: dānam ātmajñānam | 3.29: yo 'vipastho jñāhetuś ca | 3.30: svaśaktipracayo viśvam

3.31: sthitilayau | 3.32: tatpravṛttāv apy anirāsaḥ saṃvettṛbhāvāt | 3.33: sukhāsukhayor bahir mananam | 3.34: tadvimuktas tu kevalī | 3.35: mohapratisaṃhatas tu karmātmā | 3.36: bhedatiraskāre sargāntarakarmatvam | 3.37: karaṇaśaktiḥ svato 'nubhavāt | 3.38: tripadādyanuprāṇanam | 3.39: cittasthitivac charīrakaraṇabāhyeṣu | 3.40: abhilāpād bahirgatiḥ saṃvāhyasya

3.41: tadārūḍhapramites tatkṣayāj jīvasaṃkṣayaḥ | 3.42: bhūtakañcukī tadā vimukto bhūyaḥ patisamaḥ paraḥ | 3.43: naisargikaḥ prāṇasambandhaḥ | 3.44: nāsikāntarmadhyasaṃyamāt kim atra savyāpasavyasauṣumneṣu | 3.45: bhūyaḥ syāt pratimīlanam

yatra sthitam idaṃ sarvaṃ kāryaṃ yasmāc ca nirgataṃ | tasyānāvṛtarūpatvān na nirodho 'sti kutracit jāgradādi vibhede 'pi tadabhinne prasarpati | nivartate nijānnaiva svabhāvād upalabdhṛtaḥ ahaṃ sukhī ca duḥkhī ca raktaś ca ityadisamvidaḥ | sukhādyavasthānusyūte vartante 'nyatra tāḥ sphuṭam na duḥkhaṃ na sukhaṃ yatra na grāhyam grāhakaṃ na ca | na cāsti mūḍhabhāvo 'pi tad asti paramārthataḥ yataḥ karaṇavargo 'yaṃ vimūḍho 'mūḍhavat svayam | sahāntareṇa cakreṇa pravṛttisthitisaṃhṛtiḥ labhate tatpra

tam adhiṣṭhātṛbhāvena svabhāvam avalokayan | smayamāna ivāste yas tasyeyaṃ kusṛtiḥ kutaḥ nābhāvo bhāvyatām eti na ca tatrāsty amūḍhatā | yato 'bhiyogasaṃsparśāt tadāsid iti niścayah atas tatkṛtrimaṃ jñeyaṃ sauṣuptapadavat sadā | na tv evaṃ smaryamāṇatvaṃ tat tattvam pratipadyate avasthāyugalaṃ cātra kāryakartṛtvaśabditam | kāryatā kṣayiṇī tatra kartṛtvam punar akṣayam kāryonmukhaḥ prayatno yaḥ kevalaṃ so 'tra lupyate | tasmin lupte vilupto 'smīty abudhaḥ pratipadyate na tu yo 'ntarmukho bhāvah s

aprabudhadhiyas tv ete svasthitisthaganodyatāḥ | pātayanti duruttāre ghore saṃsāravartmani ataḥ satatam udyuktaḥ spandatattvaviviktaye | jāgrad eva nijam bhāvam acireṇādhigacchati atikruddhaḥ prahṛṣṭo vā kiṃ karomīti vā mṛśan | dhāvan va yat padaṃ gacchet tatra spandaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ yām avasthāṃ samālambya yad ayam mama vakṣyati | tadavaśyaṃ kariṣye 'ham iti saṃkalpya tiṣṭhati tām aśrityordhvamārgeṇa candrasūryāv ubhāv api | sauṣumne 'dhvanyastamito hitvā brahmā.ṅdagocaram tadā tasmin mahāvyomni

tasmāc chabdārthacintāsu na sāvasthā na yā śivaḥ | bhoktaiva bhogyabhāvena sadā sarvatra saṃsthitaḥ iti vā yasya saṃvittiḥ krīḍātvenākhilaṃ jagat | sa paśyan satataṃ yukto jīvanmukto na saṃśayaḥ ayam evodayas tasya dhyeyasya dhyāyicetasi | tadātmatāsamāpattir icchataḥ sādhakasya yā iyam evāmṛtaprāptir ayam evātmano grahaḥ | iyaṃ nirvāṇa-dīkṣā ca śivasadbhāvadāyini tṛtīyo niḥṣyandaḥ yathecchābhyarthito dhātā jāgrato 'rthān hṛdi sthitān somasūryodayaṃ kṛtvā sampādayati dehinaḥ || 1 | tathā svapne

anenādhiṣṭhite dehe yathā sarvajñatādayaḥ | tathā svātmany adhiṣṭhānāt sarvatraivam bhaviṣyati glānir vilu.ṅthikā dehe tasyāścājñānataḥ sṛtiḥ | tad unmeṣaviluptaṃ cet kutaḥ sā syād ahetukā ekacintāprasaktasya yataḥ syād aparodayaḥ | unmeṣaḥ sa tu vijñeyaḥ svayaṃ tam upalakṣayet ato bindur ato nādo rūpam asmād ato rasaḥ | pravartante 'cireṇaiva kṣobhakatvena dehinaḥ didṛkṣayeva sarvārthān yadā vyāpyāvatiṣṭhate | tadā kiṃ bahunoktena svayam eva avabhotsyate prabuddhaḥ sarvadā tiṣṭhej jñānenālokya

seyaṃ kriyātmikā śaktiḥ śivasya paśuvartinī | bandhayitrī svamārgasthā jñāta siddhyupapādikā tanmātrodayarūpena mano 'haṃbuddhivartinā | puryaṣṭakena saṃruddhas taduttham pratyayodbhavam bhuṅkte paravaśo bhogaṃ tadbhāvāt saṃsared ataḥ | saṃsṛtipralayasyāsya kāraṇaṃ sampracakṣmahe yadā tv ekatra saṃrūḍhas tadā tasya layodayau | niyacchan bhoktṛtām eti tataś cakreśvaro bhavet caturtho niḥṣyandaḥ agādhasaṃśayāmbhodhisamuttaraṇatārinīm | vande vicitrārthapadāṃ citrāṃ tāṃ gurubhāratīm labdhvāpy alabh

en:
He alone — Śiva, possessing spanda, self-established — who makes the inner face taste.

This hero, lord of the Kula — victorious.
l3:
He alone conquers — Śiva, throbbing, self-established — who savors the inner face.
Victorious is this hero, the Kula’s lord.
sa: sa jayati śiva ekaḥ spandavānsvapratiṣṭhaḥ yo'ntarvaktraṃ rasayati jayatyeṣa vīraḥ kulendraḥ

yaḥ sphītaḥ śrīdayābodhaparamānandasampadā vidyoddyotitamāhātmyaḥ sa jayaty aparājitaḥ prasaradbindunādāya śuddhāmṛtamayātmane namo 'nantaprakāśāya śaṃkarakṣīrasindhave dviṣmas tvāṃ tvāṃ stumas tubhyaṃ mantrayāmo 'mbikāpate ativāllabhyataḥ sādhu viśvaṅ no dhṛtavān asi saṃhṛtasparśayogāya sampūrṇāmṛtasūtaye viyanmāyāsvarūpāya vibhave śambhave namaḥ bhinneṣv api na bhinnaṃ yac chinneṣv achinnam eva ca namāmaḥ sarvasāmānyaṃ rūpaṃ tat pārameśvaram praṇavordhvārdhamātrāto 'py aṇave mahate punaḥ brahm

api paśyema gambhīrāṃ pareṇa jyotiṣābhitaḥ unmṛṣṭatamasaṃ ramyām antarbhava bhavadguhām namas tebhyo 'pi ye somakalākalitaśekharam nāthaṃ svapne 'pi paśyanti paramānandadāyinam bhagavan bhava bhāvatkaṃ bhāvaṃ bhāvayituṃ ruciḥ punarbhavabhayocchedadakṣā kasmai na rocate yāvajjīvaṃ jagannātha kartavyam idam astu naḥ tvatprasādāt tvadekāgramanaskatvena yā sthitiḥ śākhāsahasravistīrṇavedāgamamayātmane namo 'nantaphalotpādakalpavṛkṣāya śambhave vāṅmanaḥkāyakarmāṇi viniyojya tvayi prabho tvanmayībhūya

arcito 'yam ayaṃ dhyāta eṣa toṣita ity ayam rasaḥ srotaḥsahasreṇa tvayi me bhava vardhatām namo niḥśeṣadhīpatrimālālayamayātmane nāthāya sthāṇave tubhyaṃ nāgayajñopavītine ajñānatimirasyaikam auṣadhaṃ saṃsmṛtis tava bhava tattatpradānena prasādaḥ kriyatāṃ mayi nama īśāya niḥśeṣapuruṣārthaprasādhakaḥ praṇantavyaḥ praṇāmo 'pi yadīya iha dhīmatām magnair bhīme bhavāmbhodhau nilaye duḥkhayādasām bhakticintāmaṇiṃ śārvaṃ tataḥ prāpya na kiṃ jitam nirāvaraṇanirdvandvaniścalajñānasampadām jñeyo 'si kila

icchāyā eva yasyeyat phalaṃ lokatrayātmakam tasya te nātha kāryāṇāṃ ko vetti kiyatī gatiḥ brahmādayo 'pi tad yasya karmasopānamālayā upary upari dhāvanti labdhuṃ dhāma namāmi tam ayaṃ brahmā mahendro 'yaṃ sūryācandramasāv imau iti śaktilatā yasya puṣpitā pātv asau bhavaḥ bhramo na labhyate yasya bhrāntāntaḥkaraṇair api dūragair api yasyānto durgam astaṃ stumo mṛḍam namaḥ stutau smṛtau dhyāne darśane sparśane tathā prāptau cānandavṛndāya dayitāya kapardine kiṃ smayeneti matvāpi manasā parameśvara

namo nirupakāryāya trailokyaikopakāriṇe sarvasya spṛhaṇīyāya niḥspṛhāya kapardine aho kṣetrajñatā seyaṃ kāryāya mahate satām yayānantaphalāṃ bhaktiṃ vapanti tvayy amī prabho mahatīyam aho māyā tava māyin yayāvṛtaḥ tvaddhyānanidhilābhe 'pi mugdho lokaḥ ślathāyate ārambhe bhava sarvatra karma vā karaṇādi vā viśvam astu svatantras tu kartā tatraikako bhavān triguṇatriparispandadvandvagrastaṃ jagattrayam uddhartuṃ bhavato 'nyasya kasya śaktiḥ kṛpāthavā doṣo 'pideva ko doṣas tvām āptuṃ yaḥ samāsthita

upasaṃhṛtakāmāya kāmāyatim atanvate avataṃsitasomāya somāya svāmine namaḥ kim aśaktaḥ karomīti sarvatrānadhyavasyataḥ sarvānugrāhikā śaktiḥ śāṃkarī śaraṇaṃ mama guṇātītasya nirdiṣṭaniḥśeṣātiśayātmanaḥ labhyate bhava kutrāṃśe paraḥ pratinidhis tava nirdvandve nirupādhau ca tvayy ātmani sati prabho vayaṃ vañcyāmahe 'dyāpi māyayāmeyayā tava aṇimādiguṇāvāptiḥ sadaiśvaryaṃ bhavakṣayaḥ amī bhava bhavadbhaktikalpapādapapallavāḥ yā yā dik tatra na kvāsi sarvaḥ kālo bhavanmayaḥ iti labdho 'pi karhi tvaṃ

trailokye 'py atra yo yāvān ānandaḥ kaścid īkṣyate sa bindur yasya taṃ vande devam ānandasāgaram aho brahmādayo dhanyā ye vimuktānyasaṃkatham namo namaḥ śivāyeti japanty āhlādavihvalāḥ niṣkāmāyāpi kāmānām anantānāṃ vidhāyine anāditve 'pi viśvasya bhoktre bhava namo 'stu te stumas tribhuvanārambhamūlaprakṛtim īśvaram lipseran nopakāraṃ ke yataḥ sampūrṇadharmaṇaḥ mahatsv apy arthakṛcchreṣu mohaughamalinīkṛtāḥ smṛte yasmin prasīdanti matayas taṃ śivaṃ stumaḥ prabho bhavata eveha prabhuśaktir abhaṅg

namas te bhavasambhrāntabhrāntim udbhāvya bhindate jñānānandaṃ ca nirdvandvaṃ deva vṛtvā vivṛṇvate yasyāḥ prāpyeta paryantaviśeṣaḥ kair manorathaiḥ māyām ekanimeṣeṇa muṣṇaṃs tāṃ pātu naḥ śivaḥ vairāgyasya gatiṃ gurvīṃ jñānasya paramāṃ śriyam naiḥspṛhyasya parāṃ koṭiṃ bibhratāṃ tvaṃ prabho prabhuḥ brahmaṇo 'pi bhavān brahma kasya neśas tvam īśituḥ jagatkalyāṇakalyāṇaṃ kiyat tvam iti vetti kaḥ kim anyair bandhubhiḥ kiṃ ca suhṛdbhiḥ svāmibhis tathā sarvasthāne mameśa tvaṃ ya uddhartā bhavārṇavāt ja

duṣkaraṃ sukarīkartuṃ duḥkhaṃ sukhayituṃ tathā ekavīrā smṛtir yasya taṃ smarāmaḥ smaradviṣam jayanti gītayo yāsāṃ sa geyaḥ parameśvaraḥ yannāmnāpi mahātmānaḥ kīryante pulakāṅkuraiḥ bhavān iva bhavān eva bhaved yadi paraṃ bhava svaśaktivyūhasaṃvyūḍhatrailokyārambhasaṃhṛtiḥ mantro 'si mantraṇīyo 'si mantrī tvattaḥ kuto 'paraḥ sa mahyaṃ dehi taṃ mantraṃ tvanmantraḥ syāṃ yathā prabho bhārūpaḥ satyasaṃkalpas tvam ātmā yasya so 'py aham saṃsārīti kim īśaiṣa svapnaḥ so 'pi kutas tvayi tad abhaṅgi tad a

namaḥ kṛtakṛtāntānta tubhyaṃ madanamardine mastakanyastagaṅgāya yathāyuktārthakāriṇe aiśvaryajñānavairāgyadharmebhyo 'py upari sthitim nātha prārthayamānānāṃ tvad ṛte kā parā gatiḥ tvayy anicchati kaḥ śambho śaktaḥ kubjayituṃ tṛṇam tvadicchānugṛhītas tu vahed brāhmīṃ dhuraṃ na kaḥ harapraṇatimāṇikyamukuṭotkaṭamastakāḥ nameyuḥ kaṃ paraṃ kaṃ vā namayeyur na dhīdhanāḥ sarvavibhramanirmokaniṣkampam amṛtahradam bhavajjñānāmbudher madhyam adhyāsīyāpi dhūrjaṭe citraṃ yac citradṛṣṭo 'pi manorathagato 'p

niḥśeṣakleśahānasya hetuḥ ka iti saṃśaye svāmin so 'sīti niścitya kas tvāṃ na śaraṇaṃ gataḥ bhuktvā bhogān bhavabhrāntiṃ hitvā lapsye paraṃ padam ity āśaṃseha śobheta śambhau bhaktimataḥ param nātha svapne 'pi yat kuryāṃ brūyāṃ vā sādhv asādhu vā tvadadhīnatvadarpeṇa sarvatrātrāsmi nirvṛtaḥ jyotiṣām api yaj jyotis tatra tvaddhāmni dhāvataḥ cittasyeśa tamaḥsparśo manye vandhyātmajānujaḥ manye nyastapadaḥ so 'pi kṣemye mokṣasya vartmani manorathaḥ sthito yasya seviṣye śivam ity ayam sthityutpattil

aho svādutamaḥ śarvasevāśaṃsāsudhārasaḥ kutra kālakalāmātre na yo navanavāyate muhur muhur aviśrāntas trailokyaṃ kalpanāśataiḥ kalpayann api ko 'py eko nirvikalpo jayaty ajaḥ malatailāktasaṃsāravāsanāvartidāhinā jñānadīpena deva tvāṃ kadā nu syām upasthitaḥ nimeṣam api yady ekaṃ kṣīṇadoṣe kariṣyasi padaṃ citte tadā śambho kiṃ na sampādayiṣyasi dhanyo 'smi kṛtakṛtyo 'smi mahān asmīti bhāvanā bhavet sālambanā tasya yas tvadālambanaḥ prabho śubhāśubhasya sarvasya svayaṃ kartā bhavān api bhavadbhakt

aśeṣadarśanāveśaviśeṣādhivivarjitam / svasaṃvedanasaṃvedyaṃ svasthaṃ vande paraṃ śivam nirastakalpanājālavikalpaughavighātine / namo 'stu paramānandapadātītāya śambhave jayanty apārasaṃsārasārāsāravibhāgadāḥ / kaivalyajñānasaṃbodhahetavaś śambhavāṅghrayaḥ mano buddhir ahaṃ prāṇās tanmātrendriyajīvanam / yaṃ dṛṣṭvā vinivartante tam upāsyam upāsmahe mamāham iti hṛdgranthicchedanaikakṛpāṇikām / spandāspandakṛtagrāsāṃ naumy ahaṃ śuddhasaṃvidam vyapadeśavihīnasya tattvasya kathanaṃ katham / svasaṃved

svasaṃkalpaparāmarśād viśuddhajñānasaṃśrayāt / paramāhlādalābhāc ca bodhaikaghanatā muneḥ nigṛhīte svasaṃkalpe śakteḥ śaktimati sthitiḥ / śaktiśaktimator aikyam ity upeyaṃ ca yoginām prāpte svarūpavijñāne santyakte tattvakañcuke / udyogakāraṇe kīrṇe muktaḥ sa kila kathyate bodhamātre grahaḥ kāryaḥ suprabuddhena cetasā / tāvad yāvat svasāmarthyāt svaniṣṭhaḥ kevalo bhavet sarvadā suprabuddhas san paśyaty ātmānam ātmanā / draṣṭuḥ svarūpasaṃsthasya kim anyad avaśiṣyate sadaiva suprabuddhatvam etāvan

grāhyagrahaṇasaṃskāratiraskāraikacetasām / yogināṃ svātmaniṣṭhānāṃ mokṣalakṣmīr na durlabhā labdhā svarūpaviśrāntir nirvṛttā kleśasantatiḥ / grāhyagrāhakatā bhagnā svarūpastho' smi saṃsthitaḥ abhedabodhasaṃbodhasvarūpānubhavasthitim / vyutthitaḥ sanniruddho vā labhate yaḥ sa tattvavit yasya sarvāsv avasthāsu svasthitir naiva lupyate / tasya kiṃ nāma kurvanti śāstrabhramaṇavibhramāḥ vigalitasadasadvikalpasadasadbhramajanitamohamuktātmā / jīvann api janamadhye vigatabhayaḥ sarvadā yogī nirastakara

nairvāsanyāt svasaṃbodhāt tyāgād āśābhimānayoḥ / sadasatpadavicchedān na punar vigrahagrahaḥ āśvastāntaḥkaraṇaḥ kṣīṇavikalpaḥ svarūpalābharataḥ / svānubhavāmṛtatṛptaḥ kaivalyaṃ yāti caritārthaḥ ittham upeyaprāptau vigatamalā citprakāśikā satyā / kaivalyabhūtijananī svabodhasiddhir mayā gaditā yenopadeśena nalabdhalābho bhavaty alaṃ saṃśayadoṣamuktaḥ / tenopadeśena nasaṃśayena kiṃ nāma kuryād bahuśāstrapāṭhī aśeṣakṛtamaṅgalaṃ vividhakarmadāvānalaṃ svarūpapadadarśakaṃ sakalakalpanāvarjitam / samas

tadubhayayāmalasphuritabhāvavisargamayaṃ hṛdayamanuttarāmṛtakulaṃ mama sasphuratāt mātṛmānaprameyāṃśaśūlāmbujakṛtāspadām prāvṛṇmeghaghanavyomavidyullekhāvilāsinīm stājjñānaśūlaṃ satpakṣavipakṣotkartanakṣamam tadeva devītrayamantarāstāmanuttaraṃ me prathayatsvarūpam devīsuto gaṇapatiḥ sphuradindukāntiḥ samyaksamucchalayatānmama saṃvidabdhim kalombhitaṃ bāhyapathe cakāra stānme sa macchandavibhuḥ prasannaḥ pūrve jayanti guravo guruśāstrasindhukallolakelikalanāmalakarṇadhārāḥ tadaparamūrtirbhagavān

gurorlakṣmaṇaguptasya nādasaṃmohinīṃ numaḥ sa śrīcukhulako diśyādiṣṭaṃ me gururuttamaḥ yadudīritaśāsanāṃśubhirme prakaṭo@yaṃ gahano@pi śāstramārgaḥ anuttaraṣaḍardhārthakrame tvekāpi nekṣyate arthito racaye spaṣṭāṃ pūrṇārthā prakriyāmimām bodhānyapāśaviṣanuttadupāsanotthabodhojjvalo@bhinavagupta idaṃ karoti devadevena nirdiṣṭaṃ svaśabdenātha liṅgataḥ tatsāraṃ trikaśāstraṃ hi tatsāraṃ mālinīmatam adṛṣṭa prakaṭīkurmo gurunāthājñayā vayam trinayanacaraṇasaroruhacintanalabdhaprasiddhiriti

abhinavaguptahṛdambujametadvicinuta maheśapūjanahetoḥ ajñānaṃ saṃsṛterheturjñānaṃ mokṣaikakāraṇam iti proktaṃ tathā va śrīmalinīvijayottare saṃbhāvanāṃ nirasyaitadabhāve mokṣamabravīt sa hi loṣṭādike@pyasti na ca tasyāsti saṃsṛtiḥ jñānameva tadajñānaṃ śivasūtreṣu bhāṣitam saṃśleṣetarayogāśyāmayamarthaḥ pradarśitaḥ anākṣipraviśeṣaṃ sadāha sūtre purātane bruvatā tasya cinmātrarūpasya dvaitamucyate tata eva samucchedyamityāvṛttyānirūpitam

na mokṣo nāma tannāsya pṛthaṅnāmāpi gṛhyate taduttarottaraṃ jñānaṃ tattatsaṃsāraśāntidam itthaṃ samāsavyāsābhyāṃ jñānaṃ muñcati tāvataḥ amukta eva muktastu sarvāvacchedavarjitaḥ avacchedairna tatkutrāpyajñānaṃ satyamuktidam dvidhā pauruṣabauddhatvabhidoktaṃ śivaśāsane svapūrṇacitkriyārūpaśivatāvaraṇātmakam tadajñānaṃ na budghyaṃśo@dhyavasāyādyabhāvataḥ ṣaṭkañcukābilāṇūtthapratibimbanato yadā bauddhaṃ tasya ca tatpauṃsnaṃ poṣaṇīyaṃ ca poṣṭṛca

vikasvaraṃ tadvijñānaṃ pauruṣaṃ nirvikalpakam tadbauddhaṃ yasya tatpauṃsnaṃ prāgvatpoṣyaṃ ca poṣṭṛ ca tathāpi taccharīrānte tajjñānaṃ vyajyate sphuṭam vilīyate tadā jīvanmuktiḥ karatale sthitā tena tatrāpi bauddhasya jñānasyāsti pradhānatā mataṅgādau kṛtaṃ śrīmatkheṭapālādidaiśikaiḥ śāstrameva pradhānaṃ yajjñeyatattvapradarśakam dhīgatasyānivṛttatvādvikalpo@pi hi saṃbhaveta dehānte@pi na mokṣaḥ syātpauruṣājñānahānitaḥ tadaiva mokṣa ityuktaṃ dhātrā śrīmanniśāṭane

itarastu tadaiveti śāstrasyātra pradhānataḥ nahyaprakāśarūpasya prākāśyaṃ vastutāpi vā yatkuḍyasadṛśī neyaṃ dhīravastvetadityapi anapahnavanīyatvāt kiṃ tasminmānakalpanaiḥ teṣāmapi paro jīvaḥ sa eva parameśvaraḥ jñānamātmārthamityetanneti māṃ prati bhāsate yattatra ke pramāṇānāmupapattyupayogite tasya devātidevasya parāpekṣā na vidyate anapekṣasya vaśino deśakālākṛtikramāḥ vibhutvātsarvago nityabhāvādādyantavarjitaḥ

tato@sya bahurūpatvamuktaṃ dīkṣottarādike bindunādādisaṃbhinnaḥ ṣaḍvidhaḥ śiva ucyate vyomādiśabdavijñānātparo mokṣo na saṃśayaḥ anavacchinnatārūḍhāvavacchedalaye@sya ca jaladarpaṇavattena sarvaṃ vyāptaṃ carācaram eka evāsya dharmo@sau sarvākṣepeṇa vartate bahuśaktitvamapyasya tacchaktyaivāviyuktatā tenādvayaḥ sa evāpi śaktimatparikalpane ko bhedo vastuto vahnerdagdhṛpaktṛtvayoriva nahyasti kiṃcittacchaktitadvadbhedo@pi vāstavaḥ

śaktistadapi devyevaṃ bhāntyapyanyasvarūpiṇī svasaṃvinmātṛmakure svātantryādbhāvanādiṣu śaktirityeṣa vastveva śaktitadvatkramaḥ sphuṭaḥ anubhāvo vikalpo@pi mānaso na manaḥ śive kṣudhādyanubhavo naiva vikalpo nahi mānasaḥ vikalpo vetti tadvattu nādabindvādinā śivam kalātattvapurārṇāṇupadādirbhedavistaraḥ turyamityapi devasya bahuśaktitvajṛmbhitam tānyapyamuṣya nāthasya svātantryalaharībharaḥ akalau sakalaśceti śivasyaiva vibhūtayaḥ

ātmaiva hi svabhāvātmetyuktaṃ śrītriśiromate sāmūhyaṃ caiva tattvānāṃ grāmaśabdena kīrtitam prakāśāvasthitaṃ jñānaṃ bhāvābhāvādimadhyataḥ viviktavastukathitaśuddhavijñānanirmalaḥ ūrdhva tyaktvādho viśetsa rāmastho madhyadeśagaḥ dhāvanaṃ plavanaṃ caiva āyāsaḥ śaktivedanam eṣa rāmo vyāpako@tra śivaḥ paramakāraṇam dhyāyate paramaṃ dhyeyaṃ gamāgamapade sthitam tatsvarūpaṃ japaḥ prokto bhāvābhāvapadacyutaḥ dūrāsannādiko bhedaścitsvātantryavyapekṣayā

kena nāma na rūpeṇa bhāsate parameśvaraḥ āvṛtānāvṛto bhāti bahudhā bhedasaṃgamāt icchādibhirabhikhyābhirgurubhiḥ prakaṭīkṛtam mahābhairavadevo@yaṃ patiryaḥ paramaḥ śivaḥ savimarśatayā rava rūpataśca saṃsārabhīruhitakṛcca prakaṭībhūtaṃ bhavabhayavimarśanaṃ śaktipātato yena kālagrāsasamādhānarasikamanaḥsu teṣu ca prakaṭaḥ antarbahiścaturvidhakhecaryādikagaṇasyāpi bhairava iti gurubhirimairanvarthaiḥ saṃstutaḥ śāstre krīḍā sarvotkarṣeṇavartanecchā tathā svatantratvam

nikhilāvabhāsanācca dyotanamasya stutiryataḥ sakalam bodhātmakaḥ samastakriyāmayo dṛkkriyāguṇaśca gatiḥ tena patiḥ śreyomaya eva śivo nāśivaṃ kimapi tatra tenāvacchedanude paramamahatpadaviśeṣaṇamupāttam mayā svasaṃvitsattarkapatiśāstratrikakramāt sṛṣṭau sthitau laye turye tenaitā dvādaśoditāḥ tenātropāsakāḥ sākṣāttatraiva pariniṣṭhitāḥ tatsvātantryabalādeva śāstreṣu paribhāṣitam pañcamūrtiḥ ṣaḍātmāyaṃ saptako@ṣṭakabhūṣitaḥ dvādaśāramahācakranāyako bhairavastviti

viśvacakre maheśāno viśvaśaktirvijṛmbhate aikyena cakrago bhedastatra tatra nirūpitaḥ ṣaṭcakreśvaratā nāthasyoktā citranijākṛteḥ saumyaraudrākṛtidhyānayogīnyanvarthakalpanāt saumyaṃ vānyanmitaṃ saṃvidūrmicakramupāsyate dhyānātsaṃjalpasaṃmiśrād vyāpārāccāpi bāhyataḥ puṣṭiḥ śuṣkasya sarasībhāvo jalamataḥ sitam ye ca svabhāvato varṇā rasaniḥṣyandino yathā taṃ bījabhāvamāgatya saṃvidaṃ sphuṭayanti tām saṃjalpo@pi vikalpātmā kiṃ tāmeva na pūrayet

tenāsya bījaṃ puṣṇīyāmityenāṃ pūrayetkriyām avacchedānavacchidbhyāṃ bhogamokṣārthibhirjanaiḥ ye bodhādvyatiriktaṃ hi kiṃcidyājyatayā viduḥ tenāvicchinnatāmarśarūpāhantāprathātmanaḥ vedyā hi devatāsṛṣṭiḥ śakterhetoḥ samutthitā vidhirniyogastryaṃśā ca bhāvanā codanātmikā ahaṃbodhastu na tathā te tu saṃvedyarūpatām taduktaṃ na vidurmāṃ tu tattvenātaścalanti te devāndevayajo yāntītyādi tena nyarūpyata viduste hyanavacchinnaṃ tadbhaktā api yānti mām

sa bhoktṛprabhuśabdābhyāṃ yājyayaṣṭṭatayoditaḥ na tvākṛtiḥ kuto@pyanyā devatā na hi socitā so@yamātmānamāvṛtya sthito jaḍapadaṃ gataḥ jaḍājaḍasyāpyetasya dvairūpyasyāsti citratā anāvaraṇabhāgāṃśe vaicitryaṃ bahudhā sthitam tathāpyāvṛtinirhāsatāratamyātsa lakṣyate samāpya paratāṃ sthaulyaprasaṃge carcayiṣyate pūrṇameva nijaṃ rūpaṃ kaṃcidaṃśāṃśikākramāt aṇūnāṃ tatparaṃ jñānaṃ tadanyadaparaṃ bahu prathamānaṃ vicitrābhirbhaṃgībhiriha bhidyate

vyavadhānāvyavadhinā bhūyānbhedaḥ pravartate jñānameva tu tatsūkṣmaṃ paraṃ tvicchātmakaṃ matam eṣaiva ca kriyāśaktirbandhamokṣaikakāraṇam yatsphuretprakaṭaṃ sākṣāttadicchākhyaṃ prakīrtitam bhāti bhāvaḥ sphuṭastadvatkeṣāmapi śivātmatā yatparāmarśamabhyeti jñānopāyaṃ tu tadviduḥ kriyopāyaṃ tadāmnātaṃ bhedo nātrāpavargagaḥ rūḍheryogāntatāṃ prāptamiti śrīgamaśāsane svacittavāsanāśāntau sā kriyetyabhidhīyate tāsāṃ śāntinimittaṃ yā matiḥ saṃvitsvabhāvikā

kriyā saiva ca yogaḥ syāttattvānāṃ cillayīkṛtau sā dehaṃ deśamakṣāṃścāpyāviśantī gatikriyā jñānameva vimokṣāya yuktaṃ caitadudāhṛtam svarūpaṃ cātmanaḥ saṃvinnānyattatra tu yāḥ punaḥ asaṃvidrūpatāyogāddharmiṇaścānirūpaṇāt śaktīnāṃ dharmarūpāṇāmāśrayaḥ ko@pi kathyate ekaḥ śiva itīyaṃ vāgvastuśūnyaiva jāyate vivicyamānaṃ bahvīṣu paryavasyati śaktiṣu nāvaśyaṃ kāraṇātkārya tajjñānyapi na mucyate na sā mukhyā tato nāyaṃ prasaṃga iti niścitam

yato vahati tenāsyāṃ citratā dṛśyatāṃ kila bhedopabhedavaividhyānniḥsaṃkhyatvamavāntarāt upāyabhedānmokṣe@pi bhedaḥ syāditi sūrayaḥ hetubhede@pi no bhinnā ghaṭadhvaṃsādivṛttivat ādeśi parameśitrā samāveśavinirṇaye utpadyate ya āveśaḥ śāmbhavo@sāvidīritaḥ yaṃ samāveśamāpnoti śāktaḥ so@trābhidhīyate yo bhavetsa samāveśaḥ samyagāṇava ucyate tayā ca jhaṭiti jñeyasamāpattirnirūpyate jñeyābhimukhabodhena drākprarūḍhatvaśālinā

āveśaścāsvatantrasya svatadrūpanimajjanāt tenāyamatra vākyārtho vijñeyaṃ pronmiṣatsvayam mātāramadharīkurvat svāṃ vibhūtiṃ pradarśayat jñeyaṃ dvidhā ca cinmātraṃ jaḍaṃ cādyaṃ ca kalpitam jaḍena yaḥ samāveśaḥ sapraticchandakākṛtiḥ tenāvikalpā saṃvittirbhāvanādyanapekṣiṇī tatprasādātpunaḥ paścādbhāvino@tra viniścayāḥ vikalpāpekṣayā mānamavikalpamiti bruvan gṛhītamiti suspaṣṭā niścayasya yataḥ prathā avikalpātmasaṃvittau yā sphurattaiva vastunaḥ

kevalaṃ saṃvidaḥ so@yaṃ nairmalyetaraviśramaḥ niśīthe@pi maṇijñānī vidyutkālapradarśitān nairmalyaṃ saṃvidaścedaṃ pūrvābhyāsavaśādatho pañcāśadvidhatā cāsya samāveśasya varṇitā etattattvāntare yatpuṃvidyāśaktyātmakaṃ trayam puṃvidyāśaktisaṃjñaṃ yattatsarvavyāpakaṃ yataḥ aśuddhiśuddhyamānatvaśuddhitastu mitho@pi tat tattvavargātpṛthagbhūtasamākhyānyata eva hi viduścatuṣṭaye cātra sāvakāśe tadāsthitim ko@vakāśo bhavettatra bhautāveśādivarṇane

nāsmākaṃ mānasāvarjī loko bhinnaruciryataḥ bhūtādīnāṃ yathā sātra na tathā dvayavarjite etāvatī mahādevī rudraśaktiranargalā dharāderviśvarūpatvaṃ pāñcadaśyādibhedataḥ niraṃśabhāvasaṃbodhastathaivātrāpi budhyatām anyairvā śaktirūpatvāddharmaiḥ svasamavāyibhiḥ upāsate vikalpaughasaṃskārādye śrutotthitāt dharmiṇaṃ pūrṇadharmaughamabhedenādhiśerate antarullikhitacitrasaṃvido no bhaveyuranubhūtayaḥ sphuṭāḥ atha patyuradhiṣṭhānamityādyuktaṃ viśeṣaṇaiḥ

kāṣṭhā saiva parā sūkṣmā sarvadikkāmṛtātmikā ādyantoparatā sādhvī mūrtitvenopacaryate tanmukhā sphuṭatā dharmiṇyāśu tanmayatāsthitiḥ ākāraiḥ paryupāsyante tanmayībhāvasiddhaye ākṣipeddhavatāsattvanyāyāddūrāntikatvataḥ bhairavatvaṃ viśvaśaktīrākṣipedvyāpakatvataḥ śaktīḥ samākṣipeyustadupāsāntikadūrataḥ iha tūkto yatastasmāt pratiyogyavikalpakam dharāsadāśivāntena tena tena śivībhavet prakāśe tanmukhenaiva saṃvitparaśivātmatā

śāmbhavākhyaṃ samāveśaṃ sumatyantenivāsinaḥ savikalpatayā māyāmayamicchādi vastutaḥ śāktaḥ sa māyopāyo@pi tadante nirvikalpakaḥ apūrṇā mātṛdaurātmyāttadapāye vikasvarā yasyāṃ sphuṭe paraṃ tvasyāṃ saṃkocaḥ pūrvanītitaḥ sā yatheṣṭāntarābhāsakāriṇī śaktirujjvalā anyopāyātra tūccārarahitatvaṃ nyarūpayat śaktyupāye na santyete bhedābhedau hi śaktitā vikalpaniścayātmaiva paryante nirvikalpakaḥ nādhovartitayā tena kathitaṃ kathamīdṛśam

svarūpagopanaṃ kṛtvā svaprakāśaḥ punastathā adhovyāptuḥ śivasyaiva sa prakāśo vyavasthitaḥ yena buddhi-manobhūmāvapi bhāti paraṃ padam prayāta eva tadrūḍhiṃ vinā naiva hi kiṃcana kalpanāyāśca mukhyatvamatraiva kila sūcitam tadvikalpakramopāttanirvikalpapramāṇatā anupāyāvikalpāptau ratnajña iti bhaṇyate bhedābhedātmakopāyaṃ bhedopāyaṃ tadāṇavam prasphuṭenaiva rūpeṇa bhāvī so@ntarbhaviṣyati upāyavaśataḥ prāptaṃ tatkriyeti puroditam

yato hi kalpanāmātraṃ svaparādivibhūtayaḥ guruḥ sa tāvadekātmā siddho muktaśca bhaṇyate samyagjñānamayaśceti svātmanā mucyate tataḥ yuktyāgamābhyāṃ saṃsiddhaṃ tāvāneko yato muniḥ dīkṣādikā kriyā ceyaṃ sā kathaṃ muktaye bhavet iti te mūlataḥ kṣiptā yattvatrānyaiḥ samarthitam tadvihantrī kriyā dīkṣā tvañjanādikakarmavat malamāyākarmaṇāṃ ca darśayiṣyāmahe sthitim mūlaṃ taduttaraṃ madhyamuttarottaramādimam ānandaśaktiviśrāntamanuttaramihocyate

api durlabhasadbhāvaṃ śrīsiddhātantra ucyate na caitadaprasannena śaṃkareṇeti vākyataḥ tanmayā tantryate tantrālokanāmnyatra śāsane anudghāṭitarūpaṃ tatpūrvameva prakāśate saṃśayaḥ kutracidrūpe niścite sati nānyathā saṃśayo@stitvanāstyādidharmānudghāṭitātmakaḥ kiṃ tvanunmudritākāraṃ vastvevābhidadhātyayam bhūyaḥsthadharmajāteṣu niścayotpāda eva hi saṃśayaḥ sa kimityaṃśe vikalpastvanyathā sphuṭaḥ prathamaṃ sa ihoddeśaḥ praśnaḥ saṃśaya eva ca

kiṃ vātibahunā dvāravāstvādhāragurukrame / lokapāstravidhau mantrān muktvā sarvaṃ viśodhakam yaccaitadadhvanaḥ proktaṃ śodhyatvaṃ śoddhṛtā ca yā / sā svātantryācchivābhede yuktetyuktaṃ ca śāsane sarvametadvibhātyeva parameśitari dhruve / pratibimbasvarūpeṇa na tu bāhyatayā yataḥ cidvyomnyeva śive tattaddehādimatirīdṛśī / bhinnā saṃsāriṇāṃ rajjau sarpasragvīcibuddhivat yataḥ prāgdehamaraṇasiddhāntaḥ svapnagocaraḥ / dehāntarādirmaraṇe kīdṛgvā dehasaṃbhavaḥ svapne@pi pratibhāmātrasāmānyaprathanābal
