abhinnācchivasaṃbodhajaladheryugapatsphurat / pūrṇāṃ kṣipaṃstattvajālaṃ dhyāyedbhārūpakaṃ sṛtam viśuddhatattvasṛṣṭiṃ vā kuryātkumbhābhiṣecanāt / tathā dhyānabalādeva yadvā pūrṇābhiṣecanaiḥ pṛthivī sthirarūpāsya śivarūpeṇa bhāvitā / sthirīkaroti tāmeva bhāvanāmiti śuddhyati jalamāpyāyayatyenāṃ tejo bhāsvaratāṃ nayet / marudānandasaṃsparśaṃ vyoma vaitatyamāvahet evaṃ tanmātravargo@pi śivatāmaya iṣyate / parānandamahāvyāptiraśeṣamalavicyutiḥ śive gantṛtvamādānamupādeyaśivastutiḥ / śivāmodabharāsvād

ityevaṃ śuddhatattvānāṃ sṛṣṭyā śiṣyo@pi tanmayaḥ / bhaveddhyetatsūcitaṃ śrīmālinīvijayottare bandhamokṣāvubhāvetāvindriyāṇi jagurbudhāḥ / nigṛhītāni bandhāya vimuktāni vimuktaye etāni vyāpake bhāve yadā syurmanasā saha / muktāni kvāpi viṣaye rodhādbandhāya tāni tu ityevaṃ dvividho bhāvaḥ śuddhāśuddhaprabhedataḥ / indriyāṇāṃ samākhyātaḥ siddhayogīśvare mate śrīmān vidyāgurustvāha pramāṇastutidarśane / samastamantrairdīkṣāyāṃ niyamastveṣa kathyate māyāntaśuddhau sarvāḥ syuḥ kriyā hyaparayā sadā /
vilomakarmaṇā sākaṃ yāḥ pūrṇāhutayaḥ smṛtāḥ / tāsāṃ sarvādhvasaṃśuddhau saṃkhyānyatvaṃ na kiṃcana ityeṣā kathitā dīkṣā jananādisamanvitā

atha saṃkṣiptadīkṣeyaṃ śivatāpattidocyate / na rajo nādhivāso@tra na bhūkṣetraparigrahaḥ / yatra tatra pradeśe tu pūjayitvā guruḥ śivam adhvānaṃ manasā dhyātvā dīkṣayettattvapāragaḥ / jananādivihīnāṃ tu yena yenādhvanā guruḥ kuryātsa ekatattvāntāṃ śivabhāvaikabhāvitaḥ / parāmantrastato@syeti tattvaṃ saṃśodhayāmyatha svāheti pratitattvaṃ syācchuddhe pūrṇāhutiṃ kṣipet / evaṃ mantrāntaraiḥ kuryātsamastairathavoktavat parāsaṃpuṭitaṃ nāma svāhāntaṃ prathamāntakam / śataṃ sahasraṃ sāṣṭaṃ vā tena śakty

pratyekaṃ mātṛkāyugmavarṇaistattvāni śodhayet / yadi vā piṇḍamantreṇa sarvamantreṣvayaṃ vidhiḥ yathā yathā ca svabhyastajñānastanmayatātmakaḥ / gurustathā tathā kuryāt saṃkṣiptaṃ karma nānyathā śrībrahmayāmale coktaṃ saṃkṣipte@pi hi bhāvayet / vyāptiṃ sarvādhvasāmānyāṃ kiṃtu yāge na vistaraḥ atanmayībhūtamiti vikṣiptaṃ karma sandadhat / kramāttādātmyametīti vikṣiptaṃ vidhimācaret saṃkṣipto vidhirukto@yaṃ kṛpayā yaḥ śivoditaḥ / dīkṣottare kairaṇe ca tatra tatrāpi śāsane

atha sadyaḥsamutkrāntipradā dīkṣā nirūpyate / tatkṣaṇāccopabhogādvā dehapāte śivaṃ vrajet / ityuktyā mālinīśāstre sūcitāsau maheśinā dehapāte samīpasthe śaktipātasphuṭatvataḥ / āsādya śāṃkarīṃ dīkṣāṃ tasmāddīkṣākṣaṇātparam śivaṃ vrajedityartho@tra pūrvāparavivecanāt / vyākhyātaḥ śrīmatāsmākaṃ guruṇā śambhumūrtinā yadā hyāsannamaraṇe śaktipātaḥ prajāyate / tatra mande@tha gurvādisevayāyuḥ kṣayaṃ vrajet athavā bandhumitrādidvārā sāsya vibhoḥ patet / pūrvaṃ vā samayī naiva parāṃ dīkṣāmavāptavān āpt

kṛtvā pūrvoditaṃ nyāsaṃ kālānalasamaprabham / saṃhṛtikramataḥ sārdhaṃ sṛkchindiyugalena tu āgneyīṃ dhāraṇāṃ kṛtvā sarvamarmapratāpanīm / pūrayedvāyunā dehamaṅguṣṭhānmastakāntakam tamutkṛṣya tato@ṅguṣṭhādūrdhvāntaṃ vakṣyamāṇayā / kṛntenmarmāṇi randhrāntāt kālarātryā visarjayet anena kramayogena yojito hutivarjitaḥ / samayyapyeti tāṃ dīkṣāmiti śrīmālinīmate ṣoḍaśādhāraṣaṭcakralakṣyatrayakhapañcakāt / kvacidanyataratrātha prāguktapaśukarmavat praviśya mūlaṃ kandādeśchindannaikyavibhāvanāt / pūrṇāhu

śrīmaddīkṣottare tveṣa vidhirvahnipuṭīkṛtaḥ / haṃsaḥ pumānadhastasya rudrabindusamanvitaḥ śiṣyadehe niyojyaitadanudvagnaḥ śataṃ japet / utkramyordhvanimeṣeṇa śiṣya itthaṃ paraṃ vrajet eṣa eva vidhiḥ śrīmatsiddhayogīśvarīmate / iyamutkrāmaṇī dīkṣā kartavyā yogino guroḥ anabhyastaprāṇacāraḥ kathamenāṃ kariṣyati / vakṣyamāṇāṃ brahmavidyāṃ sakalāṃ niṣkalombhitām karṇe@sya vā paṭhedbhūyo bhūyo vāpyatha pāṭhayet / svayaṃ ca karma kurvīta tattvaśuddhyādikaṃ guruḥ mantrakriyābalātpūrṇāhutyetthaṃ yojayet

tattve vā yatra kutrāpi yojayetpudgalaṃ kramāt / samayī putrako vāpi paṭhedvidyāmimāṃ tathā tatpāṭhāttu samayyuktāṃ rudrāṃśāpattimaśnute / etau jape cādhyayane yasmādadhikṛtāvubhau nādhyāpanopadeśe vā sa eṣo@dhyayanādṛte / paṭhatostvanayorvastusvabhāvāttasya sā gatiḥ yathā niṣiddhabhūtādikarmā mantraṃ smaransvayam / āviṣṭe@pi kvacinnaiti lopaṃ kartṛtvavarjanāt yathā ca vācayañśāstraṃ samayī śūnyaveśmani / na lupyate tadantaḥsthaprāṇivargopakārataḥ tathā svayaṃ paṭhanneṣa vidyāṃ vastusvabhāvataḥ

akṣānapekṣayaivāntaścicchaktyā svaprakāśayā / prāgdehaṃ kila tityakṣurnottaraṃ cādhitaṣṭhivān madhye prabodhakabalāt pratibudhyet pudgalaḥ / mantrāḥ śabdamayāḥ śuddhavimarśātmatayā svayam arthātmanā cāvabhāntastadarthapratibodhakāḥ / tenāsya galitākṣasya prabodho jāyate svayam svacitsamānajātīyamantrāmarśanasaṃnidheḥ / yathā hyalpajavo vāyuḥ sajātīyavimiśritaḥ javī tathātmā saṃsuptāmarśo@pyevaṃ prabudhyate / prabuddhaḥ sa ca saṃjāto na cādīkṣita ucyate dīkṣā hi nāma saṃskāro na tvanyatso@sti cās

makṣikāśrutamantro@pi prāyaścittaucitīṃ caret / itthaṃ sadyaḥsamutkrāntiryoktā tāmājñayā guroḥ samayyādirapi proktakāle proktārthasiddhaye / svayaṃ kuryātsamabhyastaprāṇacāragamāgamaḥ akṛtādhikṛtirvāpi guruḥ samayaśuddhaye / adhastanapadāvastho natu jñāneddhacetanaḥ itīyaṃ sadya+utkrāntiḥ sūcitā mālinīmate / svayaṃ vā guruṇā vātha kāryatvena maheśinā sarvaṃ bhogaṃ virūpaṃ tu matvā dehaṃ tyajedyadi / tadā tena krameṇāśu yojitaḥ samayī śivaḥ ukteyaṃ sadya+utkrāntiryā gopyā prāṇavadbudhaiḥ
atha dīkṣāṃ bruve mūḍhajanāśvāsapradāyinīm
trikoṇe vahnisadane vahnivarṇojjvale@bhitaḥ / vāyavyapuranirdhūte kare savye sujājvale
bījaṃ kiṃcidgṛhītvaitattathaiva hṛdayāntare / kare ca dahyamānaṃ saccintayettajjapaikayuk
vahnidīpitaphaṭkāradhoraṇīdāhapīḍitam / bījaṃ nirbījatāmeti svasūtikaraṇākṣamam
taptaṃ naitatprarohāya tenaiva pratyayena tu / malamāyākhyakarmāṇi mantradhyānakriyābalāt
dagdhāni na svakāryāya nirbījapratyayaṃ tvimam / sa śrīmānsuprasanno me śaṃbhunātho nyarūpayat
bījasyāpyatra kāryā ca yojanā kṛpayā guroḥ / yato dīkṣā sudīptatvātsthāvarāṇyapi mocayet
yo gururjapahomārcādhyānasiddhatvamātmani / jñātvā dīkṣāṃ carettasya dīkṣā sapratyayā smṛtā
avadhūte nirācāre tattvajñe natvayaṃ vidhiḥ / sācāraiḥ kriyate dīkṣā yā dṛṣṭapratyayānvitā
nirācāreṇa dīkṣāyāṃ pratyayastu na gadyate / jñānaṃ svapratyayaṃ yasmānna phalāntaramarhati
dhyānādi tu phalātsādhyamiti siddhāmatoditam / tulāśuddhiparīkṣāṃ vā kuryātpratyayayoginīm
yathā śrītantrasadbhāve kathitā parameśinā / śrīpūrvaśāstre@pyeṣā ca sūcitā parameśinā
ānanda udbhavaḥ kampo nidrā ghūrṇiśca pañcamī / ityevaṃvadatā śaktitāratamyābhidhāyinā
udbhavo laghubhāvena dehagrahatirohiteḥ / deho hi pārthivo mukhyastadā mukhyatvamujjhati
bhāvilāghavamantreṇa śiṣyaṃ dhyātvā samutplutam / karmāṇi tatrāśeṣāṇi pūrvoktānyācaredguruḥ
uktā seyaṃ tulāśuddhidīkṣā pratyayadāyinī /

parokṣasaṃsthitasyātha dīkṣākarma nigadyate bhuktimuktiprasiddhyarthaṃ nīyate sadguruṃ prati / ityasminmālinīvākye pratiḥ sāṃmukhyāvācakaḥ sāṃmukhyaṃ cāsya śiṣyasya tatkṛpāspadatātmakam / tamārādhyeti vacanaṃ kṛpāhetūpalakṣaṇam tatsaṃbandhāttataḥ kaścittatkṣaṇādapavṛjyate / ityasyāyamapi hyartho mālinīvākyasanmaṇeḥ tatkṣaṇāditi nāsyāsti yiyāsādikṣaṇāntaram / kiṃtvevameva karuṇānighnastaṃ gururuddharet gurusevākṣīṇatanordīkṣāmaprāpya pañcatām / gatasyātha svayaṃ mṛtyukṣaṇoditatathāruceḥ athavādha

gururdīkṣāṃ mṛtoddhārīṃ kurvīta śivadāyinīm / śrīmṛtyuñjayasiddhādau taduktaṃ parameśinā adīkṣite nṛpatyādāvalase patite mṛte / bālāturastrīvṛddhe ca mṛtoddhāraṃ prakalpayet vidhiḥ sarvaḥ pūrvamuktaḥ sa tu saṃkṣipta iṣyate / gurvādipūjārahito bāhye bhogāya sā yataḥ adhivāsacarukṣetraṃ śayyāmaṇḍalakalpane / nopayogyatra tacchiṣyasaṃskriyāsvapnadṛṣṭaye mantrasaṃnidhisaṃtṛptiyogāyātra tu maṇḍalam / bhūyodine ca devārcā sākṣānnāsyopakāri tat kriyopakaraṇasthānamaṇḍalākṛtimantrataḥ / dhyānayogaikatad

yena saṃdṛṣṭamātreti siddhamātrapadadvayāt / ākṛtirdīptarūpā yā mantrastadvatsudīptikaḥ śiṣṭaṃ spaṣṭamato neha kathitaṃ vistarātpunaḥ / kṛtvā maṇḍalamabhyarcya tatra devaṃ kuśairatha gomayenākṛtiṃ kuryācchiṣyavattāṃ nidhāpayet / tatastasyāṃ śodhyamekamadhvānaṃ vyāptibhāvanāt prakṛtyantaṃ vinikṣipya punarenaṃ vidhiṃ caret / mahājālaprayogeṇa sarvasmādadhvamadhyataḥ cittamākṛṣya tatrasthaṃ kuryāttadvidhirucyate / mūlādhārādudetya prasṛtasuvitatānantanāḍyadhvadaṇḍaṃ vīryeṇākramya nāsāgaganaparigata

adhikāriśarīratvānmānuṣye tu śarīragaḥ / na tadā mucyate dehāddehānte tu śivaṃ vrajet tasmindehe tu kāpyasya jāyate śāṅkarī parā / bhaktirūhācca vijñānādācāryādvāpyasevitāt taddehasaṃsthito@pyeṣa jīvo jālabalādimam / dārbhādidehaṃ vyāpnoti svādhiṣṭhityāpyacetayan yogamantrakriyājñānabhūyobalavaśātpunaḥ / manuṣyadehamapyeṣa tadaivāśu vimuñcati suptakalpo@pyadeho@pi yo jīvaḥ so@pi jālataḥ / ākṛṣṭo dārbhamāyāti dehaṃ phalamayaṃ ca vā jātīphalādi yatkiṃcittena vā dehakalpanā / antarbahirdvayaucityāt

sapratyayā tviyaṃ yatra spandate darbhajā tanuḥ / tatra prāṇamanomantrārpaṇayogāttathā bhavet sābhyāsasya tadapyuktaṃ balāśvāsi na tatkṛte / mṛtoddhāroditaireva yathāsaṃbhūti hetubhiḥ jīvatparokṣadīkṣāpi kāryā nirbījikā tu sā / tasyāṃ darbhākṛtiprāyakalpane jālayogataḥ saṃkalpamātreṇākarṣo jīvasya mṛtibhītitaḥ / śiṣṭaṃ prāgvatkuśādyutthākāraviploṣavarjitam pārimityādanaiśvaryātsādhye niyatiyantraṇāt / jālākṛṣṭirvinābhyāsaṃ rāgadveṣānna jāyate parokṣa evātulyābhirdīkṣābhiryadi dīkṣitaḥ / tatrotta

agniściṭiciṭāśabdaṃ sadhūmaṃ pratimuñcati / dhatte nīlāmbudacchāyāṃ muhurjvalati śāmyati vistaro ghorarūpaśca mahīṃ dhāvati cāpyadhaḥ / dhvāṃkṣādyaśravyaśabdo vā tadā taṃ lakṣayedguruḥ brahmahatyādibhiḥ pāpaistatsaṅgaiścopapātakaiḥ / tadā tasya na kartavyā dīkṣāsminnakṛte vidhau navātmā phaṭpuṭāntaḥsthaḥ punaḥ pañcaphaḍanvitaḥ / amukasyeti pāpāni dahāmyanu phaḍaṣṭakam iti sāhasriko homaḥ kartavyastilataṇḍulaiḥ / ante pūrṇā ca dātavyā tato@smai dīkṣayā guruḥ parayojanaparyantaṃ kuryāttattvaviśodh
nirayaṃ varjayettasmāditi dīkṣottare vidhiḥ / eṣā parokṣadīkṣā dvidhoditā jīvaditarabhedena

athābhiṣekasya vidhiḥ kathyate pārameśvaraḥ yaiṣā putrakadīkṣoktā gurusādhakayorapi / saivādhikāriṇī bhogyatattvayuktimatī kramāt svabhyastajñāninaṃ santaṃ bubhūṣumatha bhāvinam / yogyaṃ jñātvā svādhikāraṃ gurustasmai samarpayet yo naivaṃ veda naivāsāvabhiṣikto@pi daiśikaḥ / samayyādikrameṇeti śrīmatkāmika ucyate yo na vedādhvasandhānaṃ ṣoḍhā bāhyāntarasthitam / sa gururmocayenneti siddhayogīśvarīmate sarvalakṣaṇahīno@pi jñānavān gururiṣyate / jñānaprādhānyamevoktamiti śrīkacabhārgave padavākyap

śrīpūrvaśāstre na tveṣa niyamaḥ ko@pi coditaḥ / yathārthatattvasaṃghajñastathā śiṣye prakāśakaḥ yaḥ punaḥ sarvatattvāni vettītyādi ca lakṣaṇam / yogacāre ca yadyatra tantre coditamācaret tathaiva siddhaye seyamājñeti kila varṇitam / yastu karmitayācāryastatra kāṇādivarjanam yataḥ kārakasāmagryātkarmaṇo nādhikaḥ kvacit / devyā yāmalaśāstre ca kāñcyādiparivarjanam taddṛṣṭadoṣātkrodhādeḥ samyakjñātaryasau kutaḥ / guravastu svayaṃbhvādi varjyaṃ yadyāmalādiṣu karmyabhiprāyataḥ sarvaṃ taditi vyācacakṣ

napuṃsakāḥ striyaḥ śūdrā ye cānye@pi tadarthinaḥ / te dīkṣāyāṃ na mīmāṃsyā jñānakāle vicārayet jñānamūlo guruḥ proktaḥ saptasatrīṃ pravartayet / dīkṣā vyākhyā kṛpā maitrī śāstracintā śivaikatā annādidānamityetatpālayetsaptasatrakam / abhiṣekavidhau cāsmai karaṇīkhaṭikādikam sarvopakaraṇavrātamarpaṇīyaṃ vipaścite / so@bhiṣikto guruṃ paścāddakṣiṇābhiḥ prapūjayet jñānahīno guruḥ karmī svādhikāraṃ samarpya no / dīkṣādyadhikṛtiṃ kuryādvinā tasyājñayā punaḥ ityevaṃ śrāvayetso@pi namaskṛtyābhinandayet

prāptābhiṣekaḥ sa guruḥ ṣaṇmāsānmantrapaddhatim / sarvāṃ tantroditāṃ dhyāyejjapeccātanmayatvataḥ yadaiva tanmayībhūtastadā vīryamupāgataḥ / chindyātpāśāṃstato yatnaṃ kuryāttanmayatāsthitau hṛccakrādutthitā sūkṣmā śaśisphaṭikasaṃnibhā / lekhākārā nādarūpā praśāntā cakrapaṅktigā dvādaśānte nirūḍhā sā sauṣumne tripathāntare / tatra hṛccakramāpūrya japenmantraṃ jvalatprabham cakṣurlomādirandhraughavahajjvālaurvasaṃnibham / yāvacchāntaśikhākīrṇaṃ viśvājyapravilāpakam tadājyadhārāsaṃtṛptamānābhikuharā

pravartante@dhikārāya karaṇānīva dehinām / kṛtavidyāvrataḥ paścāddīkṣāvyākhyādi sarvataḥ kuryādyogyeṣu śiṣyeṣu nāyogyeṣu kadācana / rahasye yojayedvipraṃ parīkṣya viparītataḥ ācārācchaktimapyeva nānyathetyūrmiśāsane / nityādyalpālpakaṃ kuryādyaduktaṃ brahmayāmale cīrṇavidyāvrataḥ sarvaṃ manasā vā smaretpriye / dehasaṃbandhasaṃchannasārvajñyo dambhabhājanam avidandīkṣamāṇo@pi na duṣyeddaiśikaḥ kvacit / jñātvā tvayogyatāṃ nainaṃ dīkṣeta pratyavāyitām buddhvā jñāne śāstrasiddhigurutvādau ca taṃ pun

lokaṃ viplāvayennāsmiñjñāte vijñānamarpayet / ajñāte@pi punarjñāte vijñānaharaṇaṃ caret punaḥpunaryadā jñāto viśvāsaparivarjitaḥ / tadā tamagrato dhyāyetsphurantaṃ candrasūryavat tato nijahṛdambhojabodhāmbarataloditām / svarbhānumalināṃ dhyāyedvāmāṃ śaktiṃ vimohanīm vāmācārakrameṇaināṃ niḥsṛtāṃ sādhyagāminīm / cintayitvā tayā grastaprakāśaṃ taṃ vicintayet anena kramayogena mūḍhabuddherdurātmanaḥ / vijñānamantravidyādyāḥ prakurvantyapakāritām nanu vijñānamātmasthaṃ kathaṃ hartuṃ kṣamaṃ bhavet / a

śivābhedena tatkuryāttadvatpañcamamapyayam / tirobhāvābhidhaṃ kṛtyaṃ tathāsau śivatātmakaḥ ata eva śive śāstre jñāne cāśvāsabhājanam / gurormūḍhatayā kopadhāmāpi na tirohitaḥ gururhi kupito yasya sa tirohita ucyate / saṃsārī satu devo hi gururna ca mṛṣāvidaḥ tata eva ca śāstrādidūṣako yadyapi krudhā / na dahyate@sau guruṇā tathāpyeṣa tirohitaḥ asmadgurvāgamastveṣa tirobhūte svayaṃ śiśau / na kupyenna śapeddhīmān sa hyanugrāhakaḥ sadā īśecchācoditaḥ pāśaṃ yadi kaṇṭhe nipīḍayet / kimācāryeṇa tatrā

adhodṛṣṭau prapannastu tadanāśvastamānasaḥ / ūrdhvaśāsanabhāk pāpaṃ taccojjhecca śivībhavet rājñe druhyannamātyāṅgabhūto@pi hi vihanyate / viparyayastu netyevamūrdhvāṃ dṛṣṭiṃ samāśrayet śrīpūrvaśāstre tenoktaṃ yāvattenaiva noddhṛtaḥ / atra hyartho@yametāvatpūrvoktajñānavṛṃhitaḥ gurustāvatsa evātra tacchabdenāvamṛśyate / tādṛksvabhyastavijñānabhājordhvapadaśālinā anuddhṛtasya na śreya etadanyagurūddhṛteḥ / ata evāmbujanmārkadṛṣṭānto@tra nirūpitaḥ trijagajjyotiṣo hyanyattejo@nyacca niśākṛtaḥ / jñā

na dhvastavyādhikaḥ ko hi bhiṣajaṃ bahu manyate / asūyurnūnamadhvastavyādhiḥ svasthāyate balāt evaṃ jñānasamāśvastaḥ kiṃ kiṃ na gurave caret / no cennūnamaviśvasto viśvasta iva tiṣṭhati ajñānādaya evaite doṣā na laukikā guroḥ / iti khyāpayituṃ proktaṃ mālinīvijayottare na tasyānveṣayedvṛttaṃ śubhaṃ vā yadi vāśubham / sa eva tadvijānāti yuktaṃ cāyuktameva vā akāryeṣu yadā saktaḥ prāṇadravyāpahāriṣu / tadā nivāraṇīyo@sau praṇatena vipaścitā viśeṣaṇamakāryāṇāmuktābhiprāyameva yat / tenātivāryamāṇo@

upadeśastvayaṃ mandamadhyaśakternijāṃ kramāt / śaktiṃ jvalayituṃ proktaḥ sā hyevaṃ jājvalītyalam dṛḍhānurāgasubhagasaṃrambhābhogabhāginaḥ / svollāsi smarasarvasyaṃ dārḍhyāyānyatra dṛśyate nanveṣa kasmāddṛṣṭāntaḥ kimetenāśubhaṃ kṛtam / citspandaḥ sarvago bhinnādupādheḥ sa tathā tathā bhavetko@pi tirobhūtaḥ punarunmukhito@pi san / vināpi daiśikātprāgvatsvayameva vimucyate prakārastveṣa nātroktaḥ śaktipātabalādgataḥ / asaṃbhāvyatayā cātra dṛḍhakopaprasādavat ityeṣa yo guroḥ prokto vidhistaṃ pālayed

jñānināṃ caiṣa no bandha iti sarvatra varṇitam / sādhakasyābhiṣeke@pi sarvo@yaṃ kathyate vidhiḥ adhikārārpaṇaṃ nātra naca vidyāvrataṃ kila / sādhyamantrārpaṇaṃ tvatra svopayogikriyākrame samaste@pyupadeśaḥ syānnijopakaraṇārpaṇam / abhiṣekavidhirnirūpitaḥ parameśena yathā nirūpitaḥ

atha śāmbhavaśāsanoditāṃ sarahasyāṃ śṛṇutāntyasaṃskriyām // 1b sarveṣāmadharasthānāṃ gurvantānāmapi sphuṭam / śaktipātātpurāproktātkuryādantyeṣṭidīkṣaṇam ūrdhvaśāsanagānāṃ ca samayopahatātmanām / antyeṣṭidīkṣā kartavyā guruṇā tattvavedinā samayācāradoṣeṣu pramādātskhalitasya hi / antyeṣṭidīkṣā kāryeti śrīdīkṣottaraśāsane yatkiṃcitkathitaṃ pūrvaṃ mṛtoddhārābhidhe vidhau / pratimāyāṃ tadevātra sarvaṃ śavatanau caret śrīsiddhātantrakathito vidhireṣa nirūpyate / antimaṃ yadbhavetpūrvaṃ tatkṛtvāntima

antyeṣṭirnaiva vidyeta śuddhacetasyamūrdhani / mantrayogādibhirye ca māritā narake tu te kāryā teṣāmihāntyeṣṭirguruṇātikṛpālunā / na maṇḍalādikaṃ tvatra bhavecchamāśānike vidhau kecittadapi kartavyamūcire pretasadmani / pūjayitvā vibhuṃ sarvaṃ nyāsaṃ pūrvavadācaret saṃhārakramayogena caraṇānmūrdhapaścimam / tathaiva bodhayedenaṃ kriyājñānasamādhibhiḥ bindunā rodhayettattvaṃ śaktibījena vedhayet / ghaṭṭayennādadeśe tu triśūlena tu tāḍayet suṣumnāntargatenaiva visargeṇa punaḥ punaḥ / tāḍayeta kalā

sādhyo@numeyo mokṣādiḥ pratyayairyadatīndriyaḥ / dīkṣottare ca puryaṣṭavargārpaṇamihoditam tadvidhiḥ śrutipatre@bje madhye devaṃ sadāśivam / īśarudraharibrahmacatuṣkaṃ prāgdigāditaḥ pūjayitvā śrutisparśau rasaṃ gandhaṃ vapurdvayam / dhyahaṃkṛtī manaśceti brahmādiṣvarpayetkramāt eteṣāṃ tarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā śatahomena daiśikaḥ / eṣā sāṃnyāsikī dīkṣā puryaṣṭakaviśodhanī puryaṣṭakasyābhāve ca na svarganarakādayaḥ / tathā kṛtvā na kartavyaṃ laukikaṃ kiṃcanāpi hi uktaṃ śrīmādhavakule śāsanastho mṛteṣvapi /

atha śrāddhavidhiḥ śrīmatṣaḍardhokto nigadyate // 1b siddhātantre sūcito@sau mūrtiyāganirūpaṇe / antyeṣṭyā suviśuddhānāmaśuddhānāṃ ca tadvidhiḥ tryahe turye@hni daśame māsi māsyādyavatsare / varṣe varṣe sarvakālaṃ kāryastatsvaiḥ sa pūrvavat tatra prāgvadyajeddevaṃ homayedanale tathā / tato naivedyameva prāggṛhītvā hastagocare gururannamayīṃ śaktiṃ vṛṃhikāṃ vīryarūpiṇīm / dhyātvā tayā samāviṣṭaṃ taṃ sādhyaṃ cintayetsudhīḥ tato@sya yaḥ pāśavoṃ@śo bhogyarūpastamarpayet / bhoktaryekātmabhāvena śiṣya

tattvajñānārkavidhvastadhvāntasya tu na ko@pyayam / antyeṣṭiśrāddhavidhyādirupayogī kadācana teṣāṃ tu guru tadvargavargyasabrahmacāriṇām / tatsantānajuṣāmaikyadinaṃ parvadinaṃ bhavet yadāhi bodhasyodrekastadā parvāha pūraṇāt / janmaikyadivasau tena parvaṇī bodhasiddhitaḥ putrako@pi yadā kasmaicana syādupakārakaḥ / tadā mātuḥ pituḥ śaktervāmadakṣāntarālagāḥ nāḍīḥ pravāhayeddevāyārpayeta niveditam / śrīmadbharuṇatantre ca tacchivena nirūpitam tadvāhakālāpekṣā ca kāryā tadrūpasiddhaye / svācchandye

atha vacmaḥ sphuṭaṃ śrīmatsiddhaye nāḍicāraṇam / yā vāhayitumiṣyeta nāḍī tāmeva bhāvayet bhāvanātanmayībhāve sā nāḍī vahati sphuṭam / yadvā vāhayituṃ yeṣṭā tadaṅgaṃ tena pāṇinā āpīḍya kukṣiṃ namayetsā vahennāḍikā kṣaṇāt / evaṃ śrāddhamukhenāpi bhogamokṣobhayasthitim kuryāditi śivenoktaṃ tatra tatra kṛpālunā / śaktipātodaye jantoryenopāyena daiśikaḥ karotyuddharaṇaṃ tattannirvāṇāyāsya kalpate / uddhartā devadevo hi sa cācintyaprabhāvakaḥ upāyaṃ gurudīkṣādidvāramātreṇa saṃśrayet / uktaṃ śrīmanmata
muktyarthamupacaryante bāhyaliṅgānyamūni tu / iti jñātvā na sandeha itthaṃ kāryo vipaścitā iyataiva kathaṃ muktiriti bhaktiṃ parāṃ śrayet / uktaḥ śrāddhavidhirbhrāntigarātaṅkavimardanaḥ

athocyate śeṣavṛttirjīvatāmupayoginī // 1b dīkṣā bahuprakāreyaṃ śrāddhāntā yā prakīrtitā / sā saṃskriyāyai mokṣāya bhogāyāpi dvayāya vā tatra saṃskārasiddhyai yā dīkṣā sākṣānna mocanī / anusaṃdhivaśādyā ca sākṣānmoktrī sabījikā tayobhayyā dīkṣitā ye teṣāmājīvavartanam / vaktavyaṃ putrakādīnāṃ tanmayatvaprasiddhaye bubhukṣorvā mumukṣorvā svasaṃvidguruśāstrataḥ / pramāṇādyā saṃskriyāyai dīkṣā hi guruṇā kṛtā tataḥ sa saṃskṛtaṃ yogyaṃ jñātvātmānaṃ svaśāsane / taduktavastvanuṣṭhānaṃ bhuktyai muktyai

tatraiṣāṃ śeṣavṛttyarthaṃ nityanaimittike dhruve / kāmyavarjaṃ yataḥ kāmāścitrāścitrābhyupāyakāḥ tatra nityo vidhiḥ sandhyānuṣṭhānaṃ devatāvraje / gurvagniśāstrasahite pūjā bhūtadayetyayam naimittikastu sarveṣāṃ parvaṇāṃ pūjanaṃ japaḥ / viśeṣavaśataḥ kiṃca pavitrakavidhikramaḥ ācāryasya ca dīkṣeyaṃ bahubhedā vivecitā / vyākhyādikaṃ ca tattasyādhikaṃ naimittikaṃ dhruvam tatrādau śiśave vrūyādgururnityavidhiṃ sphuṭam / tadyogyatāṃ samālokya vitatāvitatātmanām mukhyetarādimantrāṇāṃ vīryavyāptyādiyo

mantrā varṇātmakāste ca parāmarśātmakāḥ saca / gurusaṃvidabhinnaśvetsaṃkrāmetsā tataḥ śiśau lipisthitastu yo mantro nirvīryaḥ so@tra kalpitaḥ / saṃketabalato nāsya pustakātprathate mahaḥ pustakādhītavidyāścetyuktaṃ siddhāmate tataḥ / ye tu pustakalabdhe@pi mantre vīryaṃ prajānate te bhairavīyasaṃskārāḥ proktāḥ sāṃsiddhikā iti / iti jñātvā guruḥ samyak paramānandaghūrṇitaḥ tādṛśe tādṛśe dhāmni pūjayitvā vidhiṃ caret / yathānyaśiṣyānuṣṭhānaṃ nānyaśiṣyeṇa budhyate tathā kuryādgururguptihānirdoṣavat

śuddhiṃ vidhāya mantrāṇāṃ yathāsthānaṃ niveśanam / mudrāpradarśanaṃ dhyānaṃ bhedābhedasvarūpataḥ dehāsudhīvyomabhūṣu manasā tatra cārcanam / japaṃ cātra yathāśakti devāyaitannivedanam tanmayībhāvasiddhyarthaṃ pratisandhyaṃ samācaret / anye tu prāgudakpaścāddaśadikṣu catuṣṭayīm sandhyānāmāhuretacca tāntrikīyaṃ na no matam / yāsau kālādhikāre prāk sandhyā proktā catuṣṭayī tāmevāntaḥ samādhāya sāndhyaṃ vidhimupācaret / sandhyācatuṣṭayīkṛtyamekasyāmathavā śiśuḥ kuryātsvādhyāyavijñānagurukṛtyāditatpa

tatastatsthaṇḍilaṃ vīdhravyomasphaṭikanirmalam / bodhātmakaṃ samālokya tatra svaṃ devatāgaṇam pratibimbatayā paśyedbimbatvena ca bodhataḥ / etadāvāhanaṃ mukhyaṃ vyajanānmarutāmiva sarvago@pi marudyadvadvyajanenopajīvitaḥ / arthakṛtsarvagaṃ mantracakraṃ rūḍhestathā bhavet catuṣkapañcāśikayā tadetattattvamucyate / śrīnirmaryādaśāstre ca tadetadvibhunoditam devaḥ sarvagato deva nirmaryādaḥ kathaṃ śivaḥ / āvāhyate kṣamyate vetyevaṃpṛṣṭo@bravīdvibhuḥ vāsanāvāhyate devi vāsanā ca visṛjyate / paramārth

sthūlasūkṣmādibhedena sa hi sarvatra saṃsthitaḥ / āvāhite mantragaṇe puṣpāsavanivedanaiḥ dhūpaiśca tarpaṇaṃ kāryaṃ śraddhābhaktibalocitaiḥ / dīptānāṃ śaktinādādimantrāṇāmāsavaiḥ palaiḥ raktaiḥ prāk tarpaṇa paścāt puṣpadhūpādivistaraiḥ / āgatasya tu mantrasya na kuryāttarpaṇaṃ yadi haratyardhaśarīraṃ sa ityuktaṃ kila śambhunā / yadyadevāsya manasi vikāsitvaṃ prayacchati tenaiva kuryātpūjāṃ sa iti śambhorviniścayaḥ / sādhakānāṃ bubhukṣūṇāṃ vidhirniyatiyantritaḥ mumukṣūṇāṃ tattvavidāṃ sa eva tu nir

kriyā syāttanmayībhūtyai hṛdayāhlādadāyibhiḥ / śivābhedabharādbhāvavargaḥ ścyotati yaṃ rasam tameva parame dhāmni pūjanāyārpayedbudhaḥ / stotreṣu bahudhā caitanmayā proktaṃ nijāhnike adhiśayya pāramārthikabhāvaprasaraprakāśamullasati / yā paramāmṛtadṛk tvāṃ tayārcayante rahasyavidaḥ kṛtvādhāradharāṃ camatkṛtirasaprokṣākṣaṇakṣālitāmāttairmānasataḥ svabhāvakusumaiḥ svāmodasandohibhiḥ / ānandāmṛtanirbharasvahṛdayānarghārghapātrakramāt tvāṃ devyā saha dehadevasadane devārcaye@harniśam nānāsvādarasām

prāṇino jalajāḥ pūrvadīkṣitāḥ śambhunā svayam / vidhinā bhāvinā śrīmanmīnanāthāvatāriṇā mārjāramūṣikādyairyadadīkṣaiścāpi bhakṣitam / tacchaṅkātaṅkadānena vyādhaye narakāya ca atastattvavidā dhvastaśaṅkātaṅko@pi paṇḍitaḥ / prakaṭaṃ nedṛśaṃ kuryāllokānugrahavāñchayā śrīmanmatamahāśāstre taduktaṃ vibhunā svayam / svayaṃ tu śaṅkāsaṅkocaniṣkāsanaparāyaṇaḥ bhavettathā yathānyeṣāṃ śaṅkā no manasi sphuret / mārjayitvā tataḥ snānaṃ puṣpeṇātha prapūjayet puṣpādi sarvaṃ tatsthaṃ tadagādhāmbhasi nikṣipet /

athocyate liṅgapūjā sūcitā mālinīmate // 1b eteṣāmūrdhvaśāstroktamantrāṇāṃ na pratiṣṭhitam / bahiṣkuryāttato hyete rahasyatvena siddhidāḥ svavīryānandamāhātmyapraveśavaśaśālinīm / ye siddhiṃ dadate teṣāṃ bāhyatvaṃ rūpavicyutiḥ kiṃca coktaṃ samāveśapūrṇo bhoktrātmakaḥ śivaḥ / bhogalāmpaṭyabhāgbhogavicchede nigrahātmakaḥ śāntatvanyakkriyodbhūtajighatsāvṛṃhitaṃ vapuḥ / svayaṃ pratiṣṭhitaṃ yena so@syābhoge vinaśyati uktaṃ jñānottarāyāṃ ca tadetatparameśinā / śivo yāgapriyo yasmādviśeṣānmātṛmadhyagaḥ

guruścātra nirodhākhye kāla itthaṃ vibhau vadet / jīvatyasminphalāntaṃ tvaṃ tiṣṭherjīvāvadhīti vā liṅgaṃ ca bāṇaliṅgaṃ vā ratnajaṃ vātha mauktikam / pauṣpamānnamatho vāstraṃ gandhadravyakṛtaṃ ca vā natu pāṣāṇajaṃ liṅgaṃ śilpyutthaṃ parikalpayet / dhātūtthaṃ ca suvarṇotthavarjamanyadvivarjayet na cātra liṅgamānādi kvacidapyupayujyate / udāravīryairmantrairyadbhāsitaṃ phaladaṃ hi tat tasyāpi sthaṇḍilādyuktavidhinā śuddhimācaret / mantrārpaṇaṃ tathaiva syānnirodhastūktayuktitaḥ agnau ca tarpaṇaṃ bh

paṅkticakrakaśūlābjavidhinā tūramāśrayet / tallakṣaṇaṃ bruve śrīmatpicuśāstre nirūpitam tūre yogaḥ sadā śastaḥ siddhido doṣavarjite / jālakairjarjarai randhrairdantairūnādhikai rujā yukte ca tūre hāniḥ syāt taddhīne yāga uttamaḥ / kāmya eva bhavettūramiti kecitprapedire guravastu vidhau kāmye yatnāddoṣāṃstyajediti / vyācakṣate picuproktaṃ na nitye karmaṇītyadaḥ śrīsiddhātantra uktaṃ ca tūralakṣaṇamuttamam / ekādikacatuṣkhaṇḍe gomukhe pūrṇacandrake padmagorocanāmuktānīrasphaṭikasaṃnibhe / ekādipa

akṣasūtraṃ kramotkṛṣṭaṃ raudrākṣaṃ vā viśeṣataḥ / śataṃ tithyuttaraṃ yadvā sāṣṭaṃ yadvā tadardhakam tadardhaṃ vātha pañcāśadyuktaṃ tatparikalpayet / vaktrāṇi pañca citspandajñānecchākṛtisaṃgateḥ pañcadhādyantagaṃ caikyamityupāntyākṣago vidhiḥ / śaktitadvatprabhedena tatra dvairūpyamucyate tato dviguṇamāne tu dvirūpaṃ nyāsamācaret / tato@pi dviguṇe sṛṣṭisaṃhṛtidvitayena tam mātṛkāṃ mālinīṃ vātha nyasyetkhaśarasaṃmite / uttame tu dvayīṃ nyasyennyasya pūrvaṃ pracoditān dīkṣāyāṃ mukhyato mantrāṃstān

tasyāpyeṣa vidhiḥ sarvaḥ pratiṣṭhādau prakīrtitaḥ / tanniṣkamparasaiḥ pūrṇaṃ kṛtvāsminpūjayetkramam adhomukhaṃ sadā sthāpyaṃ pūjitaṃ pūjane punaḥ / tatpātramunmukhaṃ tacca riktaṃ kuryānna tādṛśam pūjānte tadrasāpūrṇamātmānaṃ pravidhāya tat / adhomukhaṃ ca saṃpūjya sthāpayet vicakṣaṇaḥ khaṅgaṃ kṛpāṇikāṃ yadvā kartarīṃ makuraṃ ca vā / vimalaṃ tattathā kuryācchrīmatkālīmukhoditam śrībhairavakule@pyuktaṃ kulaparvaprapūjane / sthaṇḍile@gnau paṭe liṅge pātre padme@tha maṇḍale mūrtau ghaṭe@strasaṃghāte

ata eva yadā bhūridinaṃ maṇḍalakalpanam / tadā dine dine kuryādvibhavaistarpaṇaṃ bahu pratiṣṭhāyāṃ ca sarvatra guruḥ pūrvoditaṃ param / satattvamanusandhāya saṃnidhiṃ sphuṭamācaret siddhe tu tanmayībhāve phale putrakasādhakaiḥ / anyasmai taddvayādanyatarasmai tatsamarpyate tasyāpyeṣa vidhiḥ sarvastadalābhe tu sarvathā / agādhe@mbhasi tatkṣepyaṃ kṣamayitvā visṛjya ca ityeṣa svapratiṣṭhānavidhiḥ śivanirūpitaḥ / parapratiṣṭhite liṅge bāṇīye@tha svayaṃbhuvi sarvamāsanapakṣe prāṅnyasya saṃpūjayetkram

atha yathocitamantrakadambakaṃ trikakulakramayogi nirūpyate / tāvadvimarśānārūḍhadhiyāṃ tātsiddhaye kramāt pratibuddhā hi te mantrā vimarśaikasvabhāvakāḥ / svatantrasyaiva ciddhāmnaḥ svātantryāt kartṛtāmayāḥ yamāviśanti cācāryaṃ taṃ tādātmyanirūḍhitaḥ / svatantrīkurvate yānti karaṇānyapi kartṛtām ādhāraśaktau hrīṃ pṛthvīprabhṛtau tu catuṣṭaye / kṣlāṃ kṣvīṃ vaṃ kṣamiti prāhuḥ kramādvarṇacatuṣṭayam haṃ nāle yaṃ tathā raṃ laṃ vaṃ dharmādicatuṣṭaye / ṛṃ ṝṃ ḷṃ ḷḷṃ catuṣke ca viparītakramādbhavet oṃ a

ratiśekharamantro@sya vaktrāṅgaṃ hrasvadīrghakaiḥ / agniprāṇāgnisaṃhārakālendrāmbusamīraṇāḥ saṣaṣṭhasvarabirndvadhacandrādyāḥ syurnavātmanaḥ / bindunādādikā vyāptiḥ śrīmattraiśirase mate kṣepākrānticidudbodhadīpanasthāpanānyatha / tatsaṃvittistadāpattiriti saṃjñābhiśabditā etāvatī mahāvyāptirmūrtitvenātra kīrtitā / pariṇāmastallayaśca namaskāraḥ sa ucyate eṣa tryarṇojjhito@dhastāddīrghaiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ svarairyutaḥ / ṣaḍaṅgāni hṛdādīni vaktrāṇyasya ca kalpayet kṣayaravalabījaistu dīptairbinduvibhūṣita

prāṇaṃ daṇḍāsanasthaṃ tu guhyaśaktīcchayā yutam / pareyaṃ vācikoddiṣṭā mahājñānasvarūpataḥ sphuṭaṃ bhairavahṛjjñānamidaṃ tvekākṣaraṃ param / amṛtaṃ kevalaṃ khasthaṃ yadvā sāvitrikāyutam śūnyadvayasamopetaṃ parāyā hṛdayaṃ param / yugmayāge prasiddhaṃ tu kartavyaṃ tattvavedibhiḥ anye@pyekākṣarā ye tu ekavīravidhānataḥ / guptā guptatarāste tu aṃgābhijanavarjitāḥ yaṣṭavyāḥ sādhakendraistu kulasthāḥ siddhidāyakāḥ / kulakramavidhānena sūkṣmavijñānayogataḥ anuṣṭheyāḥ sadā devi striyā vā puruṣeṇa vā / s

netrametatprakāśātma sarvasādhāraṇaṃ smṛtam / tāraḥ ślīṃ paśu huṃ phat ca tadastraṃ rasavarṇakam laraṭakṣavayairdīrghaiḥ samayuktaiḥ sabindukaiḥ / indrādayastadastrāṇi hrasvairviṣṇuprajāpatī smṛtau turyadvitīyābhyāṃ hrasvābhyāṃ padmacakrake / namaḥ svāhā tathā vauṣaṭ huṃ vaṣaṭ phaṭ ca jātayaḥ aṅgeṣu kramaśaḥ ṣaṭsu karmasvatha tadātmikāḥ / jape home tathāpyāye samuccāṭe@tha śāntike abhicāre ca mantrāṇāṃ namaskārādijātayaḥ / akṣiṣaṇmunivargebhyo dvitīyāḥ saha bindunā yonyarṇena ca mātṝṇāṃ sadmāvaḥ

yāvatyaḥ siddhayastantre tāḥ sarvāḥ kurute tviyam / aṅgavaktrāṇi cāpyasyāḥ prāgvatsvaraniyogataḥ daṇḍo jīvastriśūlaṃ ca dakṣāṅgulyaparastanau / nābhikaṇṭhau marudrudrau visargaḥ satriśūlakaḥ sarvayoginicakrāṇāmadhipo@yamudāhṛtaḥ / asyāpyuccāraṇādeva saṃvittiḥ syātpuroditā mahācaṇḍeti tu yogeśvaṛ ityaṣṭavarṇakam / navārṇeyaṃ guptatarā sadbhāvaḥ kālakarṣiṇī śrīḍāmare mahāyāge parātparataroditā / sudhācchedakaṣaṇṭhādyairbījaṃ chedakamasvaram adhyardhārṇā kālarātriḥ kṣurikā mālinīmate / śatāvartanay

kuñcanaṃ cāṅgulīnāṃ tu kartavyaṃ codanaṃ tataḥ / jānvādiparacakrāntaṃ cakrāccakraṃ tu kuñcayet kathitaṃ sarahasyaṃ tu sadyonirvāṇakaṃ param / athocyate brahmavidyā sadyaḥpratyayadāyinī śivaḥ śrībhūtirājo yāmasmabhyaṃ pratyapādayat / sarveṣāmeva bhūtānāṃ maraṇe samupasthite yayā paṭhitayotkramya jīvo yāti nirañjanam / yā jñānino@pi saṃpūrṇakṛtyasyāpi śrutā satī prāṇādicchedajāṃ mṛtyuvyathāṃ sadyo vyapohati / yāmākarṇya mahāmohavivaśo@pi kramādgataḥ prabodhaṃ vaktṛsāṃmukhyamabhyeti rabhasātsvayam

haṃsamahāmantramayaḥ sanātanastvaṃ śubhāśubhāpekṣī / maṇḍalamadhyaniviṣṭaḥ śaktimahāsetukāraṇamahārthaḥ kamalobhayaviniviṣṭaḥ prabodhamāyāhi devatādeha / āryāvākyamidaṃ sārdhaṃ rudrasaṃkhyapaderitam niḥśvāse tvapaśabdasya sthāne@styupa iti dhvaniḥ / ajñānāttvaṃ baddhaḥ prabodhitottiṣṭha devāde etatpañcamamāryārdhavākyaṃ syātsaptabhiḥ padaiḥ / vraja tālusāhvayāntaṃ hyauḍambaraghaṭṭitaṃ mahādvāram prāpya prayāhi haṃho haṃho vā vāmadevapadam / āryyāvākyamidaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ syāccaturdaśabhiḥ padaiḥ granth

sanātma tripiṇḍamiti mahākośamiti sthitam / padatrayaṃ tu niḥśvāsamukuṭottarakādiṣu aṅguṣṭhamātramamalamāvaraṇaṃ jahihi he mahāsūkṣma / āryyāvākyamidaṃ ṣaḍbhiḥ padairdaśamamucyate alaṃ dviriti sūkṣmaṃ cetyevaṃ śrīmukuṭottare / puruṣastvaṃ prakṛtimayairbaddho@haṅkāratantunā bandhaiḥ abhavābhava nityodita paramātmaṃstyaja sarāgamadhvānam / etattrayodaśapadaṃ syādāryāvākyamuttamam hrīṃhūṃmantraśarīramavilambamāśu tvamehi dehāntam / āryārdhavākyametatsyād dvādaśaṃ ṣaṭpadaṃ param tadidaṃ guṇabhūtamay

iti pañcākṣarāṇi syuḥ proktavyāptyanusārataḥ / binduprāṇāmṛtajalaṃ marutṣaṣṭhasvarānvitam etena śaktyuccārasthabījenālabhyate paśuḥ / kṛtadīkṣāvidhiḥ pūrvaṃ brahmaghno@pi viśuddhyati laghutvena tulāśuddhiḥ sadyaḥpratyayakāriṇī / tāraḥ śamarayaiḥ piṇḍo natiśca caturarṇakam śākinīstobhanaṃ marma hṛdayaṃ jīvitaṃ tvidam / ṣaṣṭhaprāṇatrikūṭordhvabāhuśūlākhyabindubhiḥ anackanāsādhovaktracandrakhaṇḍaiśca maṇḍitam / hṛdayaṃ bhairavākhyaṃ tu sarvasaṃhārakārakam agnimaṇḍalamadhyasthabhairavānalatāpitāḥ /

prakartavyā yathā dīKṣā śrīsantatyāgamoditā / kathyate hāṭakeśānapātālādhipacoditā śrīnātha ārya bhagavannetattritayaṃ hi kanda ādhāre / varuṇo macchando bhagavatta iti trayamidaṃ hṛdaye dharmādivargasaṃjñāścatvāraḥ kaṇṭhadeśagāḥ pūjyāḥ / hrīṃśrīṃpūrvāḥ sarve sambodhajuṣaśca pādaśabdāntāḥ mūrdhatale vidyātrayamuktaṃ bhāvyatha mano@bhiyogena / kusumairānandairvā bhāvanayā vāpi kevalayā guruṇā tattvavidā kila śiṣyo yadi mokṣamātrakṛtahṛdayaḥ / mokṣaikadānacaturā dīkṣā seyaṃ paropaniṣaduktā etaddīk

asya varṇatrayasyānte tvantaḥsthānāṃ catuṣṭayam / vargādyaśvau tryasrabinduyuk pānto@rṇatrayādataḥ mahāhāṭakaśabdādyamīśvarītyarṇasaptakam / āmantritaṃ kṣamasveti tryarṇaṃ pāpāntakāriṇi ṣaḍarṇaṃ pāpaśabdādivimohanipadaṃ tataḥ / pāpaṃ hana dhuna dvirdvirdaśārṇaṃ padamīdṛśam pañcamyantaṃ ṣaḍarṇaṃ syādrudraśaktivaśāditi / tata ekākṣaraṃ yattadvisargabrahma kīrtitam tadanackatakāreṇa sahaikībhāvataḥ paṭhet / randhrābdhivarṇā vidyeyaṃ dīkṣāvidyeti kīrtitā māyārṇañca pare brahme caturvidye padatrayam

yaḥ sākṣādabhajacchrīmāñśrīkaṇṭho mānuṣīṃ tanum / atra vīryaṃ puraivoktaṃ sarvatrānusaredguruḥ arthabījapraveśāntaruccārādyanusārataḥ / nahi tatkiṃcanāpyasti yatpurā na nirūpitam niṣphalā punaruktistu nāsmabhyaṃ jātu rocate / ityevaṃ mantravidyādisvarūpamupavarṇitam

atha kathaye mudrāṇāṃ gurvāgamagītamatra vidhim / 0b mudrā ca pratibimbātmā śrīmaddevyākhyayāmale / uktā bimbodayaśrutyā vācyadvayavivecanāt bimbātsamudayo yasyā ityuktā pratibimbatā / vimbasya yasyā udaya ityuktā tadupāyatā mudaṃ svarūpalābhākhyaṃ dehadvāreṇa cātmanām / rātyarpayati yattena mudrā śāstreṣu varṇitā tatra pradhānabhūtā śrīkhecarī devatātmikā / niṣkalatvena vikhyātā sākalyena triśūlinī karaṅkiṇī krodhanā ca bhairavī lelihānikā / mahāpretā yogamudrā jvālinī kṣobhiṇī dhruvā ityevaṃba

daṇḍākāraṃ tu taṃ tāvannayedyāvatkakhatrayam / nigṛhya tatra tattūrṇaṃ prerayet khatrayeṇa tu etāṃ baddhvā khe gatiḥ syāditi śrīpūrvaśāsane / dhvanijyotirmarudyuktaṃ cittaṃ viśramya copari anenābhyāsayogena śivaṃ bhittvā paraṃ vrajet / jatrvadhastātkarau kṛtvā vāmapādaṃ ca dakṣiṇe vidāryāsyaṃ kaniṣṭhābhyāṃ madhyamābhyāṃ tu nāsikām / anāme kuñcayetprājño bhrūbhaṅgaṃ tarjanīdvayam jihvāṃ ca cālayenmantrī hāhākāraṃ ca kārayet / triśūlena prayogeṇa brahmarandhramupasthitaḥ padaṃ santyajya tanmātraṃ

avadhūto nirācāro nāhamasmīti bhāvayam / mantraikaniṣṭhaḥ saṃpaśyan dehasthāḥ sarvadevatāḥ hlādodvegāsmitākruṣṭanidrāmaithunamatsare / rūpādau vā kartṛkarmakaraṇeṣu ca sarvaśaḥ nāhamasmīti manvāna ekībhūtaṃ vicintayan / karṇākṣimukhanāsādicakrasthaṃ devatāgaṇam grahītāraṃ sadā paśyan khecaryā siddhyati sphuṭam / vidyāśaṅkī malāśaṅkī śāstraśaṅkī na siddhyati śivo raviḥ śivo vahniḥ paktṛtvātsa purohitaḥ / tatrasthā devatāḥ sarvā dyotayantyo@khilaṃ jagat kaniṣṭhayā vidāryāsyaṃ tarjanībhyāṃ bhruvau

navacchidragataṃ caikaṃ nadantaṃ vyāpakaṃ dhruvam / anayā hi khacārī śrīyogasañcāra ucyate kulakuṇḍalikāṃ baddhvā aṇorantaravedinīm / vāmo yo@yaṃ jagatyasmiṃstasya saṃharaṇodyatām svasthāne nirvṛtiṃ labdhvā jñānāmṛtarasātmakam / vrajetkandapadaṃ madhye rāvaṃ kṛtvā hyarāvakam yāvajjīvaṃ catuṣkoṇaṃ piṇḍādhāraṃ ca kāmikam / tatra tāṃ bodhayitvā tu gatiṃ buddhvā kramāgatām cakrobhayanibaddhāṃ tu śākhāprāntāvalambinīm / mūlasthānādyathā devi tamogranthiṃ vidārayet vajrākhyāṃ jñānajenaiva tathā śākhob

yonyādhāreti vikhyātā śūlamūleti śabdyate / varṇāstatra layaṃ yānti hyavarṇe varṇarūpiṇi nādiphāntaṃ samuccārya kauleśaṃ dehasaṃnibham / ākramya prathamaṃ cakraṃ khe yantre pādapīḍitam nādaṃ vai śaktisadgarbhaṃ sadgarbhātkaulinīpadam / bījapañcakacāreṇa śūlabhedakrameṇa tu hṛcchūlagranthibhedaiścidrudraśaktiṃ prabodhayet / vāyucakrāntanilayaṃ bindvākhyaṃ nābhimaṇḍalam āgacchellambikāsthānaṃ sūtradvādaśanirgatam / candracakravilomena praviśedbhūtapañjare bhūyastu kurute līlāṃ māyāpañjaravartinīm

vṛṣaṇadvayaliṅgaṃ ca prāpya kāyaṃ gatā tviyam / bhavasthānābhavasthānamuccāreṇāvadhārayet mānasīyamitastvanyāḥ padmādyā aṣṭa mudrikāḥ / mātṛvyūhakule tāḥ syurasyāstu parivāragāḥ śarīraṃ tu samastaṃ yatkūṭākṣarasamākṛti / eṣā mudrā mahāmudrā bhairavasyeti gahvare sūpaviṣṭaḥ padmake tu hastāgrāṅguliraśmibhiḥ / parāṅmukhairjhaṭityudyadraśmibhiḥ pṛṣṭhasaṃsthitaiḥ antaḥsthitiḥ khecarīyaṃ saṃkocākhyā śaśāṅkinī / tasmādeva samuttambya bāhū caivāvakuñcitau samyagvyomasu saṃsthānādvyomākhyā khecarī matā

sāhasānupraveśena kuñcitaṃ hastayugmakam / adhovīkṣaṇaśīlaṃ ca samyagdṛṣṭisamanvitam vīrabhairavasaṃjñeyaṃ khecarī bodhavardhinī / aṣṭadhetthaṃ varṇitā śrībhargāṣṭakaśikhākule evaṃ nānāvidhānbhedānāśrityaikaiva yā sthitā / śrīkhecarī tayāviṣṭaḥ paraṃ bījaṃ prapadyate ekaṃ sṛṣṭimayaṃ bījaṃ yadvīryaṃ sarvamantragam / ekā mudrā khecarī ca mudraughaḥ prāṇito yayā tadevaṃ khecarīcakrarūḍhau yadrūpamullaset / tadeva mudrā mantavyā śeṣaḥ syāddehavikriyā yāgādau tanmadhye tadavasitau jñānayogaparimarśe

athāvasarasaṃprāpta ekīkāro nigadyate / 0b yaduktaṃ cakrabhedena sārdhaṃ pūjyamiti trikam / tatraiṣa cakrabhedānāmekīkāro diśānayā viśvā tadīśā hāraudrī vīranetryambikā tathā / gurvīti ṣaḍare devyaḥ śrīsiddhāvīradarśitāḥ māheśī brāhmaṇī skāndī vaiṣṇavyaindrī yamātmikā / cāmuṇḍā caiva yogīśītyaṣṭāghoryādayo@thavā agninirṛtivāyvīśamātṛbhirdvādaśānvitāḥ / nandā bhadrā jayā kālī karālī vikṛtānanā kroṣṭukī bhīmamudrā ca vāyuvegā hayānanā / gambhīrā ghoṣaṇī ceti caturviṃśatyare vidhiḥ siddhirvṛddhirdy

śakuniḥ sumatirnando gopālaśca pitāmahaḥ / śrīkaṇṭho@nantasūkṣmau ca trimūrtiḥ śaṃbareśvaraḥ arghīśo bhārabhūtiśca sthitiḥ sthāṇurharastathā / jhaṇṭhibhautikasadyojānugrahakrūrasainikāḥ dvyaṣṭau yadvāmṛtastena yuktāḥ pūrṇābhataddravāḥ / oghormisyandanāṅgāśca vapurudgāravaktrakāḥ tanusecanamūrtīśāḥ sarvāmṛtadharo@paraḥ / śrīpāṭhācchaktayaścaitāḥ ṣoḍaśaiva prakīrtitāḥ saṃvartalakulibhṛgusitabakakhaṅgipinākibhujagabalikālāḥ / dviśchagalāṇḍau śikhiśoṇameṣamīnatridaṇḍi sāṣāḍhi devīkāntatadardhau dāru

śrutyagnyare syurete strīpāṭhācchaktayastvetāḥ / juṃkāro@thāgnipatnīti ṣaḍare ṣaṇṭhavarjitāḥ dvādaśāre tatsahitāḥ ṣoḍaśāre svarāḥ kramāt / halastaddviguṇe@ṣṭāre yādyaṃ hāntaṃ tu tattrike dvātriṃśadarake sāntaṃ binduḥ sarveṣu mūrdhani / evamanyānbahūṃścakrabhedānasmātprakalpayet eka eva cidātmaiṣa viśvāmarśanasārakaḥ / śaktistadvānato mātā śabdarāśiḥ prakīrtitau tayoreva vibhāge tu śaktitadvatprakalpane / śabdarāśirmālinī ca kṣobhātma vapurīdṛśam tathāntaḥsthaparāmarśabhedane vastutastrikam / anu

viśvamekaparāmarśasahatvātprabhṛti sphuṭam / aṃśāṃśikāparāmarśān paryante sahate yataḥ ataḥ pañcāśadaikātmyaṃ svaravyaktivirūpatā / vargāṣṭakaṃ varṇabheda ekāśītikalodayaḥ iti pradarśitaṃ pūrvam ardhamātrāsahatvataḥ / svarārdhamapyasti yataḥ svaritasyārdhamātrakam tasyādita udāttaṃ tatkathitaṃ padavedinā / itthaṃ saṃvidiyaṃ yājyasvarūpāmarśarūpiṇī abhinnaṃ saṃvidaścaitaccakrāṇāṃ cakravālakam / svāmyāvaraṇabhedena bahudhā tatprayojayet parāparā parā cānyā sṛṣṭisthititirodhayaḥ / mātṛsadbhāvarūpā

athocyate samastānāṃ śāstrāṇāmiha melanam / iha tāvatsama sto@yaṃ vyavahāraḥ purātanaḥ prasiddhimanusandhāya saiva cāgama ucyate / anvayavyatirekau hi prasiddherupajīvakau svāyattatve tayorvyaktipūge kiṃ syāttayorgatiḥ / pratyakṣamapi netrātmadīpārthādiviśeṣajam apekṣate tatra mūle prasiddhiṃ tāṃ tathātmikām / abhitaḥsaṃvṛte jāta ekākī kṣudhitaḥ śiśuḥ kiṃ karotu kimādattāṃ kena paśyatu kiṃ vrajet / nanu vastuśatākīrṇe sthāne@pyasya yadeva hi paśyato jighrato vāpi spṛśataḥ saṃprasīdati / cetastad

prācyā cedāgatā seyaṃ prasiddhiḥ paurvakālikī / naca cetaḥprasattyaiva sarvo vyavahṛtikramaḥ mūlaṃ prasiddhistanmānaṃ sarvatraiveti gṛhyatām / pūrvapūrvopajīvitvamārgaṇe sā kvacitsvayam sarvajñarūpe hyekasminniḥśaṅkaṃ bhāsata purā / vyavahāro hi naikatra samastaḥ ko@pi mātari tenāsarvajñapūrvatvamātreṇaiṣā na siddhyati / bahusarvajñapūrvatve na mānaṃ cāsti kiṃcana bhogāpavargataddhetuprasiddhiśataśobhitaḥ / tadvimarśasvabhāvo@sau bhairavaḥ parameśvaraḥ tataścāṃśāṃśikāyogātsā prasiddhiḥ paramparā

naca kāpyatra doṣāśāśaṅkāyāśca nivṛttitaḥ / prasiddhiścāvigānotthā pratītiḥ śabdanātmikā mātuḥ svabhāvo yattasyāṃ śaṅkate naiṣa jātucit / svakṛtatvavaśādeva sarvavitsa hi śaṅkaraḥ yāvattu śivatā nāsya tāvatsvātmānusāriṇīm / tāvatīmeva tāmeṣa prasiddhiṃ nābhiśaṅkate anyasyāmabhiśaṅkī syādbhūyastāṃ bahu manyate / evaṃ bhāviśivatvo@mūṃ prasiddhiṃ manyate dhruvam eka evāgamaścāyaṃ vibhunā sarvadarśinā / darśito yaḥ pravṛtte ca nivṛtte ca pathi sthitaḥ dharmārthakāmamokṣeṣu pūrṇāpūrṇādibhedataḥ / vic

yathaikatrāpi vedādau tattadāśramagāminaḥ / saṃskārāntaramatrāpi tathā liṅgoddhṛtādikam yathāca tatra pūrvasminnāśrame nottarāśramāt / phalameti tathā pāñcarātrādau na śivātmatām eka evāgamastasmāttatra laukikaśāstrataḥ / prabhṛtyāvaiṣṇavādbauddhācchaivātsarvaṃ hi niṣṭhitam tasya yattat paraṃ prāpyaṃ dhāma tat trikaśabditam / sarvāvibhedānucchedāt tadeva kulamucyate yathordhvādharatābhāksu dehāṅgeṣu vibhediṣu / ekaṃ prāṇitamevaṃ syāt trikaṃ sarveṣu śāstrataḥ śrīmatkālīkule coktaṃ pañcasrotovivar

ekasmādāgamāccaite khaṇḍakhaṇḍā vyapoddhṛtāḥ / loke syurāgamāstaiśca jano bhrāmyati mohitaḥ anekāgamapakṣe@pi vācyā viṣayabheditā / avaśyamūrdhvādharatāsthityā prāmāṇyasiddhaye anyathā naiva kasyāpi prāmāṇyaṃ siddhyati dhruvam / nityatvamavisaṃvāda iti no mānakāraṇam asminnaṃśe@pyamuṣyaiva prāmāṇyaṃ syāttathoditeḥ / anyathāvyākṛtau kḷptāvasatyatve prarocane atiprasaṅga sarvasyāpyāgamasyāpabādhakaḥ / avaśyopetya ityasminmāna āgamanāmani avaśyopetyamevaitacchāstraniṣṭhānirūpaṇam / pradhāne@ṅge kṛt
āyātiratha śāstrasya kathyate@vasarāgatā /0b śrīsiddhādivinirdiṣṭā gurubhiśca nirūpitā / bhairavo bhairavī devī svacchando lākulo@ṇurāṭ
gahaneśo@bjajaḥ śakro guruḥ koṭyapakarṣataḥ / navabhiḥ kramaśo@dhītaṃ navakoṭipravistaram
etaistato guruḥ koṭimātrāt pādaṃ vitīrṇavān / dakṣādibhya ubhau pādau saṃvartādibhya eva ca
pādaṃ ca vāmanādibhyaḥ pādārdhaṃ bhārgavāya ca / pādapādaṃ tu balaye pādapādastu yo@paraḥ
siṃhāyārdhaṃ tataḥ śiṣṭāddvau bhāgau vinatābhuve / pādaṃ vāsukināgāya khaṇḍāḥ saptadaśa tvamī
svargādardhaṃ rāvaṇo@tha jahre rāmo@rdhamapyataḥ / vibhīṣaṇamukhādāpa guruśiṣyavidhikramāt
khaṇḍairekānnaviṃśatyā vibhaktaṃ tadabhūttataḥ / khaṇḍaṃ khaṇḍaṃ cāṣṭakhaṇḍaṃ proktapādādibhedataḥ
pādo mūloddhārāvuttaravṛhaduttare tathā kalpaḥ / sāṃhitakalpaskandāvanuttaraṃ vyāpakaṃ tridhā tisraḥ
devyo@tra nirūpyante kramaśo vistāriṇaiva rūpeṇa / navame pade tu gaṇanā na kāciduktā vyavacchidāhīne
rāmācca lakṣmaṇastasmāt siddhāstebhyo@pi dānavāḥ / guhyakāśca tatastebhyo yogino nṛvarāstataḥ
teṣāṃ krameṇa tanmadhye bhraṣṭaṃ kālāntarādyadā / tadā śrīkaṇṭhanāthājñāvaśāt siddhā avātaram
tryambakāmardakābhikhyaśrīnāthā advaye dvaye / dvayādvaye ca nipuṇāḥ krameṇa śivaśāsane
ādyasya cānvayo jajñe dvitīyo duhitṛkramāt / sa cārdhatryambakābhikhyaḥ saṃtānaḥ supratiṣṭhitaḥ
ataścārdhacatasro@tra maṭhikāḥ saṃtatikramāt / śiṣyapraśiṣyairvistīrṇāḥ śataśākhaṃ vyavasthitaiḥ
adhyuṣṭasaṃtatisrotaḥsārabhūtarasāhṛtim / vidhāya tantrāloko@yaṃ syandate sakalānrasān
uktāyātirupādeyabhāvo nirṇīyate@dhunā /

tantrasāra, prathamam āhnikam
vimalakalāśrayābhinavasṛṣṭimahā jananī bharitatanuś ca pañcamukhaguptarucir janakaḥ /
tadubhayayāmalasphuritabhāvavisargamayaṃ hṛdayam anuttarāmṛtakulaṃ mama saṃsphuratāt // abhts_1.1 vitatas tantrāloko vigāhituṃ naiva śakyate sarvaiḥ /
ṛjuvacanaviracitam idaṃ tu tantrasāraṃ tataḥ śṛṇuta // abhts_1.2 śrīśambhunāthabhāskaracaraṇanipātaprabhāpagatasaṃkocam /
abhinavaguptahṛdambujam etad vicinuta maheśapūjanahetoḥ // abhts_1.3 iha jñānaṃ mokṣakāraṇaṃ bandhanimittasya a

tantrasāra, dvitīyam āhnikam atha anupāyam eva tāvat vyākhyāsyāmaḥ // abhts_2.1 yadā khalu dṛḍhaśaktipātāviddhaḥ svayam eva itthaṃ vivecayati sakṛd eva guruvacanam avadhārya tadā punar upāyavirahito nityoditaḥ asya samāveśaḥ // abhts_2.2 atra ca tarka eva yogāṅgam iti kathaṃ vivecayati iti cet ucyate yo 'yaṃ parameśvaraḥ svaprakāśarūpaḥ svātmā tatra kim upāyena kriyate na svarūpalābho nityatvāt na jñaptiḥ svayaṃprakāśamānatvāt nāvaraṇavigamaḥ āvaraṇasya kasyacid api asaṃbhavāt na tadanupraveśaḥ

tantrasāra, tṛtīyam āhnikam yad etat prakāśarūpaṃ śivatattvam uktam tatra akhaṇḍamaṇḍale yadā praveṣṭuṃ na śaknoti tadā svātantryaśaktim eva adhikāṃ paśyan nirvikalpam eva bhairavasamāveśam anubhavati ayaṃ ca asya upadeśaḥ sarvam idaṃ bhāvajātaṃ bodhagagane pratibimbamātraṃ pratibimbalakṣaṇopetatvāt idaṃ hi pratibimbasya lakṣaṇaṃ yat bhedena bhāsitam aśaktam anyavyāmiśratvenaiva bhāti tat pratibimbam mukharūpam iva darpaṇe rasa iva dantodake gandha iva ghrāṇa mithunasparśa iva ānandendriye śūlak

anuttarānandayoḥ icchādiṣu yadā prasaraḥ tadā varṇadvayam e oṃ iti // abhts_3.14 tatrāpi punar anuttarānandasaṃghaṭṭāt varṇadvayam ai au iti // abhts_3.15 sā iyaṃ kriyāśaktiḥ tad eva ca varṇacatuṣṭayam e ai o au iti // abhts_3.16 tataḥ punaḥ kriyāśaktyante sarvaṃ kāryabhūtaṃ yāvat anuttare pravekṣyati tāvad eva pūrvaṃ saṃvedanasāratayā prakāśamātratvena bindutayā āste am iti // abhts_3.17 tatas tatraiva anuttarasya visargo jāyate aḥ iti // abhts_3.18 evaṃ ṣoḍaśakaṃ parāmarśānāṃ bījasvarūpam ucya

tantrasāra, caturtham āhnikam tatra yadā vikalpaṃ krameṇa saṃskurute samanantaroktasvarūpapraveśāya tadā bhāvanākramasya sattarkasadāgamasadgurūpadeśapūrvakasya asti upayogaḥ // abhts_4.1 tathā hi vikalpabalāt eva jantavo baddham ātmānam abhimanyante sa abhimānaḥ saṃsārapratibandhahetuḥ ataḥ pratidvandvirūpo vikalpa uditaḥ saṃsārahetuṃ vikalpaṃ dalayati iti abhyudayahetuḥ // abhts_4.2 sa ca evaṃrūpaḥ samastebhyaḥ paricchinnasvabhāvebhyaḥ śivāntebhyaḥ tattvebhyo yat uttīrṇam aparicchinnasaṃvinmāt

laukike 'pi vā abhyāse cidātmatvena sarvarūpasya tasya tasya dehādeḥ abhimatarūpatāprakaṭīkaraṇaṃ taditararūpanyagbhāvanaṃ ca iti eṣa eva abhyāsārthaḥ // abhts_4.18 paratattve tu na kiṃcit apāsyam iti uktam // abhts_4.19 dvaitādhivāso 'pi nāma na kaścana pṛthak vastubhūtaḥ api tu svarūpākhyātimātraṃ tat ato dvaitāpāsanaṃ vikalpena kriyata ity ukteḥ // abhts_4.20 ayaṃ paramārthaḥ svarūpaṃ prakāśamānam akhyātirūpatvaṃ svayaṃ svātantryāt gṛhītaṃ krameṇa projjhya vikāsonmukham atha vikasat atha vika

yayā parasparaviviktātmanā bhedenaiva sā asya śrīmadaparaśaktiḥ // abhts_4.34 etat trividhaṃ yayā dhāraṇam ātmany eva kroḍīkāreṇa anusandhānātmanā grasate sā asya bhagavatī śrīparaiva śrīmanmātṛsadbhāvakālakarṣiṇyādiśabdāntaraniruktā // abhts_4.35 tā etāḥ catasraḥ śaktayaḥ svātantryāt pratyekaṃ tridhaiva vartante // abhts_4.36 sṛṣṭau sthitau saṃhāre ca iti dvādaśa bhavanti // abhts_4.37 tathā hi saṃvit pūrvam antar eva bhāvaṃ kalayati tato bahir api sphuṭatayā kalayati tatraiva raktimayatāṃ gṛhī

## tsa05-p01 — the atom's toolkit, and how to see fire
When thought can refine itself with no outside help, it has slipped the bondsman's work; graced by bright knowing and wearing the Lord's own power, taken up as a means, it delivers the knowledge of power. (That verdict belongs to the next chapter.) But when thought still needs props, it grabs limited ones — mind, breath, body, pots — and goes atomic: small knower, small knowledge. Mind means seeing; breath is coarse breath-work, and a subtle
sa: tantrasāra, pañcamam āhnikam tatra yadā vikalpaḥ svayam eva saṃskāram ātmani upāyāntaranirapekṣatayaiva kartuṃ prabhavati tadā asau pāśavavyāpārāt pracyutaḥ śuddhavidyānugraheṇa parameśaśaktirūpatām āpanna upāyatayā avalambyamānaḥ śāktaṃ jñānam āvirbhāvayati // abhts_5.1 tad etac ca nirṇītam anantara eva āhnike // abhts_5.2 yadā tu upāyāntaram asau svasaṃskārārthaṃ vikalpo 'pekṣate tadā buddhiprāṇadehaghaṭādikān parimitarūpān upāyatvena gṛhṇan aṇutvaṃ prāpta āṇavaṃ jñānam āvirbhāvayati tatra bud

tat etāsu uccārabhūmiṣu pratyekaṃ dvyādiśaḥ sarvaśo vā viśrāmya anyat taddehaprāṇādivyatiriktaṃ viśrāntitattvam āsādayati // abhts_5.20 tad eva sṛṣṭisaṃhārabījoccāraṇarahasyam anusaṃdadhat vikalpaṃ saṃskuryāt āsu ca viśrāntiṣu pratyekaṃ pañca avasthā bhavanti praveśatāratamyāt // abhts_5.21 tatra prāg ānandaḥ pūrṇatāṃśasparśāt tata udbhavaḥ kṣaṇaṃ niḥśarīratāyāṃ rūḍheḥ tataḥ kampaḥ svabalākrāntau dehatādātmyaśaithilyāt tato nidrā bahirmukhatvavilayāt // abhts_5.22 ittham anātmani ātmabhāve līne

tantrasāra, ṣaṣṭham āhnikam sa eva sthānaprakalpanaśabdena uktaḥ tatra tridhā sthānaṃ prāṇavāyuḥ śarīraṃ bāhyaṃ ca tatra prāṇe tāvat vidhiḥ sarvaḥ asau vakṣyamāṇaḥ adhvā prāṇasthaḥ kalyate tasya kramākramakalanaiva kālaḥ sa ca parameśvara eva antarbhāti tadbhāsanaṃ ca devasya kālī nāma śaktiḥ bhedena tu tadābhāsanaṃ kramākramayoḥ prāṇavṛttiḥ // abhts_6.1 saṃvid eva hi prameyebhyo vibhaktaṃ rūpaṃ gṛhṇāti ata eva ca avacchedayogāt vedyatāṃ yāntī nabhaḥ tataḥ svātantryāt meye svīkārautsukyena nipat

pramātṛpramāṇaprameyatritayāvibhāgakāritvāt sa puṇyaḥ kālaḥ pāralaukikaphalapradaḥ // abhts_6.18 tataḥ praviśati prāṇe cidarka ekaikayā kalayā apānacandram āpūrayati yāvat pañcadaśī tuṭiḥ pūrṇimā tadanantaraṃ pakṣasaṃdhiḥ grahaṇaṃ ca iti prāgvat etat tu aihikaphalapradam iti māsodayaḥ // abhts_6.19 atha varṣodayaḥ // abhts_6.20 tatra kṛṣṇapakṣa eva uttarāyaṇaṃ ṣaṭsu ṣaṭsu aṅguleṣu saṃkrāntiḥ makarāt mithunāntām // abhts_6.21 tatra pratyaṅgulaṃ pañca tithayaḥ tatrāpi dinarātrivibhāgaḥ evaṃ praveś

punaḥ gahaneśaḥ sṛjati // abhts_6.44 evaṃ yaḥ avyaktakālaḥ taṃ daśabhiḥ parārdhaiḥ guṇayitvā māyādinaṃ kathayet tāvatī rātriḥ // abhts_6.45 sa eva pralayaḥ // abhts_6.46 māyākālaḥ parārdhaśatena guṇita aiśvaratattve dinam // abhts_6.47 atra prāṇo jagat sṛjati tāvatī rātriḥ yatra prāṇapraśamaḥ prāṇe ca brahmabiladhāmni śānte 'pi yā saṃvit tatrāpy asti kramaḥ // abhts_6.48 aiśvare kāle parārdhaśataguṇite yā saṃkhyā tat sādāśivaṃ dinaṃ tāvatī niśā sa eva mahāpralayaḥ // abhts_6.49 sadāśivaḥ svakāla

atrāpi pūrvavat vidhiḥ // abhts_6.71 vyāne tu vyāpakatvāt akrame 'pi sūkṣmocchalattāyogena kālodayaḥ // abhts_6.72 atha varṇodayaḥ // abhts_6.73 tatra ardhaprahare ardhaprahare vargodayo viṣuvati samaḥ varṇasya varṇasya dve śate ṣoḍaśādhike prāṇānām bahiḥ ṣaṭtriṃśat caṣakāṇi iti udayaḥ ayam ayatnajo varṇodayaḥ // abhts_6.74 yatnajas tu mantrodayaḥ araghaṭṭaghaṭīyantravāhanavat ekānusaṃdhibalāt citraṃ mantrodayaṃ divāniśam anusaṃdadhat mantradevatayā saha tādātmyam eti // abhts_6.75 tatra sadodit

tantrasāra, saptamam āhnikam tatra samasta eva ayaṃ mūrtivaicitryābhāsanaśaktijo deśādhvā saṃvidi viśrāntaḥ taddvāreṇa śūnye buddhau prāṇe nāḍīcakrānucakreṣu bahiḥ śarīre yāval liṅgasthaṇḍilapratimādau samasto 'dhvā pariniṣṭhitaḥ taṃ samastam adhvānaṃ dehe vilāpya dehaṃ ca prāṇe taṃ dhiyi tāṃ śūnye tatsaṃvedane nirbharaparipūrṇasaṃvit sampadyate ṣaṭtriṃśattattvasvarūpajñaḥ taduttīrṇāṃ saṃvidaṃ paramaśivarūpāṃ paśyan viśvamayīm api saṃvedayeta aparathā vedyabhāgam eva kaṃcit paratvena gṛhṇīyān mā

tantrasāra, aṣṭamam āhnikam yad idaṃ vibhavātmakaṃ bhuvanajātam uktaṃ garbhīkṛtānantavicitrabhoktṛbhogyaṃ tatra yad anugataṃ mahāprakāśarūpaṃ tat mahāsāmānyakalpaṃ paramaśivarūpam // abhts_8.1 yat tu katipayakatipayabhedānugataṃ rūpaṃ tat tattvaṃ yathā pṛthivī nāma dyutikāṭhinyasthaulyādirūpā kālāgniprabhṛtivīrabhadrāntabhuvaneśādhiṣṭhitasamastabrahmāṇḍānugatā // abhts_8.2 tatra eṣāṃ tattvānāṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvo darśyate sa ca dvividhaḥ // abhts_8.3 pāramārthikaḥ sṛṣṭeś ca // abhts_8.4 tatra pāram

iyati sākṣāt śivaḥ kartā aśuddhaṃ punar adhvānam anantāparanāmāghoreśaḥ sṛjati īśvarecchāvaśena prakṣubdhabhogalolikānām aṇūnāṃ bhogasiddhyartham // abhts_8.18 tatra loliko 'pūrṇam anyatārūpaḥ parispandaḥ akarmakam abhilāṣamātram eva bhaviṣyad avacchedayogyateti na malaḥ puṃsas tattvāntaram // abhts_8.19 rāgatattvaṃ tu karmāvacchinno 'bhilāṣaḥ // abhts_8.20 karma tu tatra karmamātraṃ buddhidharmas tu rāgaḥ karmabhedacitra iti vibhāgo vakṣyate // abhts_8.21 so 'yaṃ malaḥ parameśvarasya svātmaprac

māyāgarbhādhikāriṇas tu kasyacid īśvarasya prasādāt sarvakarmakṣaye māyāpuruṣaviveko bhavati yena māyordhve vijñānākala āste na jātucit māyādhaḥ kalāpuṃviveko vā yena kalordhve tiṣṭhati // abhts_8.39 prakṛtipuruṣaviveko vā yena pradhānādho na saṃsaret // abhts_8.40 malapuruṣaviveke tu śivasamānatvam // abhts_8.41 puruṣapūrṇatādṛṣṭau tu śivatvam eveti // abhts_8.42 evaṃ kalātattvam eva kiṃcitkartṛtvadāyi na ca // abhts_8.43 kartṛtvam ajñasya iti // abhts_8.44 kiṃcijjñatvadāyiny aśuddhavidyā kalāt

kṣobhaḥ avaśyam eva antarāle abhyupagantavya iti siddhaṃ sāṃkhyāparidṛṣṭaṃ pṛthagbhūtaṃ guṇatattvam // abhts_8.65 sa ca kṣobhaḥ prakṛtes tattveśādhiṣṭhānād eva anyathā niyataṃ puruṣaṃ prati iti na sidhyet // abhts_8.66 tato guṇatattvāt buddhitattvaṃ yatra puṃprakāśo viṣayaś ca pratibimbam arpayataḥ // abhts_8.67 buddhitattvāt ahaṃkāro yena buddhipratibimbite vedyasamparke kaluṣe puṃprakāśe anātmani ātmābhimānaḥ śuktau rajatābhimānavat // abhts_8.68 ata eva kāra ity anena kṛtakatvam asya uktaṃ sā

tantrasāra, navamam āhnikam sa ca saptadhā ṣaḍardhaśāstra eva paraṃ parameśena uktaḥ // abhts_9.1 tatra śivāḥ mantramaheśāḥ mantreśāḥ mantrāḥ vijñānākalāḥ pralayākalāḥ sakalā iti sapta śaktimantaḥ // abhts_9.2 eṣāṃ saptaiva śaktayaḥ tadbhedāt pṛthivyādipradhānatattvāntaṃ caturdaśabhir bhedaiḥ pratyekaṃ svaṃ rūpaṃ pañcadaśam // abhts_9.3 tatra svaṃ rūpaṃ prameyatāyogyaṃ svātmaniṣṭham aparābhaṭṭārikānugrahāt pramātṛṣu udriktaśaktiṣu yat viśrāntibhājanaṃ tat tasyaiva śāktaṃ rūpaṃ śrīmatparāparānugr

tāvaty udriktarāgādikañcukasya sakalasya pramātṛtvāt sakalasyāpi evaṃ pāñcadaśyaṃ tasyāpi tāvad vedyatvāt // abhts_9.17 vitatya caitat nirṇītaṃ tantrāloke // abhts_9.18 puṃsaḥ prabhṛti kalātattvāntaṃ trayodaśadhā // abhts_9.19 sakalasya tatra pramātṛtāyogena tacchaktiśaktimadātmano bhedadvayasya pratyastamayāt tathā ca sakalasya svarūpatvam eva kevalaṃ pralayākalasya svarūpatve pañcānāṃ pramātṛtve ekādaśa bhedāḥ // abhts_9.20 vijñānākalasya svarūpatve caturṇāṃ pramātṛtve nava bhedāḥ // abhts_9.2

## tsa09-p03 — fifteen everywhere, the instant, and the four states (CONDENSED companion)
Doing one's own work is being a grasper — said, not recounted — so the rich-in-discernment, dwelling with teachers, tell fifteen everywhere by dividing. Fewer thoughts, fewer instants — down, in joys and knowings, to thought-free. People rest in thought and mistake the I-shaped, I-covered, this-spreading, thought-free grasping-ground, unshown, for suffering — as the joy-rested mistake pain; but as thought t
sa: svakāryakartṛtā tu grāhakarūpatā iti uktaṃ na sā bhūyo gaṇyate ity evaṃ vivekadhanā gurūpaveśānuśīlinaḥ sarvatra pāñcadaśyaṃ pravibhāgena viviñcate // abhts_9.36 vikalpanyūnatve tu tuṭinyūnatā sukhādisaṃvittāv iva yāvat avikalpataiva // abhts_9.37 lokās tu vikalpaviśrāntyā tām ahaṃtāmayīm ahaṃtācchāditedaṃbhāvavikalpaprasarāṃ nirvikalpāṃ vimarśabhuvam aprakāśitām iva manyante duḥkhāvasthāṃ sukhaviśrāntā iva vikalpanirhrāsena tu sā prakāśata eva iti iyam asau sambandhe grāhyagrāhakayoḥ sāvadhānat

tantrasāra, daśamam āhnikam uktas tāvat tattvādhvā // abhts_10.1 kalādyadhvā tu nirūpyate tatra yathā bhuvaneṣu anugāmi kiṃcid rūpaṃ tattvam ity uktam tathā tattveṣu vargaśo yat anugāmi rūpaṃ tat kalā ekarūpakalanāsahiṣṇutvāt // abhts_10.2 tad yathā pṛthivyāṃ nivṛttiḥ nivartate yatas tattvasarga iti // abhts_10.3 jalādipradhānānte varge pratiṣṭhā kāraṇatayāpyāyanapūraṇakāritvāt // abhts_10.4 pumādimāyānte vidyā vedyatirobhāve saṃvidādhikyāt // abhts_10.5 śuddhavidyādiśaktyante śāntā kañcukataraṃ

tantrasāra, ekādaśam āhnikam tatra yāvat idam uktam tat sākṣāt kasyacit apavargāptaye yathoktasaṃgrahanītyā bhavati kasyacit vakṣyamāṇadīkṣāyām upayogagamanāt iti dīkṣādikaṃ vaktavyam // abhts_11.1 tatra kaḥ adhikārī iti nirūpaṇārthaṃ śaktipāto vicāryate // abhts_11.2

## tsa11-p02 — the failed explanations
Three theories are on offer, and Abhinava demolishes each in turn. Some say liberation is a matter
of knowledge: we suffer from not-knowing, so when knowledge dawns, power descends. But the "dawn
of right knowledge" is itself the thing that needs explaining — the account is circular on arrival.
Say instead that grace is produced by ritual action, and it inherits action's limits: like any reward,
it would be something merely enjoyed, and anyone enjoying anyt
sa: tatra kecit āhuḥ jñānābhāvāt ajñānamūlaḥ saṃsāraḥ tadapagame jñānodayāt śaktipāta iti teṣāṃ samyak jñānodaya eva vikṛta iti vācyam karmajanyatve karmaphalavat bhogatvaprasaṅge bhogini ca śaktipātābhyupagatau atiprasaṅgaḥ īśvarecchānimittatve tu jñānodayasya anyonyāśrayatā vaiyarthyaṃ ca īśvare rāgādiprasaṅgaḥ viruddhayoḥ karmaṇoḥ samabalayoḥ anyonyapratibandhe karmasāmyaṃ tataḥ śaktipāta iti cet na kramikatve virodhāyogāt virodhe 'pi anyasya aviruddhasya karmaṇo bhogadānaprasaṅgāt aviruddhakarmā

en:
## tsa11-p03 — maturation, and the collapse of dualism
"Grace comes when the stain ripens." Very well: what is this ripening — what is it, and what causes
it? No answer comes. And with it fall the whole catalogue of supposed causes — dispassion, merit,
discernment, good company, attainment, worship. For the dualist schools, every option on the table
is now incoherent.

sa: atha malaparipāke śaktipātaḥ so 'pi kiṃsvarūpaḥ kiṃ ca tasya nimittam iti etena vairāgyaṃ dharmaviśeṣo vivekaḥ satsevā satprāptiḥ devapūjā ityādihetuḥ pratyukta iti bhedavādināṃ sarvam asamañjasam // abhts_11.4

svatantraparameśādvayavāde tu upapadyate etat yathāhi parameśvaraḥ svarūpācchādanakrīḍayā paśuḥ pudgalo 'ṇuḥ sampannaḥ na ca tasya deśakālasvarūpabhedavirodhaḥ tadvat svarūpasthaganavinivṛttyā svarūpapratyāpattiṃ jhaṭiti vā krameṇa vā samāśrayan śaktipātapātram aṇuḥ ucyate svātantryamātrasāraś ca asau paramaśivaḥ śakteḥ pātayitā iti nirapekṣa eva śaktipāto yaḥ svarūpaprathāphalaḥ yas tu bhogotsukasya sa karmāpekṣaḥ lokottararūpabhogotsukasya tu sa eva śaktipātaḥ parameśvarecchāpreritamāyāgarbhād

bhedadarśana iva anādiśivasaṃnidhau muktaśivānāṃ sṛṣṭilayādikṛtyeṣu mandatīvrāt śaktipātāt sadguruviṣayā yiyāsā bhavati asadguruviṣayāyāṃ tu tirobhāva eva asadgurutas tu sadgurugamanaṃ śaktipātād eva // abhts_11.8 sadgurus tu samastaitacchāstratattvajñānapūrṇaḥ sākṣāt bhagavadbhairavabhaṭṭāraka eva yogino 'pi svabhyastajñānatayaiva mocakatve tatra yogyatvasya saubhāgyalāvaṇyādimattvasyevānupayogāt // abhts_11.9 asadgurus tu anyaḥ sarva eva // abhts_11.10

## tsa11-p06 — how initiation works, and what follows by rank
So the seeker receives from the teacher the initiation whose mark is knowledge — and is free at
once, while still alive. It comes by a glance, a word, a text taught, a conduct shown, food
shared, and more. There is also the initiation that severs the life-breath — but that one is for
the hour of death, as will be taught. From the highest three intensities of the intense, even the
initiated has no steady footing in his own Śiva-nature
sa: evaṃ yiyāsuḥ guroḥ jñānalakṣaṇāṃ dīkṣāṃ prāpnoti yayā sadya eva mukto bhavati jīvann api atra avalokanāt kathanāt śāstrasambodhanāt caryādarśanāt carudānāt ityādayo bhedāḥ // abhts_11.11 abhyāsavato vā tadānīṃ sadya eva prāṇaviyojikāṃ dīkṣāṃ labhate sā tu maraṇakṣaṇa eva kāryā iti vakṣyāma iti // abhts_11.12 tīvrās tridhā utkṛṣṭamadhyāt śaktipātāt kṛtadīkṣāko 'pi svātmanaḥ śivatāyāṃ na tathā dṛḍhapratipattiḥ bhavati pratipattiparipākakrameṇa tu dehānte śiva eva madhyamadhyāt tu śivatotsuko 'pi b

nikṛṣṭamadhyāt tu dehāntareṇa bhogaṃ bhuktvā śivatvam eti iti // abhts_11.14 madhyas tu tridhā bhogotsukatā yadā pradhānabhūtā tadā mandatvaṃ pārameśvaramantrayogopāyatayā yatas tatra autsukyam pārameśamantrayogādeś ca yato mokṣaparyantatvam ataḥ śaktipātarūpatā // abhts_11.15 tatrāpi tāratamyāt traividhyam ity eṣa mukhyaḥ śaktipātaḥ // abhts_11.16

vaiṣṇavādīnāṃ tu rājānugrahavat na mokṣāntatā iti na iha vivecanam // abhts_11.17 śivaśaktyadhiṣṭhānaṃ tu sarvatra iti uktam sā paraṃ jyeṣṭhā na bhavati api tu ghorā ghoratarā vā sa eṣa śaktipāto vicitro 'pi tāratamyavaicitryāt bhidyate kaścid vaiṣṇavādisthaḥ samayyādikrameṇa srotaḥpañcake ca prāptaparipākaḥ sarvottīrṇabhagavatṣaḍardhaśāstraparamādhikāritām eti anyas tu ullaṅghanakrameṇa anantabhedena ko 'pi akramam iti ata eva adharādharaśāsanasthā guravo 'pi iha maṇḍalamātradarśane 'pi anadhik

yogī tu phalotsukasya yukto yadi upāyopadeśena avyavahitam eva phalaṃ dātuṃ śaktaḥ upāyopadeśena tu jñāne eva yukto mokṣe 'pi abhyupāyāt jñānapūrṇatākāṅkṣī ca bahūn api gurūn kuryāt // abhts_11.20 uttamottamādijñānabhedāpekṣayā teṣu varteta sampūrṇajñānagurutyāge tu prāyaścittam eva // abhts_11.21 nanu so 'pi abruvan viparītaṃ vā bruvan kiṃ na tyājyaḥ naiva iti brūmaḥ tasya hi pūrṇajñānatvāt eva rāgādyabhāva iti avacanādikaṃ śiṣyagatenaiva kenacit ayogyatvānāśvastatvādinā nimittena syāt iti tadu

## tsa11-p10 — grace unconditioned; hiding; the unbroken self
So: the descent, which is what makes grace happen, is unconditioned — it does not wait on deeds
or destinies. Hiding, by contrast, ripens thick suffering and confusion, all of it deed-
conditioned. Watch the mirror: the awake man playing the fool still inwardly despises folly — and
the fool playing awake, mouthing mantras, still despises the part. The awake man's folly, once
acted, dissolves; but the fool's acted awakeness — performed
sa: evam anugrahanimittaṃ śaktipāto nirapekṣa eva karmādiniyatyapekṣaṇāt // abhts_11.23 tirobhāva iti tirobhāvo hi karmādyapekṣagāḍhaduḥkhamohabhāgitvaphalaḥ yathāhi prakāśasvātantryāt prabuddho 'pi mūḍhavat ceṣṭate hṛdayena ca mūḍhaceṣṭāṃ nindati tathā mūḍho 'pi prabuddhaceṣṭāṃ mantrārādhanādikāṃ kuryāt nindec ca yathā ca asya mūḍhaceṣṭā kriyamāṇāpi prabuddhasya dhvaṃsam eti tathā asya prabuddhaceṣṭā sā tu nindyamānā niṣiddhācaraṇarūpatvāt svayaṃ ca tayaiva viśaṅkamānatvāt enaṃ duḥkhamohapaṅke nima

tantrasāra, dvādaśam āhnikam dīkṣādikaṃ vaktavyam iti uktam ato dīkṣāsvarūpanirūpaṇārthaṃ prāk kartavyaṃ snānam upadiśyate // abhts_12.1 snānaṃ ca śuddhatā ucyate śuddhatā ca parameśvarasvarūpasamāveśaḥ // abhts_12.2 kāluṣyāpagamo hi śuddhiḥ kāluṣyaṃ ca tadekarūpe 'pi atatsvabhāvarūpāntarasaṃvalanābhimānaḥ // abhts_12.3 tad iha svatantrānandacinmātrasāre svātmani viśvatrāpi vā tadanyarūpasaṃvalanābhimānaḥ aśuddhiḥ sā ca mahābhairavasamāveśena vyapohyate so 'pi kasyacit jhaṭiti bhavet kasyāpi upā

tantrasāra, trayodaśam āhnikam atha prasannahṛdayo yāgasthānaṃ yāyāt tac ca yatraiva hṛdayaṃ prasādayuktaṃ parameśvarasamāveśayogyaṃ bhavati tad eva na tu asya anyal lakṣaṇam uktāv api dhyeyatādātmyam eva kāraṇam tad api bhāvaprasādād eva iti nānyat sthānam // abhts_13.1 pīṭhaparvatāgram ityādis tu śāstre sthānoddeśa etatpara eva boddhavyaḥ // abhts_13.2 teṣu teṣu pīṭhādisthāneṣu parameśaniyatyā parameśvarāviṣṭānāṃ śaktīnāṃ dehagrahaṇāt āryadeśā iva dhārmikāṇāṃ mlecchadeśā iva adhārmikāṇām parva

tantrasāra, caturdaśam āhnikam atha putrakadīkṣāvidhiḥ // abhts_14.1 sa ca vistīrṇaḥ tantrālokāt avadhāryaḥ // abhts_14.2 saṃkṣiptas tu ucyate // abhts_14.3 samayyantaṃ vidhiṃ kṛtvā tṛtīye 'hni triśūlābje maṇḍale sāmudāyikaṃ yāgaṃ pūjayet tatra bāhyaparivāraṃ dvāradevatācakraṃ ca bahiḥ pūjayet tato maṇḍalapūrvabhāge aiśakoṇāt ārabhya āgneyāntaṃ paṅktikrameṇa gaṇapatiṃ guruṃ paramaguruṃ parameṣṭhinaṃ pūrvācāryān yoginīcakraṃ vāgīśvarīṃ kṣetrapālaṃ ca pūjayet // abhts_14.4 tata ājñāṃ samucitām ādā

tantrasāra, pañcadaśam āhnikam yadā punar āsannamaraṇasya svayaṃ vā bandhumukhena śaktipāta upajāyate tadā asmai sadyaḥ samutkramaṇadīkṣāṃ kuryāt // abhts_15.1 samastam adhvānaṃ śiṣye nyasya taṃ ca krameṇa śodhayitvā bhagavatīṃ kālarātrīm marmakartanīṃ nyasya tayā kramāt kramaṃ marmapāśān vibhidya brahmarandhravarti śiṣyacaitanyaṃ kuryāt // abhts_15.2 tataḥ pūrvoktakrameṇa yojanikārthaṃ pūrṇāhutiṃ dadyāt yathā pūrṇāhutyante jīvo niṣkrāntaḥ paramaśivābhinno bhavati // abhts_15.3 bubhukṣos tu dvit

tantrasāra, ṣodaśam āhnikam atha parokṣasya dīkṣā dvividhaś ca saḥ mṛto jīvaṃś ca // abhts_16.1 tatra kṛtaguruseva eva mṛta udvāsito vā abhicārādihato ḍimbāhato mṛtyukṣaṇoditatathāruciḥ mukhāntarāyātaśaktipāto vā tathā dīkṣya ity ājñā // abhts_16.2 atra ca mṛtadīkṣāyām adhivāsādi na upayujyate // abhts_16.3 maṇḍale mantraviśeṣasaṃnidhaye yatra bahulā kriyā uttamam upakaraṇaṃ puṣpādi sthānaṃ pīṭhādi maṇḍalaṃ triśūlābjādi ākṛtiḥ dhyeyaviśeṣaḥ mantraḥ svayaṃ dīptaś ca dhyānaparasya yoginaḥ tadekabh

tantrasāra, ekonaviṃśam āhnikam atha adharaśāsanasthānāṃ gurvantānām api maraṇasamanantaraṃ mṛtoddhāroditaśaktipātayogād eva antyasaṃskārākhyāṃ dīkṣāṃ kuryāt ūrdhvaśāsanasthānām api luptasamayānām akṛtaprāyaścittānām iti parameśvarājñā // abhts_19.1 tatra yo mṛtoddhāre vidhiḥ uktaḥ sa sarva eva śarīre kartavyaḥ pūrṇāhutyā śavaśarīradāhaḥ mūḍhānāṃ tu pratītirūḍhaye sapratyayām antyeṣṭiṃ kriyājñānayogabalāt kuryāt tatra śavaśarīre saṃhārakrameṇa mantrān nyasya jālakrameṇa ākṛṣya rodhanavedhanaghaṭ

"namaḥ," "I bow," "I worship" — all move by one of these two directions, but each must culminate in the

**The own-self: the one consciousness, whose body is the world**

The kārikā says that the own-self alone is the Lord. But what is this "own-self"? Does it reach the
whole world — the inert things, the void, everything? The objector presses hard on this. If the
maheśvara is the self of the blue, then he must be the self of the yellow too; and then how can the
world be divided — "this is the blue, this is the yellow"? The answer turns on what "own-self" really
means.

Recognition (pratyabhijñā) is tasting t

When the yogin abides with mind-wind dissolved in the inward aim — he, seeing yet not seeing outside with unmoving-pupil gaze — this indeed becomes the śāmbhavī mudrā, by your grace, O guru: devoid of void and non-void becomes that reality, the śāmbhava state.
antarlakṣyavilīnacittapavano yogī yadā vartate dṛṣṭyā niścalatārayā bahirasau paśyannapaśyannapi | mudreyaṃ khalu śāmbhavī bhavati sā yuṣmatprasādādguro śūnyāśūnyavivarjitaṃ bhavati yat tattvaṃ padaṃ śāmbhavam
sa: antarlakṣyavilīnacittapavano yogī yadā vartate dṛṣṭyā niścalatārayā bahirasau paśyannapaśyannapi | mudreyaṃ khalu śāmbhavī bhavati sā yuṣmatprasādādguro śūnyāśūnyavivarjitaṃ bhavati yat tattvaṃ padaṃ śāmbhavam

en:
Half-open-eyed, steady-minded, gaze placed on the nose-tip — moon and sun too have attained dissolution in the interior of the triple-throb state — light-formed, devoid of all exteriority, and one supreme person: reality attains that state, the thing supreme. What more is there to say here?

sa: ardhoddhāṭitalocanaḥ sthiramanā nāsāgradattekṣaṇaḥ candrārkāvapi līnatāmupagatau trispandabhāvāntare | jyotīrūpamaśeṣabāhyarahitaṃ caikaṃ pumāṃsaṃ paraṃ tattvaṃ tatpadameti vastu paramam vācyaṃ kimatrādhikam

en:
Whatever sound arises from the mouth — that mantra is transcendent. Whatever posture of the pleasure-pain-born body — that indeed is mudrā. Whatever flowing of breath by its own rhythm — that indeed is wonderful yoga. The supreme śākta abode — while I experience, what indeed would not shine?

en: That mantra shines forth in which letter-arrangement is not distinguished. That mudrā arises in which entire bodily action is dissolved. That yoga spreads forth from which breath's flowing is exhausted. en:
Transition here is no method at all — not contemplation, not speech-connection, not discussion, not visualization, not steadying, not japa-practice-effort. So what is well-decided? Speak the supreme truth, and hear it: not renouncer, not possessor — enjoy happiness, wholly, as staying.

sa: saṃkrāmo 'tra na bhāvanā na ca kathāyuktir na carcā na ca dhyānaṃ vā na ca dhāraṇā na ca japābhyāsaprayāso na ca | tat kiṃ nāma suniścitaṃ vada paraṃ satyaṃ ca tac chrūyatām: na tyāgī na parigrahī — bhaja sukhaṃ sarvam yathāvasthitaḥ

en:
Passion, aversion, pleasure, displeasure, rise and fall, I-ness, misery and the rest — things shining forth, universe-bodied, are not different-natured. Whosever manifestation you suddenly see — having regarded it as one-self-natured consciousness-form — why do you not delight, full of contemplation?
rāgadveṣasukhāsukhodayalayāhaṅkāradainyādayo ye bhāvāḥ pravibhānti viśvavapuṣo bhinnasvabhāvā na te | vyaktiṃ paśyasi yasya yasya sahasā tattattadekātmatāsaṃvidrūpam avekṣya kiṃ na ramase tadbhāvanā
sa: rāgadveṣasukhāsukhodayalayāhaṅkāradainyādayo ye bhāvāḥ pravibhānti viśvavapuṣo bhinnasvabhāvā na te | vyaktiṃ paśyasi yasya yasya sahasā tattattadekātmatāsaṃvidrūpam avekṣya kiṃ na ramase tadbhāvanānirbharaḥ || AgAna_5

en:
Former non-being, being, action — things always, suddenly, in this existence: middle-formed, transformation-confused — whence their truth? In the non-true, unsteady, manifold, clever dream-delusion — transcending doubt, fear, stain, and reasoning's contriving: awakened, become.
pūrvābhāvabhavakriyā hi sahasā bhāvāḥ sadā 'smin bhave madhyākāravikārasaṃkaravatāṃ teṣāṃ kutaḥ satyatā | niḥsatye capale prapañcanicaye svapnabhrame peśale śaṅkātaṅkakalaṅkayuktikalanātītaḥ prabuddho bhava || AgAna_6
sa: pūrvābhāvabhavakriyā hi sahasā bhāvāḥ sadā 'smin bhave madhyākāravikārasaṃkaravatāṃ teṣāṃ kutaḥ satyatā | niḥsatye capale prapañcanicaye svapnabhrame peśale śaṅkātaṅkakalaṅkayuktikalanātītaḥ prabuddho bhava || AgAna_6

en:
Of things there is no arising; naturally, by your contemplation they shine; even the non-true partakes of truth for a moment, through experience's delusion. This universe-glory is will-born from you, birth from elsewhere it has none; hence by splendor you shine in worlds — one, yet many-selfed.
bhāvānāṃ na samudbhavo 'sti sahajas tvadbhāvitā bhānty amī niḥsatyā api satyatām anubhavabhrāntyā bhajanti kṣaṇam | tvatsaṅkalpaja eṣa viśvamahimā nāsty asya janmānyataḥ tasmāt tvaṃ vibhavena bhāsi bhuvan
sa: bhāvānāṃ na samudbhavo 'sti sahajas tvadbhāvitā bhānty amī niḥsatyā api satyatām anubhavabhrāntyā bhajanti kṣaṇam | tvatsaṅkalpaja eṣa viśvamahimā nāsty asya janmānyataḥ tasmāt tvaṃ vibhavena bhāsi bhuvaneṣv ekopy anekātmakaḥ || AgAna_7

en:
What true, what untrue, little-much, eternal, not eternal, what Māyā-stained, what self-pure — in the consciousness-mirror shines. That all, from own-grasping-consciousness-rise, form-light-natured, having known — own-experience-risen glory: Lordhood — worship.
yat satyaṃ yad asatyam alpabahulaṃ nityaṃ na nityaṃ ca yat yan māyāmalinaṃ yad ātmavimalaṃ ciddarpaṇe rājate | tat sarvaṃ svavimarśasaṃvidudayād rūpaprakāśātmakaṃ jñātvā svānubhavādhirūḍhamahimā viśveśvaratvaṃ bhaja || AgAna_8
sa: yat satyaṃ yad asatyam alpabahulaṃ nityaṃ na nityaṃ ca yat yan māyāmalinaṃ yad ātmavimalaṃ ciddarpaṇe rājate | tat sarvaṃ svavimarśasaṃvidudayād rūpaprakāśātmakaṃ jñātvā svānubhavādhirūḍhamahimā viśveśvaratvaṃ bhaja || AgAna_8

en:
Pervading the particular states of moving and unmoving — consciousness-made, one, endless, beginningless: Bhairava-Lord, refuge of the helpless — by mind become Yours, in heart I venerate.
vyāptacarācarabhāvaviśeṣaṃ cinmayam ekam anantam anādim bhairavanātham anāthaśaraṇyaṃ tvanmayacittatayā hṛdi vande
sa: vyāptacarācarabhāvaviśeṣaṃ cinmayam ekam anantam anādim bhairavanātham anāthaśaraṇyaṃ tvanmayacittatayā hṛdi vande

en:
All this, become of You, now appears to me by the power of Your grace. You, Maheśa, are always my self; by You all is mine.
tvanmayam etad aśeṣam idānīṃ bhāti mama tvadanugrahaśaktyā tvaṃ ca maheśa sadaiva mamātmā svātmamayaṃ mama tena samastam
sa: tvanmayam etad aśeṣam idānīṃ bhāti mama tvadanugrahaśaktyā tvaṃ ca maheśa sadaiva mamātmā svātmamayaṃ mama tena samastam

en:
With You as Lord, all-pervading in own self — therefore no talk of transmigration-fear. Even though hard-to-bear suffering, delusion, and terror-causing karmas stand.
svātmani viśvagaye tvayi nāthe tena na saṃsṛtibhītikathāsti satsv api durdharaduḥkhavimohatrāsavidhāyiṣu karmagaṇeṣu
sa: svātmani viśvagaye tvayi nāthe tena na saṃsṛtibhītikathāsti satsv api durdharaduḥkhavimohatrāsavidhāyiṣu karmagaṇeṣu

en:
O Ender, do not direct this most wrathful-terrible gaze toward me. Firm in Śaṅkara-service and contemplation, I am filled with terrifying Bhairava-power.
antaka māṃ prati mā dṛśam enāṃ krodhakarālatamāṃ vinidhehi śaṅkarasevanacintanadhīro bhīṣaṇabhairavaśaktimayo 'smi

en:
Thus — great darkness already dispelled by rays of awareness: death, Yama, ender, karma-ghosts met with salutation alone, and never do I fear.

en:
Arisen true awakening: its rays reveal the true essence of world-objects. In You, being-full, I the self enter bliss.
proditasatyavibodhamarīciprekṣitaviśvapadārthasatattvaḥ bhāvaparāmṛtanirbharapūrṇe tvayi aham ātmani nirvṛtim emi

en:
When affliction, producing slight anguish, comes into mind's range — then alone my nondifference with You, and nectar-rain arises.

en:
Truly, O Śaṅkara: vow, giving, bathing, austerity dispel becoming's heat. Contemplation of Your scripture as supreme nectar streams a bliss-stream in mind.

sa: śaṅkara satyam idam vratadānasnānatapaḥ bhavatāpavidāri tāvakaśāstra parāmṛtacintā cetasi nirvṛtidhārām syandati

en:
This consciousness of mine dances, sings, deeply rejoices — O Bhairava-Lord. Having obtained You, the dear: the beautiful vision alone, hard to get by others.

en:
In the month of Pauṣa, on the dark tenth, Abhinavagupta made this hymn. The pervasive, compassionate Lord pacifies the world's desert-heat — instantly.

How can the self be the *eternal* knower, if memory reaches only what one has experienced — and the Rāmāyaṇa was composed by Vālmīki long ago, whom "I" was not? The objection: "I was not at the time of the Rāmāyaṇa." Abhinavagupta answers that the *param-essence knower* — the consciousness-self — is un-cut by all three times; the "I" that was not at that time is only the present body, not the self. Memory itself, he shows, presupposes the eternal knower.

The Buddhist's pūrvapakṣa has denied the self (V1-F), the cognition (V1-G), and the action (V1-I). Now it completes itself: since the *relation* (between the cognition and its object, or the agent and the action) is also impossible, "thence the agent too is constructed (kalpita)." This is the close of the no-self attack — the agent, like everything else, is only a construction. (It will be Abhinavagupta's task, in the siddhānta, to show the opposite — that the agent is the real, free self.)

The Buddhist's last resort is the *determination* (adhyavasāya) — the act by which the cognition is taken to establish an external thing. Abhinavagupta now shows that the determination cannot do this: it is itself only the manifestation-form in the self, and the "external" it seems to posit is not established by it. And the memory-cognition is not separate from the cognition — both are the self-luminous awareness.
